LPt_LPl_G_Geometry.source:
import Aeneas
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl_G
/-- Every iteration's source window is contained in the caller's full buffer. -/
theorem window_contained (width count i : Nat) (hi : i < count) :
    width * i + width ≤ width * count := by
  have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left width (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hi)
  simpa only [Nat.mul_succ] using h
/-- Covers arbitrary rows of the 29-value scanner, rather than 29 fixtures. -/
theorem scan928 (i : Nat) (hi : i < 29) : 32*i+32 ≤ 928 := by omega
/-- The 116-value validator and late Claims decoder use this same range. -/
theorem record3712 (i : Nat) (hi : i < 116) : 32*i+32 ≤ 3712 := by omega
/-- Late decode windows remain in the SAME record for all three Claims offsets. -/
theorem claims_window (point i : Nat) (hp : point < 3) (hi : i < 29) :
    29*point+i < 116 ∧ 5+32*(29*point+i)+16 ≤ 5+116*32 := by omega
#print axioms window_contained
#print axioms scan928
#print axioms record3712
#print axioms claims_window
end LPt_LPl_G

  (bs.take 4).foldr (fun b n => b.val + 256*n) 0

def validChunk (width : Nat) (highZero : Bool) (bs : List U8) : Bool :=
  (List.range width).all fun j =>
    let n := le32 ((bs.drop (4*j)).take 4)
    decide (n < 2147483647) && (!highZero || decide (j < 4 ∨ n = 0))

def chunksValid (size width : Nat) (highZero : Bool) (bs : List U8) : Bool :=
  (List.range (bs.length / size)).all fun i =>
    validChunk width highZero ((bs.drop (size*i)).take size)
end LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes

/- P6 OPEN. XRe_reference.rs:28-38, lines 29/30 loop bound -> chunksValid16;
   lines31-33 word parse/test -> validChunk4; lines35-38 -> error/Ok. -/
def LPt_External.compact.check_values (bytes : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit compact.CodecError) :=
  ok (if LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes.chunksValid 16 4 false bytes.val then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonical)

/- P6 OPEN. XRe_reference.rs:49-60, lines50-51 chunk loop -> chunksValid32;
   lines52-55 parse8/canonical/high-zero -> validChunk8; lines56-60 -> return. -/
def LPt_External.verifier.echeck (bytes : Slice U8) (k : Bool) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit verifier.Error) :=
  ok (if LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes.chunksValid 32 8 k bytes.val then .Ok () else .Err .Parse)

/- P6 OPEN. XRg_reference.rs:validate_reference, whole chunks32 in source order;
   first failing chunk i yields NonCanonical(row,i), matching the reference. -/
def LPt_External.r1_wire.validate_record_fields (row : U8) (bytes : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit r1_wire.Error) := do
  match (List.range (bytes.val.length / 32)).find? (fun i =>
      !(LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes.validChunk 8 true ((bytes.val.drop (32*i)).take 32))) with
  | none => ok (.Ok ())
  | some i =>
    dite (i ≤ UScalar.cMax UScalarTy.Usize)
      (fun h => ok (.Err (.NonCanonical row (UScalar.ofNat i h))))
      (fun _ => fail .panic)

/- P6 OPEN. XRe_reference.rs:39-47: alignment short-circuits first; checked
   multiplication matches Rust's overflow behavior. Source low16 copy / high16
   fill is the map on every destination index. No allocator/borrow bridge. -/
def LPt_External.compact.expand_values (bytes out : Slice U8) :
    Result ((core.result.Result Unit compact.CodecError) × Slice U8) := do
  if bytes.val.length % 16 != 0 then
    ok (.Err .Length, out)
  else
    let size ← Slice.len bytes * 2#usize
    if Slice.len out != size then ok (.Err .Length, out)
    else
      let values := (List.range out.val.length).map fun i =>
        if i % 32 < 16 then bytes.val[i/32*16+i%32]?.getD 0#u8 else 0#u8
      dite (values.length ≤ Usize.max)
        (fun bound => ok (.Ok (), ⟨values, bound⟩))
        (fun _ => fail .panic)

LPt_LPl_A_Fold.source:
import Aeneas

/-! Pure P6 association: native stage certificates are named in LPt_LPl_A_LEAVES.md.
They are evidence references, not Lean axioms. This module only proves the
iteration/fold transport; it cannot manufacture native source correspondence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl_A

def stages {S : Type} (step : S → Nat → S) (initial : S) : Nat → S
  | 0 => initial
  | n+1 => step (stages step initial n) n

/-- Induction on the actual iteration bound, without concrete loop reduction. -/
theorem stages_fold {S : Type} (step : S → Nat → S) (initial : S) (n : Nat) :
    stages step initial n = (List.range n).foldl step initial := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [stages, ih, List.range_succ, List.foldl_append,
      List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]

theorem stages_all (p : Nat → Bool) (n : Nat) :
    stages (fun good i => good && p i) true n = (List.range n).all p := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [stages, ih, List.range_succ, List.all_append,
      List.all_cons, List.all_nil, Bool.and_true]

theorem stages_append {S : Type} (step : S → Nat → S) (initial : S) (n : Nat) :
    stages step initial (n+1) = step ((List.range n).foldl step initial) n := by
  rw [stages, stages_fold]

#print axioms stages_fold
#print axioms stages_all
#print axioms stages_append
end LPt_LPl_A

def build {A : Type} (f : Nat → A) : Nat → List A
  | 0 => []
  | n+1 => build f n ++ [f n]
theorem build_map {A : Type} (f : Nat → A) (n : Nat) :
    build f n = (List.range n).map f := by
  induction n with

theorem build_fold {A : Type} (f : Nat → A) (n : Nat) :
    build f n = (List.range n).foldl (fun xs i => xs ++ [f i]) [] := by

LPt_LPl_A_FirstError.source:
import LPt_LPl_A_Fold
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl_A

def firstBad (bad : Nat → Bool) : Nat → Option Nat
  | 0 => none
  | n+1 => match firstBad bad n with
    | some i => some i
    | none => if bad n then some n else none

theorem firstBad_find (bad : Nat → Bool) (n : Nat) :
    firstBad bad n = (List.range n).find? bad := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [firstBad, ih, List.range_succ, List.find?_append]
    cases h : (List.range n).find? bad <;> cases hb : bad n <;> simp [h, hb, List.find?]

theorem firstBad_fold (bad : Nat → Bool) (n : Nat) :
    firstBad bad n = (List.range n).foldl (fun found i =>
      match found with
      | some j => some j
      | none => if bad i then some i else none) none := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [firstBad, ih, List.range_succ, List.foldl_append,
      List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]

#print axioms firstBad_find
#print axioms firstBad_fold
end LPt_LPl_A

LPt_LPl_A_StageLaws.source:
import LPt_LPl_A_Fold
import LPt_LPl_A_Map
import LPt_LPl_A_FirstError
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl_A

theorem stages_congr {S : Type} (a b : S → Nat → S) (initial : S) (n : Nat)
    (same : ∀ state i, i < n → a state i = b state i) :
    stages a initial n = stages b initial n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have small : ∀ state i, i < n → a state i = b state i := by
      intro state i hi
      exact same state i (Nat.lt.step hi)
    simp only [stages, ih small]
    exact same _ _ (Nat.lt_succ_self _)

theorem firstBad_bound (bad : Nat → Bool) (n i : Nat)
    (hit : firstBad bad n = some i) : i < n := by
  rw [firstBad_find] at hit
  exact List.mem_range.mp (List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hit)

theorem firstBad_none (bad : Nat → Bool) (n : Nat) :
    firstBad bad n = none ↔ ∀ i, i < n → bad i = false := by
  rw [firstBad_find, List.find?_eq_none]
  simp only [List.mem_range, Bool.not_eq_true]

theorem firstBad_is_bad (bad : Nat → Bool) (n i : Nat)
    (hit : firstBad bad n = some i) : bad i = true := by
  rw [firstBad_find] at hit
  exact List.find?_some hit

theorem build_length {A : Type} (f : Nat → A) (n : Nat) : (build f n).length = n := by
  rw [build_map]
  simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range]

#print axioms stages_congr
#print axioms firstBad_bound
#print axioms firstBad_none
#print axioms firstBad_is_bad
#print axioms build_length
end LPt_LPl_A

    LPt_External.verifier.echeck bs k = ok (.Ok ()) ↔
      ∀ i, i < bs.val.length/32 → predicate bs.val k i = true := by
  rw [shipped_leaf_model]
  simp only [loop, LPt_LPl_A.stages_all, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range]
  split <;> simp_all

theorem rejects_of_bad_stage (bs : Slice U8) (k : Bool) (i : Nat)
    (bound : i < bs.val.length/32) (bad : predicate bs.val k i = false) :
    LPt_External.verifier.echeck bs k = ok (.Err .Parse) := by
  have failed : loop bs.val k = false := by
    rw [loop, LPt_LPl_A.stages_all, List.all_eq_false]
    exact ⟨i,List.mem_range.mpr bound,by simp only [bad, Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true]⟩
  rw [shipped_leaf_model, failed]
  rfl

#print axioms accepts_iff

end LPt_LPl_A.Echeck

theorem error_index_bound (bs : Slice U8) (size : bs.val.length ≤ 3712) (i : Nat) (hit : loop bs.val = some i) :
    i ≤ UScalar.cMax .Usize := by
  have h := LPt_LPl_A.firstBad_bound (bad bs.val) (bs.val.length/32) i hit
  change i ≤ 4294967295
  omega

theorem error_exact (row : U8) (bs : Slice U8) (size : bs.val.length ≤ 3712) (i : Nat) (hit : loop bs.val = some i) :
    LPt_External.r1_wire.validate_record_fields row bs =
      ok (.Err (.NonCanonical row (UScalar.ofNat i (error_index_bound bs size i hit)))) := by
  rw [shipped_leaf_model, hit]
  simp only [dif_pos (error_index_bound bs size i hit)]

theorem accepts_of_all_stages (row : U8) (bs : Slice U8)
    (valid : ∀ i, i < bs.val.length/32 → bad bs.val i = false) :
    LPt_External.r1_wire.validate_record_fields row bs = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  have absent : loop bs.val = none := (LPt_LPl_A.firstBad_none _ _).mpr valid
  rw [shipped_leaf_model, absent]

#print axioms error_index_bound
#print axioms error_exact
#print axioms accepts_of_all_stages
end LPt_LPl_A.Validate

import LPt_LPl_A_EcheckLaws

namespace LPt_LPl_C.Echeck
theorem caller_iff (bs : Slice U8) (k : Bool) (size : bs.val.length = 928) :
    LPt_External.verifier.echeck bs k = ok (.Ok ()) ↔
    ∀ i, i < 29 → LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.predicate bs.val k i = true := by
  rw [LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.accepts_iff, size]
theorem tail_class (n : Nat) (bound : n < 64) :
    n < 16 ∨ (16 ≤ n ∧ n < 32) ∨ (32 ≤ n ∧ n < 48) ∨ (48 ≤ n ∧ n < 64) := by omega
/-- Count law for the actual chunks_exact semantics, with arbitrary tail. -/
theorem count_with_tail (n tail : Nat) (small : tail < 32) :
    (32*n+tail)/32 = n := by omega
#print axioms caller_iff
#print axioms tail_class
#print axioms count_with_tail
end LPt_LPl_C.Echeck

namespace LPt_LPl_C.Check
/-- Full caller bound; input bytes are arbitrary. Native/carrier join is separate. -/
theorem caller_iff (bs : Slice U8) (size : bs.val.length = 464) :
    LPt_External.compact.check_values bs = ok (.Ok ()) ↔
    ∀ i, i < 29 → LPt_LPl_A.Check.predicate bs.val i = true := by
  rw [LPt_LPl_A.Check.accepts_iff, size]
/-- Rejection retains the actual error, with no successful-return antecedent. -/
theorem caller_reject (bs : Slice U8) (size : bs.val.length = 464) (i : Nat)
    (bound : i < 29) (bad : LPt_LPl_A.Check.predicate bs.val i = false) :
    LPt_External.compact.check_values bs = ok (.Err .NonCanonical) := by
  exact LPt_LPl_A.Check.rejects_of_bad_stage bs i (by rw [size]; exact bound) bad
#print axioms caller_iff
#print axioms caller_reject
end LPt_LPl_C.Check

namespace LPt_LPl_C.Validate
theorem caller_success (row : U8) (bs : Slice U8) (size : bs.val.length = 3712)
    (valid : ∀ i, i < 116 → LPt_LPl_A.Validate.bad bs.val i = false) :
    LPt_External.r1_wire.validate_record_fields row bs = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  apply LPt_LPl_A.Validate.accepts_of_all_stages
  simpa only [size] using valid
theorem caller_error_bound (bs : Slice U8) (size : bs.val.length = 3712)
    (i : Nat) (hit : LPt_LPl_A.Validate.loop bs.val = some i) : i < 116 := by
  have h := LPt_LPl_A.firstBad_bound (LPt_LPl_A.Validate.bad bs.val) (bs.val.length/32) i hit
  simpa only [size] using h
#print axioms caller_success
#print axioms caller_error_bound
end LPt_LPl_C.Validate

theorem echeck_stages (bs : List Aeneas.Std.U8) (k : Bool) (size : bs.length = 928)

    ((xs++tail).drop offset).take width = (xs.drop offset).take width := by
  rw [List.drop_append_of_le_length (by omega : offset ≤ xs.length)]

theorem check_stage_congruence (a b : List Aeneas.Std.U8)
    (count : a.length/16 = b.length/16)
    (same : ∀ i, i < a.length/16 → Check.predicate a i = Check.predicate b i) :
    Check.loop a = Check.loop b := by

  rw [← count]
  apply stages_congr

    (count : a.length/32 = b.length/32)
    (same : ∀ i, i < a.length/32 → Echeck.predicate a k i = Echeck.predicate b k i) :
    Echeck.loop a k = Echeck.loop b k := by
  unfold Echeck.loop
  rw [← count]
  apply stages_congr
  intro state i bound
  rw [same i bound]

import LPt_LPl_C_ChunkFrame
import LPt_LPl_A_ScanCongruence
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl_C.Echeck
/-- Induction transports the checked one-chunk tail law to every loop length.
This is a model theorem: native Slice/heap association is still separate. -/
theorem append_tail (xs tail : List Aeneas.Std.U8) (k : Bool) (n : Nat)
    (size : xs.length = 32*n) (small : tail.length < 32) :
    LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.loop (xs++tail) k = LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.loop xs k := by
  apply LPt_LPl_A.echeck_stage_congruence
  · simp only [List.length_append, size]
    omega
  · intro i hi
    have contained : 32*i+32 ≤ xs.length := by
      have bound : i+1 ≤ n := by
        simp only [List.length_append, size] at hi
        omega
      have mul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 32 bound
      omega
    unfold LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.predicate
    rw [LPt_LPl_C.window_append xs tail (32*i) 32 contained]
#print axioms append_tail
end LPt_LPl_C.Echeck

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl.Echeck
/-- Value port used by the native little-endian polynomial gate. -/
def byte (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) : Nat := (bs[i]?.getD 0#u8).val
def word (bs : List U8) : Nat :=
  byte bs 0 + 256 * (byte bs 1 + 256 * (byte bs 2 + 256 * byte bs 3))
/-- Exact local decoder specification; all bytes, including rejected words. -/
def chunk (bs : List U8) (k : Bool) : Bool :=
  (List.range 8).all fun j =>
    let n := word ((bs.drop (4*j)).take 4)
    decide (n < 2147483647) && (!k || decide (j < 4 ∨ n = 0))

theorem word_eq_le32 (bs : List U8) : word bs = LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes.le32 bs := by
  rcases bs with _ | ⟨a,bs⟩ <;>
    first | rfl | skip
  rcases bs with _ | ⟨b,bs⟩ <;>
    first | simp [word, byte, LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes.le32] | skip
  rcases bs with _ | ⟨c,bs⟩ <;>
    first | simp [word, byte, LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes.le32] | skip
  rcases bs with _ | ⟨d,bs⟩ <;>
    simp [word, byte, LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes.le32]

theorem chunk_eq (bs : List U8) (k : Bool) :
    chunk bs k = LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes.validChunk 8 k bs := by
  simp only [chunk, LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes.validChunk, word_eq_le32]

/-- The pointer-selected native window is the SAME list window consumed by the model. -/
theorem window (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) (native : List U8)
    (pointerWindow : native = (bs.drop (32*i)).take 32) (k : Bool) :
    chunk native k = LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.predicate bs k i := by
  rw [pointerWindow, chunk_eq]
  rfl

#print axioms word_eq_le32
#print axioms chunk_eq
#print axioms window
end LPt_LPl.Echeck

LPt_LPl_EcheckTrace.source:
import LPt_LPl_EcheckBytes
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPt_LPl_Kit_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl.Echeck
/-- One immutable chunks_exact pre-state. `offset` is the byte displacement of
    its pointer into the SAME backing; `remaining` is the actual chunk count. -/
structure Cursor (bs : List U8) where
  index : Nat
  offset : Nat
  remaining : Nat
  pointer : offset = 32*index
  count : remaining = bs.length/32-index
  bound : index ≤ bs.length/32

def cursor (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : i ≤ bs.length/32) : Cursor bs :=
  ⟨i,32*i,bs.length/32-i,rfl,rfl,h⟩

def read (bs : List U8) (s : Cursor bs) : List U8 := (bs.drop s.offset).take 32

theorem read_eq (bs : List U8) (s : Cursor bs) :
    read bs s = (bs.drop (32*s.index)).take 32 := by rw [read,s.pointer]

theorem read_size (bs : List U8) (s : Cursor bs) (live : 0 < s.remaining) :
    (read bs s).length = 32 := by
  have hi : s.index < bs.length/32 := by have := s.count; omega
  have mul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 32 (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hi)
  have div := Nat.div_mul_le_self bs.length 32
  rw [read_eq, List.length_take, List.length_drop]
  omega

theorem advance (bs : List U8) (s : Cursor bs) (live : 0 < s.remaining) :
    ∃ t : Cursor bs, t.index = s.index+1 ∧ t.offset = s.offset+32 ∧
      t.remaining+1 = s.remaining := by
  have hi : s.index < bs.length/32 := by have := s.count; omega
  refine ⟨cursor bs (s.index+1) (by omega),rfl,?_,?_⟩
  · simp only [cursor]; rw [s.pointer]; omega
  · simp only [cursor]; rw [s.count]; omega

/-- Source-shaped execution: exact next window/count, local decoder Result,
    immediate Parse rejection, and no decoder invocation on the empty suffix.
    There is no whole-output equality field. Native gates construct this trace. -/
inductive Trace (bs : List U8) (k : Bool) : Nat → Bool → Prop where
  | done (i : Nat) (endOfIterator : i = bs.length/32) : Trace bs k i true
  | reject (s : Cursor bs) (live : 0 < s.remaining)
      (nativeWindow : List U8) (sameWindow : nativeWindow = read bs s)
      (rejected : chunk nativeWindow k = false) : Trace bs k s.index false
  | next (s t : Cursor bs) (live : 0 < s.remaining)
      (nativeWindow : List U8) (sameWindow : nativeWindow = read bs s)
      (accepted : chunk nativeWindow k = true)
      (indexNext : t.index = s.index+1) (pointerNext : t.offset = s.offset+32)
      (countNext : t.remaining+1 = s.remaining)
      (result : Bool) (rest : Trace bs k t.index result) : Trace bs k s.index result

/-- Remaining-source semantics; induction follows the decreasing actual count. -/
def run (bs : List U8) (k : Bool) (i : Nat) : Nat → Bool
  | 0 => true
  | n+1 => chunk ((bs.drop (32*i)).take 32) k && run bs k (i+1) n

theorem trace_result (bs : List U8) (k : Bool) (i : Nat) (out : Bool)
    (h : Trace bs k i out) : out = run bs k i (bs.length/32-i) := by
  induction h with
  | done i endOfIterator => simp [endOfIterator,run]
  | reject s live w same bad =>
    have hi : s.index < bs.length/32 := by have := s.count; omega
    have hn : bs.length/32-s.index = (bs.length/32-s.index-1)+1 := by omega
    rw [hn,run]
    rw [same,read_eq] at bad
    simp only [bad,Bool.false_and]
  | next s t live w same good indexNext pointerNext countNext result rest ih =>
    have hi : s.index < bs.length/32 := by have := s.count; omega
    have hn : bs.length/32-s.index = (bs.length/32-t.index)+1 := by omega
    rw [hn,run]
    rw [same,read_eq] at good
    rw [good,Bool.true_and,← indexNext]
    exact ih

#print axioms read_eq
#print axioms read_size
#print axioms advance
#print axioms trace_result
end LPt_LPl.Echeck

LPt_LPl_EcheckResult.source:
import LPt_LPl_EcheckTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPt_LPl_Kit_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl.Echeck

theorem run_all (bs : List U8) (k : Bool) (n i : Nat) :
    run bs k i n = (List.range n).all (fun j => LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.predicate bs k (i+j)) := by
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [run,List.range_succ_eq_map,List.all_cons,List.all_map,ih,chunk_eq]
    simp only [Function.comp_def,Nat.add_zero,Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    change (LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.predicate bs k i && _) = (LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.predicate bs k i && _)
    congr 1
    congr 1
    funext j
    congr 1 <;> omega

theorem run_loop (bs : List U8) (k : Bool) :
    run bs k 0 (bs.length/32) = LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.loop bs k := by
  rw [run_all,LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.loop_eq_model]
  simp only [Nat.zero_add,LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes.chunksValid,LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.predicate]

/-- Whole Result equality, including rejection, on every source-shaped trace
    at the native initial cursor. Kani/source association constructs the trace;
    no model whole-loop equality is an assumption. -/
theorem native_result (bs : Slice U8) (k out : Bool)
    (trace : Trace bs.val k 0 out) :
    LPt_External.verifier.echeck bs k = ok (if out then .Ok () else .Err .Parse) := by
  have eq := trace_result bs.val k 0 out trace
  simp only [Nat.sub_zero] at eq
  rw [run_loop] at eq
  rw [LPt_LPl_A.Echeck.shipped_leaf_model,← eq]

theorem unique (bs : List U8) (k : Bool) (i : Nat) (a b : Bool)
    (left : Trace bs k i a) (right : Trace bs k i b) : a = b :=
  (trace_result bs k i a left).trans (trace_result bs k i b right).symm

/-- Existence for every input and every reached suffix; the trace interface is
    total and cannot encode an unsatisfiable accepted-run precondition. -/
theorem exists_trace (bs : List U8) (k : Bool) (n i : Nat)
    (remaining : bs.length/32-i = n) (bound : i ≤ bs.length/32) :
    ∃ out, Trace bs k i out := by
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero => exact ⟨true,.done i (by omega)⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    let s := cursor bs i bound
    have live : 0 < s.remaining := by simp only [s,cursor]; omega
    obtain ⟨t,idx,ptr,cnt⟩ := advance bs s live
    have nextBound := t.bound
    obtain ⟨out,rest⟩ := ih t.index (by simp only [s,cursor] at idx; omega) nextBound
    cases h : chunk (read bs s) k with
    | false => exact ⟨false,.reject s live (read bs s) rfl h⟩
    | true => exact ⟨out,.next s t live (read bs s) rfl h idx ptr cnt out rest⟩

#print axioms run_all
#print axioms run_loop
#print axioms native_result
#print axioms unique
#print axioms exists_trace
end LPt_LPl.Echeck

LPt_LPl_Scan.source:
import LPt_LPl_EcheckResult
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl.Scan
/-- Source-order scan preserving the index of the FIRST failure. -/
def run (p : Nat → Bool) (i : Nat) : Nat → Option Nat
  | 0 => none
  | n+1 => if p i then run p (i+1) n else some i

inductive Trace (p : Nat → Bool) (count : Nat) : Nat → Option Nat → Prop where
  | done (i : Nat) (endOfIterator : i = count) : Trace p count i none
  | reject (i : Nat) (live : i < count) (bad : p i = false) : Trace p count i (some i)
  | next (i : Nat) (live : i < count) (good : p i = true)
      (out : Option Nat) (rest : Trace p count (i+1) out) : Trace p count i out

theorem result (p : Nat → Bool) (count i : Nat) (out : Option Nat)
    (h : Trace p count i out) : out = run p i (count-i) := by
  induction h with
  | done i endOfIterator => simp [endOfIterator,run]
  | reject i live bad =>
    have hn : count-i = (count-i-1)+1 := by omega
    rw [hn,run,bad]; rfl
  | next i live good out rest ih =>
    have hn : count-i = (count-(i+1))+1 := by omega
    rw [hn,run,good]
    exact ih

theorem run_find (p : Nat → Bool) (n i : Nat) :
    run p i n = (List.range' i n).find? (fun j => !p j) := by
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [run,List.range'_succ,List.find?,Nat.add_one]; cases h : p i <;> simp [h,ih]

theorem first_error (p : Nat → Bool) (count : Nat) (out : Option Nat)
    (h : Trace p count 0 out) : out = LPt_LPl_A.firstBad (fun i => !p i) count := by
  rw [result p count 0 out h,Nat.sub_zero,run_find,LPt_LPl_A.firstBad_find]
  rw [List.range_eq_range']

theorem unique (p : Nat → Bool) (count i : Nat) (a b : Option Nat)
    (left : Trace p count i a) (right : Trace p count i b) : a = b :=
  (result p count i a left).trans (result p count i b right).symm

theorem exists_trace (p : Nat → Bool) (n i count : Nat)
    (remaining : count-i=n) (bound : i ≤ count) : ∃ out, Trace p count i out := by
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero => exact ⟨none,.done i (by omega)⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    have live : i < count := by omega
    cases h : p i with
    | false => exact ⟨some i,.reject i live h⟩
    | true =>
      obtain ⟨out,rest⟩ := ih (i+1) (by omega) (by omega)
      exact ⟨out,.next i live h out rest⟩

/-- Explicit local carrier association used to construct p at the reached
    iterator pre-state. Byte equality identifies the backing, not just length. -/
structure Window (bs : List U8) (width i : Nat) where
  offset : Nat
  remaining : Nat
  bytes : List U8
  pointer : offset = width*i
  count : remaining = bs.length/width-i
  sameBytes : bytes = (bs.drop offset).take width

theorem window_eq (bs : List U8) (width i : Nat) (w : Window bs width i)
    (decoder : List U8 → Bool) :
    decoder w.bytes = decoder ((bs.drop (width*i)).take width) := by
  rw [w.sameBytes,w.pointer]

/-- The inherited Boolean loop and the exact first-error scan reject on the
    same index set. No accepted-only hypothesis. -/
theorem bool_none (p : Nat → Bool) (count : Nat) :
    LPt_LPl_A.stages (fun good i => good && p i) true count =
      (LPt_LPl_A.firstBad (fun i => !p i) count).isNone := by
  have eq : LPt_LPl_A.stages (fun good i => good && p i) true count = true ↔
      LPt_LPl_A.firstBad (fun i => !p i) count = none := by
    rw [LPt_LPl_A.stages_all,List.all_eq_true,LPt_LPl_A.firstBad_none]
    simp only [List.mem_range]
    constructor
    · intro h i hi; rw [h i hi]; rfl
    · intro h i hi; have := h i hi; cases q : p i <;> simp_all
  cases a : LPt_LPl_A.stages (fun good i => good && p i) true count <;>
    cases b : LPt_LPl_A.firstBad (fun i => !p i) count <;> simp_all

#print axioms result
#print axioms run_find
#print axioms first_error
#print axioms unique
#print axioms exists_trace
#print axioms window_eq
#print axioms bool_none
end LPt_LPl.Scan

LPt_LPl_Check.source:
import LPt_LPl_Scan
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPt_LPl_Kit_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl.Check

def chunk (bs : List U8) : Bool :=
  (List.range 4).all fun j => decide (LPt_LPl.Echeck.word ((bs.drop (4*j)).take 4) < 2147483647)

theorem chunk_eq (bs : List U8) : chunk bs = LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes.validChunk 4 false bs := by
  simp only [chunk,LPt_LPl_Kit_Bytes.validChunk,LPt_LPl.Echeck.word_eq_le32,Bool.not_false,Bool.true_or,Bool.and_true]

def predicate (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) : Bool := chunk ((bs.drop (16*i)).take 16)

theorem window (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) (w : LPt_LPl.Scan.Window bs 16 i) :
    chunk w.bytes = LPt_LPl_A.Check.predicate bs i := by
  rw [LPt_LPl.Scan.window_eq bs 16 i w chunk,chunk_eq]
  rfl

theorem stage (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) : predicate bs i = LPt_LPl_A.Check.predicate bs i := by
  rw [predicate,chunk_eq]; rfl

/-- SAME native iterator windows and decoder observations construct this trace;
    result is a local first-error index, not a supplied model output. -/
theorem native_result (bs : Slice U8) (out : Option Nat)
    (trace : LPt_LPl.Scan.Trace (predicate bs.val) (bs.val.length/16) 0 out) :
    LPt_External.compact.check_values bs = ok (if out.isNone then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonical) := by
  have h := LPt_LPl.Scan.first_error _ _ _ trace
  have all := LPt_LPl.Scan.bool_none (predicate bs.val) (bs.val.length/16)
  rw [← h] at all
  rw [LPt_LPl_A.Check.shipped_leaf_model]
  have loop : LPt_LPl_A.Check.loop bs.val = out.isNone := by
    rw [← all]
    unfold LPt_LPl_A.Check.loop
    apply LPt_LPl_A.stages_congr
    intro good i hi
    rw [stage]
  rw [loop]

theorem unique (bs : List U8) (a b : Option Nat)
    (left : LPt_LPl.Scan.Trace (predicate bs) (bs.length/16) 0 a)
    (right : LPt_LPl.Scan.Trace (predicate bs) (bs.length/16) 0 b) : a=b :=
  LPt_LPl.Scan.unique _ _ _ _ _ left right

theorem total (bs : List U8) :
    ∃ out, LPt_LPl.Scan.Trace (predicate bs) (bs.length/16) 0 out :=
  LPt_LPl.Scan.exists_trace (predicate bs) (bs.length/16) 0 (bs.length/16) (by omega) (by omega)

theorem zero_chunk : chunk (List.replicate 16 (0#u8)) = true := by decide

theorem rejected_chunk : chunk ([255#u8,255#u8,255#u8,127#u8] ++
    List.replicate 12 (0#u8)) = false := by decide

#print axioms chunk_eq
#print axioms window
#print axioms stage
#print axioms native_result
#print axioms unique
#print axioms total
#print axioms zero_chunk
#print axioms rejected_chunk
end LPt_LPl.Check

LPt_LPs_CheckDomain.source:
import LPt_LPl_Check
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPt_LPs_CheckDomain
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def byte (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) : Nat := (bs[i]?.getD 0#u8).val
def word (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  byte bs i + 256*byte bs (i+1) + 65536*byte bs (i+2) + 16777216*byte bs (i+3)
def CompactCanonical (bs : List U8) : Prop := ∀ row, row<29 → ∀ limb,
  limb<4 → word bs (16*row+4*limb)<2147483647

theorem byte_window (bs : List U8) (off width j : Nat) (hj : j<width) :
    byte ((bs.drop off).take width) j=byte bs (off+j) := by
  simp only [byte,List.getElem?_take,hj,↓reduceIte,List.getElem?_drop]

theorem word_window (bs : List U8) (off width j : Nat) (hj : j+3<width) :
    word ((bs.drop off).take width) j=word bs (off+j) := by
  simp only [word,byte_window bs off width j (by omega),
    byte_window bs off width (j+1) (by omega),
    byte_window bs off width (j+2) (by omega),
    byte_window bs off width (j+3) hj,Nat.add_assoc]

theorem echeck_word (bs : List U8) : LPt_LPl.Echeck.word bs=word bs 0 := by
  simp only [LPt_LPl.Echeck.word,LPt_LPl.Echeck.byte,word,byte,
    Nat.zero_add,Nat.mul_add]
  omega

theorem checked (compact : Slice U8) (len : compact.val.length=464)
    (success : _root_.LPt_External.compact.check_values compact=ok (.Ok ())) :
    CompactCanonical compact.val := by
  obtain ⟨out,trace⟩ := LPt_LPl.Check.total compact.val
  have call := LPt_LPl.Check.native_result compact out trace
  have none : out=none := by
    cases out <;> simp_all
  subst out
  have hit := LPt_LPl.Scan.first_error _ _ _ trace
  have good := (LPt_LPl_A.firstBad_none _ _).mp hit.symm
  intro row hr limb hl
  have count : row<compact.val.length/16 := by omega
  have row_good := good row count
  have chunk : LPt_LPl.Check.chunk ((compact.val.drop (16*row)).take 16)=true := by
    change (!LPt_LPl.Check.chunk _)=false at row_good
    cases h : LPt_LPl.Check.chunk ((compact.val.drop (16*row)).take 16) <;> simp_all
  have limbs := List.all_eq_true.mp chunk
  have bound := limbs limb (List.mem_range.mpr hl)
  change decide (LPt_LPl.Echeck.word _ < 2147483647)=true at bound
  have bound' := of_decide_eq_true bound
  rw [echeck_word,word_window _ (4*limb) 4 0 (by omega),Nat.add_zero,
    word_window _ (16*row) 16 (4*limb) (by omega)] at bound'
  exact bound'

#print axioms byte_window
#print axioms word_window
#print axioms echeck_word
#print axioms checked
end AspisR1.LPt_LPs_CheckDomain

LPt_LPl_A_Expand.source:
import LPt_LPl_Kit_FunsExternal
import LPt_LPl_A_Map
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open LPt_LPl_Kit_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl_A.Expand
-- Native stage: compact::LPt_LPl_A_compact::LPt_LPl_A_expand_stage (K004), 29-stage index K006.
def byte (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) : U8 :=
  if i%32 < 16 then bs[i/32*16+i%32]?.getD 0#u8 else 0#u8
def loop (bs : List U8) (size : Nat) : List U8 := LPt_LPl_A.build (byte bs) size
theorem loop_eq_map (bs : List U8) (size : Nat) :
    loop bs size = (List.range size).map (byte bs) := LPt_LPl_A.build_map _ _
theorem loop_eq_fold (bs : List U8) (size : Nat) :
    loop bs size = (List.range size).foldl (fun xs i => xs ++ [byte bs i]) [] :=
  LPt_LPl_A.build_fold _ _
theorem shipped_leaf_model (bs out : Slice U8) :
    LPt_External.compact.expand_values bs out = (do
      if bs.val.length % 16 != 0 then ok (.Err .Length, out)
      else
        let size ← Slice.len bs * 2#usize
        if Slice.len out != size then ok (.Err .Length, out)
        else
          let values := loop bs.val out.val.length
          dite (values.length ≤ Usize.max)
            (fun h => ok (.Ok (), (⟨values,h⟩ : Slice U8)))
            (fun _ => fail .panic)) := by
  simp only [loop_eq_map]
  rfl
#print axioms loop_eq_map
#print axioms loop_eq_fold
#print axioms shipped_leaf_model
end LPt_LPl_A.Expand

LPt_LPl_A_ExpansionLaws.source:
import LPt_LPl_A_Expand
import LPt_LPl_A_StageLaws
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl_A.Expand

theorem loop_length (bs : List U8) (n : Nat) : (loop bs n).length = n :=
  LPt_LPl_A.build_length _ _

theorem low_half (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : i%32 < 16) :
    byte bs i = bs[i/32*16+i%32]?.getD 0#u8 := by
  exact if_pos h

theorem high_half (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) (h : ¬ i%32 < 16) :
    byte bs i = 0#u8 := by
  exact if_neg h

-- The byte bound is the actual frozen y1 target size, not a new input premise.
theorem y1_loop_fold (bs : List U8) :
    loop bs (29*32) = (List.range (29*32)).foldl
      (fun xs i => xs ++ [byte bs i]) [] := loop_eq_fold _ _

#print axioms loop_length
#print axioms low_half
#print axioms high_half
#print axioms y1_loop_fold
end LPt_LPl_A.Expand

import LPt_LPl_A_ExpansionLaws
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl_C.Expand
/-- Row/lane formulas for all caller rows, not a checked finite fixture. -/
theorem row_low (bs : List U8) (row lane : Nat) (lo : lane < 16) :
    LPt_LPl_A.Expand.byte bs (32*row+lane) = bs[16*row+lane]?.getD 0#u8 := by
  have div : (32*row+lane)/32 = row := by omega
  have mod : (32*row+lane)%32 = lane := by omega
  simp only [LPt_LPl_A.Expand.byte, mod, if_pos lo, div]
  congr 2 <;> omega
theorem row_high (bs : List U8) (row lane : Nat) (lo : 16 ≤ lane) (hi : lane < 32) :
    LPt_LPl_A.Expand.byte bs (32*row+lane) = 0#u8 := by
  have mod : (32*row+lane)%32 = lane := by omega
  simp only [LPt_LPl_A.Expand.byte, mod, if_neg (by omega : ¬ lane < 16)]
theorem caller_rows (bs : List U8) :
    (LPt_LPl_A.Expand.loop bs (29*32)).length = 928 := LPt_LPl_A.Expand.loop_length _ _
#print axioms row_low
#print axioms row_high
#print axioms caller_rows
end LPt_LPl_C.Expand

LPt_LPl_ExpandFrame.source:
import LPt_LPl_C_ExpandRows
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPt_LPl_Kit_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl.Expand
/-- Pointwise interpretation of exactly one native16→32 slice write, including
    both live frames. These are the four inherited local native frame classes. -/
def step (bs before : List U8) (row j : Nat) : U8 :=
  if 32*row ≤ j ∧ j < 32*row+32 then
    if j < 32*row+16 then bs[16*row+(j-32*row)]?.getD 0#u8 else 0#u8
  else before[j]?.getD 0#u8

/-- Native pointer offsets become the model's global byte index, without
    reducing a whole concrete928/3712-byte output. -/
theorem inside (bs before : List U8) (row j : Nat)
    (lo : 32*row ≤ j) (hi : j<32*row+32) :
    step bs before row j = LPt_LPl_A.Expand.byte bs j := by
  have div : j/32=row := by omega
  have mod : j%32=j-32*row := by omega
  unfold step LPt_LPl_A.Expand.byte
  rw [if_pos ⟨lo,hi⟩,div,mod]
  by_cases h : j < 32*row+16
  · rw [if_pos h,if_pos (by omega : j-32*row < 16)]
    congr 2 <;> omega
  · simp only [if_neg h,if_neg (by omega : ¬ j-32*row < 16)]

theorem outside (bs before : List U8) (row j : Nat)
    (frame : j<32*row ∨ 32*row+32≤j) :
    step bs before row j = before[j]?.getD 0#u8 := by
  unfold step; rw [if_neg (by omega)]

/-- Source write relation: no assumed whole-output equality. The exact local
    native/frame gates instantiate each byte observation of a reached window. -/
structure Write (bs before after : List U8) (row : Nat) : Prop where
  length : after.length=before.length
  bytes : ∀ j, j<before.length → after[j]?.getD 0#u8=step bs before row j

inductive Trace (bs initial : List U8) : Nat → List U8 → Prop where
  | start : Trace bs initial 0 initial
  | next (row : Nat) (before after : List U8) (rest : Trace bs initial row before)
      (write : Write bs before after row) : Trace bs initial (row+1) after

theorem length (bs initial after : List U8) (n : Nat) (h : Trace bs initial n after) :
    after.length=initial.length := by
  induction h with
  | start => rfl
  | next row before after rest write ih => exact write.length.trans ih

theorem invariant (bs initial after : List U8) (n : Nat) (h : Trace bs initial n after) :
    ∀ j, j < initial.length → after[j]?.getD 0#u8 =
      if j<32*n then LPt_LPl_A.Expand.byte bs j else initial[j]?.getD 0#u8 := by
  induction h with
  | start => intro j hj; simp
  | next row before after rest write ih =>
    intro j hj
    have size := length bs initial before row rest
    rw [write.bytes j (by omega)]
    by_cases low : j<32*row
    · rw [outside bs before row j (Or.inl low),ih j hj,if_pos low,if_pos (by omega)]
    · by_cases hi : j<32*row+32
      · rw [inside bs before row j (by omega) hi,if_pos (by omega)]
      · rw [outside bs before row j (Or.inr (by omega)),ih j hj,if_neg low,if_neg (by omega)]

#print axioms inside
#print axioms outside
#print axioms length
#print axioms invariant
end LPt_LPl.Expand

LPt_LPl_ExpandOutput.source:
import LPt_LPl_ExpandFrame
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPt_LPl_Kit_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl.Expand

def update (bs before : List U8) (row : Nat) : List U8 :=
  (List.range before.length).map (step bs before row)

theorem update_write (bs before : List U8) (row : Nat) :
    Write bs before (update bs before row) row := by
  constructor
  · simp only [update,List.length_map,List.length_range]
  · intro j hj; simp [update,hj]

theorem total (bs initial : List U8) (n : Nat) : ∃ after, Trace bs initial n after := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨initial,.start⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨before,h⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨update bs before n,.next n before (update bs before n) h (update_write bs before n)⟩

theorem output (bs initial after : List U8) (n : Nat)
    (trace : Trace bs initial n after) (done : 32*n=initial.length) :
    after=LPt_LPl_A.Expand.loop bs initial.length := by
  have hlen := length bs initial after n trace
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · rw [hlen,LPt_LPl_A.Expand.loop_length]
  · intro j hj hk
    have valid : j < initial.length := by omega
    have observed := invariant bs initial after n trace j valid
    rw [if_pos (by omega)] at observed
    have model : (LPt_LPl_A.Expand.loop bs initial.length)[j] = LPt_LPl_A.Expand.byte bs j := by
      simp only [LPt_LPl_A.Expand.loop_eq_map,List.getElem_map,List.getElem_range]
    rw [model]
    simpa only [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj,Option.getD_some] using observed

theorem unique (bs initial a b : List U8) (n : Nat)
    (done : 32*n=initial.length) (left : Trace bs initial n a) (right : Trace bs initial n b) : a=b :=
  (output bs initial a n left done).trans (output bs initial b n right done).symm

#print axioms update_write
#print axioms total
#print axioms output
#print axioms unique
end LPt_LPl.Expand

LPt_LPl_ExpandResult.source:
import LPt_LPl_ExpandOutput
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPt_LPl_Kit_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPl.Expand

theorem double (bs : Slice U8) (bound : bs.val.length≤1856) :
    ∃ z : Usize, Slice.len bs * 2#usize = ok z ∧ z.val=2*bs.val.length := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.mul_spec
    (x:=Slice.len bs) (y:=2#usize) (by scalar_tac))
  exact ⟨z,hz,by scalar_tac⟩

/-- Complete native owned output carrier on the aligned/length-matched source
    branch. Source guard gates separately cover every early Length error. -/
theorem native_result (bs before after : Slice U8)
    (bound : bs.val.length≤1856) (aligned : bs.val.length%16=0)
    (shape : before.val.length=2*bs.val.length)
    (trace : Trace bs.val before.val (bs.val.length/16) after.val) :
    LPt_External.compact.expand_values bs before = ok (.Ok (),after) := by
  have done : 32*(bs.val.length/16)=before.val.length := by omega
  have hafter := output bs.val before.val after.val _ trace done
  obtain ⟨z,mul,hz⟩ := double bs bound
  have z_eq : z=Slice.len before := by scalar_tac
  have values : LPt_LPl_A.Expand.loop bs.val before.val.length=after.val := hafter.symm
  rw [LPt_LPl_A.Expand.shipped_leaf_model]
  simp only [aligned,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,mul,bind_tc_ok,z_eq,
    bne_self_eq_false]
  rw [values]
  simp [bind_tc_ok,dif_pos after.property]

/-- Error preserves the SAME mutable output carrier on all bounded bad lengths. -/
theorem length_error (bs before : Slice U8)
    (bound : bs.val.length≤1856)
    (bad : bs.val.length%16≠0 ∨ before.val.length≠2*bs.val.length) :
    LPt_External.compact.expand_values bs before = ok (.Err .Length,before) := by
  rw [LPt_LPl_A.Expand.shipped_leaf_model]
  by_cases aligned : bs.val.length%16=0
  · have mismatch : before.val.length≠2*bs.val.length := by
      rcases bad with h|h
      · exact False.elim (h aligned)
      · exact h
    obtain ⟨z,mul,hz⟩ := double bs bound
    have neq : Slice.len before≠z := by scalar_tac
    simp only [aligned,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,mul,bind_tc_ok]
    simp [bind_tc_ok,Slice.len,hz,mismatch]
  · simp [aligned]

#print axioms double
#print axioms native_result
#print axioms length_error
end LPt_LPl.Expand

LPt_LPn_ExpandSpatial.source:
import LPt_LPl_ExpandResult
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPt_LPl_Kit_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPn.Expand

/-- Preserve the observed byte's relation to one32-byte write window while
    compressing the untouched prefix/suffix. No global row enumeration. -/
def coordinate (row j : Nat) : Nat :=
  if j < 32*row then 0 else if j < 32*row+32 then 32+(j-32*row) else 64

/-- The scalar observation checked by LPn_K001 at the interior aligned slot.
    Source and overwritten bytes are arbitrary, with no canonicality test. -/
def localByte (source : Nat → U8) (old : U8) (q : Nat) : U8 :=
  if 32 ≤ q ∧ q < 48 then source (q-32)
  else if 48 ≤ q ∧ q < 64 then 0#u8 else old

theorem coordinate_bound (row j : Nat) : coordinate row j < 96 := by
  unfold coordinate
  split <;> try omega
  split <;> omega

/-- Spatial transport of the native single-window observation. The arbitrary
    row is unbounded; the116-row caller is an immediate specialization. -/
theorem local_global (bs before : List U8) (row j : Nat) :
    localByte (fun lane => bs[16*row+lane]?.getD 0#u8)
      (before[j]?.getD 0#u8) (coordinate row j) = LPt_LPl.Expand.step bs before row j := by
  by_cases left : j < 32*row
  · simp [coordinate,left,localByte,LPt_LPl.Expand.step,show ¬ 32*row ≤ j by omega]
  · by_cases inside : j < 32*row+32
    · by_cases low : j < 32*row+16
      · have h1 : 32 ≤ 32+(j-32*row) ∧ 32+(j-32*row)<48 := by omega
        simp only [coordinate,if_neg left,if_pos inside,localByte,if_pos h1,
          Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,LPt_LPl.Expand.step,if_pos (show 32*row≤j ∧ j<32*row+32 by omega),if_pos low]
      · have h1 : ¬ (32 ≤ 32+(j-32*row) ∧ 32+(j-32*row)<48) := by omega
        have h2 : 48 ≤ 32+(j-32*row) ∧ 32+(j-32*row)<64 := by omega
        simp only [coordinate,if_neg left,if_pos inside,localByte,if_neg h1,if_pos h2,
          LPt_LPl.Expand.step,if_pos (show 32*row≤j ∧ j<32*row+32 by omega),if_neg low]
    · simp [coordinate,left,inside,localByte,LPt_LPl.Expand.step]

/-- A local native observation for each selected byte gives the inherited
    Write relation on the SAME before/after carrier; no full output equality. -/
theorem write_of_observations (bs before after : List U8) (row : Nat)
    (size : after.length=before.length)
    (observed : ∀ j, j<before.length → after[j]?.getD 0#u8 =
      localByte (fun lane => bs[16*row+lane]?.getD 0#u8)
        (before[j]?.getD 0#u8) (coordinate row j)) :
    LPt_LPl.Expand.Write bs before after row := by
  refine ⟨size,?_⟩
  intro j hj
  exact (observed j hj).trans (local_global bs before row j)

theorem windows_disjoint (row other j : Nat) (different : row≠other)
    (lo : 32*row≤j) (hi : j<32*row+32) :
    j<32*other ∨ 32*other+32≤j := by omega

/-- K012's chunks_exact_mut offsets and exhaustion imply coverage for every
    valid caller size, including empty and the maximal116-row size. -/
theorem iterator_partition (n row lane : Nat) (bound : n≤1856)
    (aligned : n%16=0) (reached : row<n/16) (within : lane<32) :
    row<116 ∧ 32*row+lane<2*n ∧ 16*row+lane/2<n ∧
      32*(n/16)=2*n := by omega

#print axioms coordinate_bound
#print axioms local_global
#print axioms write_of_observations
#print axioms windows_disjoint
#print axioms iterator_partition
end LPt_LPn.Expand

LPt_LPn_ExpandTrace.source:
import LPt_LPn_ExpandSpatial
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPt_LPl_Kit_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPt_LPn.Expand

/-- The reached source loop: exactly one local observation per selected byte
    and one next-row event. K012 supplies actual window identity/count/end;
    K001 supplies these byte observations via local_global. -/
inductive NativeTrace (bs initial : List U8) : Nat → List U8 → Prop where
  | start : NativeTrace bs initial 0 initial
  | next (row : Nat) (before after : List U8)
      (rest : NativeTrace bs initial row before)
      (size : after.length=before.length)
      (observed : ∀ j, j<before.length → after[j]?.getD 0#u8 =
        localByte (fun lane => bs[16*row+lane]?.getD 0#u8)
          (before[j]?.getD 0#u8) (coordinate row j)) :
      NativeTrace bs initial (row+1) after

theorem to_inherited (bs initial after : List U8) (n : Nat)
    (trace : NativeTrace bs initial n after) : LPt_LPl.Expand.Trace bs initial n after := by
  induction trace with
  | start => exact .start
  | next row before after rest size observed ih =>
    exact .next row before after ih (write_of_observations bs before after row size observed)

theorem of_inherited (bs initial after : List U8) (n : Nat)
    (trace : LPt_LPl.Expand.Trace bs initial n after) : NativeTrace bs initial n after := by
  induction trace with
  | start => exact .start
  | next row before after rest write ih =>
    apply NativeTrace.next row before after ih write.length
    intro j hj
    exact (write.bytes j hj).trans (local_global bs before row j).symm

theorem total (bs initial : List U8) (n : Nat) :
    ∃ after, NativeTrace bs initial n after := by
  obtain ⟨after,trace⟩ := LPt_LPl.Expand.total bs initial n
  exact ⟨after,of_inherited bs initial after n trace⟩

theorem native_result (bs before after : Slice U8)
    (bound : bs.val.length≤1856) (aligned : bs.val.length%16=0)
    (shape : before.val.length=2*bs.val.length)
    (trace : NativeTrace bs.val before.val (bs.val.length/16) after.val) :
    LPt_External.compact.expand_values bs before = ok (.Ok (),after) :=
  LPt_LPl.Expand.native_result bs before after bound aligned shape
    (to_inherited _ _ _ _ trace)

theorem unique (bs initial a b : List U8) (n : Nat)
    (done : 32*n=initial.length)
    (left : NativeTrace bs initial n a) (right : NativeTrace bs initial n b) : a=b :=
  LPt_LPl.Expand.unique bs initial a b n done
    (to_inherited _ _ _ _ left) (to_inherited _ _ _ _ right)

theorem length_error (bs before : Slice U8) (bound : bs.val.length≤1856)
    (bad : bs.val.length%16≠0 ∨ before.val.length≠2*bs.val.length) :
    LPt_External.compact.expand_values bs before = ok (.Err .Length,before) :=
  LPt_LPl.Expand.length_error bs before bound bad

#print axioms to_inherited
#print axioms of_inherited
#print axioms total
#print axioms native_result
#print axioms unique
#print axioms length_error
end LPt_LPn.Expand

import LPt_LPs_CheckDomain
import LPt_LPn_ExpandTrace
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPt_LPs_ExpandDomain
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPt_LPs_CheckDomain

def Expanded (compact y1 : List U8) : Prop := ∀ row, row<29 → ∀ lane, lane<32 →
  byte y1 (32*row+lane)=if lane<16 then byte compact (16*row+lane) else 0

theorem expanded (compact before y1 : Slice U8)
    (len : compact.val.length=464) (size : before.val.length=928)
    (trace : LPt_LPn.Expand.NativeTrace compact.val before.val 29 y1.val) :
    y1.val.length=928 ∧ Expanded compact.val y1.val ∧
    _root_.LPt_External.compact.expand_values compact before=ok (.Ok (),y1) := by
  have inherited := LPt_LPn.Expand.to_inherited _ _ _ _ trace
  have length := LPt_LPl.Expand.length _ _ _ _ inherited
  refine ⟨length.trans size,?_,?_⟩
  · intro row hr lane hl
    have observed := LPt_LPl.Expand.invariant _ _ _ _ inherited (32*row+lane) (by omega)
    rw [if_pos (by omega)] at observed
    have div : (32*row+lane)/32=row := by omega
    have mod : (32*row+lane)%32=lane := by omega
    simp only [LPt_LPl_A.Expand.byte,div,mod] at observed
    unfold byte
    rw [observed]
    split <;> (try simp only [Nat.mul_comm]) <;> rfl
  · apply LPt_LPn.Expand.native_result compact before y1 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
    simpa only [len] using trace

#print axioms expanded
end AspisR1.LPt_LPs_ExpandDomain

import LPi_RawAssociation
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPi_RawValues
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Q := FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Q

def Canon (x : Q) : Prop :=
  x.val[0]!.val ≤ 2147483646 ∧ x.val[1]!.val ≤ 2147483646 ∧
  x.val[2]!.val ≤ 2147483646 ∧ x.val[3]!.val ≤ 2147483646

def spec (x y : Q) : Nat × Nat × Nat × Nat :=
  let a := x.val[0]!.val; let b := x.val[1]!.val
  let c := x.val[2]!.val; let d := x.val[3]!.val
  let e := y.val[0]!.val; let f := y.val[1]!.val
  let g := y.val[2]!.val; let h := y.val[3]!.val
  (R22RawQmProductResidues.rawC0 a b c d e f g h,
   R22RawQmProductResidues.rawC1 a b c d e f g h,
   R22RawQmProductResidues.rawC2 a b c d e f g h,
   R22RawQmProductResidues.rawC3 a b c d e f g h)

/-- Total concrete FIo raw call, with the existing repaired four-coordinate law.
No independently selected raw return or no-wrap hypothesis is supplied. -/
theorem source (x y : Q) (hx : Canon x) (hy : Canon y) : ∃ r0 r1 r2 r3 : U64,
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Q.raw x y = ok (Array.make 4#usize [r0,r1,r2,r3]) ∧
    (r0.val,r1.val,r2.val,r3.val) = spec x y := by
  obtain ⟨out,run⟩ := AspisR1S5QRawSourceTotality.qraw_total_of_canonical_limbs x y
    hx.1 hx.2.1 hx.2.2.1 hx.2.2.2 hy.1 hy.2.1 hy.2.2.1 hy.2.2.2
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,r0,r1,r2,r3,shape,v0,v1,v2,v3,ea,eb,ec,ed,ee,ef,eg,eh⟩ :=
    AspisR1QRawActualC0V2.actual_raw_coefficients_of_input_bounds_v2 x y out run
      hx.1 hx.2.1 hx.2.2.1 hx.2.2.2 hy.1 hy.2.1 hy.2.2.1 hy.2.2.2
  subst a; subst b; subst c; subst d; subst e; subst f; subst g; subst h
  refine ⟨r0,r1,r2,r3,?_,Prod.ext v0 (Prod.ext v1 (Prod.ext v2 v3))⟩
  rw [LPi_RawAssociation.source_eq,run,shape]

#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPi_RawValues

import LPf_ReductionWord
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPf_DotWordStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def bound : Nat := 10737418238

theorem fold_bound (raw : U64) : (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold raw).val ≤ bound := by
  rw [LPf_ReductionWord.fold_value]
  have h : raw.val < 18446744073709551616 := by scalar_tac
  unfold LPe_MersenneReduction.fold bound
  omega

/-- Actual per-coordinate wrapping addition is ordinary addition for every
reached count below the public4096 term cap, on arbitrary raw u64 inputs. -/
theorem value (sum raw : U64) (n : Nat) (hn : n < 4096)
    (hs : sum.val ≤ n*bound) :
    (U64.wrapping_add sum (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold raw)).val =
      sum.val + (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold raw).val ∧
    (U64.wrapping_add sum (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold raw)).val ≤ (n+1)*bound := by
  have hf := fold_bound raw
  have small : sum.val + (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold raw).val < UScalar.size .U64 := by
    norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits]
    unfold bound at *
    omega
  rw [U64.wrapping_add_val_eq,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt small]
  constructor
  · rfl
  · simpa only [Nat.add_mul,Nat.one_mul] using Nat.add_le_add hs hf

/-- Mathematical reduction of that exact word update: each raw representative
contributes its residue, including nonzero and maximal raw words. -/
theorem reduced (sum raw : U64) (n : Nat) (hn : n < 4096)
    (hs : sum.val ≤ n*bound) : ∃ z,
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce
      (U64.wrapping_add sum (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold raw)) = ok z ∧
    z.val = (sum.val + raw.val) % 2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨z,run,v,c⟩ := LPf_ReductionWord.native_reduce
    (U64.wrapping_add sum (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold raw))
  refine ⟨z,run,?_,c⟩
  rw [(value sum raw n hn hs).1,LPf_ReductionWord.fold_value] at v
  rw [Nat.add_mod,LPe_MersenneReduction.fold_mod] at v
  rw [Nat.add_mod]
  exact v

#print axioms fold_bound
#print axioms value
#print axioms reduced
end AspisR1.LPf_DotWordStep

    (hi : i.val < 4)
    (advance : core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize
      {start:=i,«end»:=4#usize} = ok (some i,{start:=next,«end»:=4#usize}))
    (oldRead : Array.index_usize self.sums i = ok before)
    (rawRead : Array.index_usize raw i = ok term) :
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push_loop.body raw
      {start:=i,«end»:=4#usize} self =
      ok (.cont ({start:=next,«end»:=4#usize},
        ⟨self.sums.set i (U64.wrapping_add before (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold term))⟩)) := by
  obtain ⟨updated,write,same⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec self.sums i
      (U64.wrapping_add before (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold term)) (by simpa using hi))
  subst updated
  unfold FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push_loop.body
  rw [advance,bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,oldRead,rawRead,bind_tc_ok,
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.P,lift]
  change (do
    let a ← Array.update self.sums i (U64.wrapping_add before (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold term))
    ok (.cont ({start:=next,«end»:=4#usize},⟨a⟩) :
      ControlFlow (core.ops.range.Range Usize × Dot) Dot)) = _
  rw [write,bind_tc_ok]

import LPf_DotPushStep
import JGo_TX2_LoopChain
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPf_DotPushFour
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
abbrev Dot := FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot
abbrev Raw := Array U64 4#usize
def update (a r : U64) : U64 := U64.wrapping_add a (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold r)

theorem source (a b c d r0 r1 r2 r3 : U64) :
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push_loop {start:=0#usize,«end»:=4#usize}
      ⟨Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]⟩ (Array.make 4#usize [r0,r1,r2,r3]) =
      ok ⟨Array.make 4#usize [update a r0,update b r1,update c r2,update d r3]⟩ := by
  let raw : Raw := Array.make 4#usize [r0,r1,r2,r3]
  let s0 : Dot := ⟨Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]⟩
  let s1 : Dot := ⟨Array.make 4#usize [update a r0,b,c,d]⟩
  let s2 : Dot := ⟨Array.make 4#usize [update a r0,update b r1,c,d]⟩
  let s3 : Dot := ⟨Array.make 4#usize [update a r0,update b r1,update c r2,d]⟩
  let s4 : Dot := ⟨Array.make 4#usize [update a r0,update b r1,update c r2,update d r3]⟩
  have t0 : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push_loop.body raw
      {start:=0#usize,«end»:=4#usize} s0 = ok (.cont ({start:=1#usize,«end»:=4#usize},s1)) := by
    exact LPf_DotPushStep.source s0 raw 0#usize 1#usize a r0 (by decide)
      (JGo_TX2_Range.next 0#usize 4#usize 1#usize (by decide) (by decide)) rfl rfl
  have t1 : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push_loop.body raw
      {start:=1#usize,«end»:=4#usize} s1 = ok (.cont ({start:=2#usize,«end»:=4#usize},s2)) := by
    exact LPf_DotPushStep.source s1 raw 1#usize 2#usize b r1 (by decide)
      (JGo_TX2_Range.next 1#usize 4#usize 2#usize (by decide) (by decide)) rfl rfl
  have t2 : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push_loop.body raw
      {start:=2#usize,«end»:=4#usize} s2 = ok (.cont ({start:=3#usize,«end»:=4#usize},s3)) := by
    exact LPf_DotPushStep.source s2 raw 2#usize 3#usize c r2 (by decide)
      (JGo_TX2_Range.next 2#usize 4#usize 3#usize (by decide) (by decide)) rfl rfl
  have t3 : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push_loop.body raw
      {start:=3#usize,«end»:=4#usize} s3 = ok (.cont ({start:=4#usize,«end»:=4#usize},s4)) := by
    exact LPf_DotPushStep.source s3 raw 3#usize 4#usize d r3 (by decide)
      (JGo_TX2_Range.next 3#usize 4#usize 4#usize (by decide) (by decide)) rfl rfl
  have t4 : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push_loop.body raw
      {start:=4#usize,«end»:=4#usize} s4 = ok (.done s4) := by
    unfold FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push_loop.body
    rw [OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_done _ (by decide),bind_tc_ok]
    rfl
  change loop (fun state : core.ops.range.Range Usize × Dot =>
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push_loop.body raw state.1 state.2)
    ({start:=0#usize,«end»:=4#usize},s0) = ok s4
  let states : Nat → core.ops.range.Range Usize × Dot
    | 0 => ({start:=0#usize,«end»:=4#usize},s0)
    | 1 => ({start:=1#usize,«end»:=4#usize},s1)
    | 2 => ({start:=2#usize,«end»:=4#usize},s2)
    | 3 => ({start:=3#usize,«end»:=4#usize},s3)
    | _ => ({start:=4#usize,«end»:=4#usize},s4)
  apply JGo_TX2_LoopChain.source _ states 4 s4
  · intro i hi
    have cases : i=0 ∨ i=1 ∨ i=2 ∨ i=3 := by omega
    rcases cases with h | h | h | h
    · subst i; exact t0
    · subst i; exact t1
    · subst i; exact t2
    · subst i; exact t3
  · exact t4

end AspisR1.LPf_DotPushFour

import LPf_ReductionWord
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPf_ArrayFour
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

theorem list_shape {α : Type} (xs : List α) (h : xs.length = 4) :
    ∃ a b c d, xs = [a,b,c,d] := by
  rcases xs with _ | ⟨a,xs⟩
  · simp at h
  rcases xs with _ | ⟨b,xs⟩
  · simp at h
  rcases xs with _ | ⟨c,xs⟩
  · simp at h
  rcases xs with _ | ⟨d,xs⟩
  · simp at h
  have hz : xs.length = 0 := by
    simp only [List.length_cons] at h
    omega
  cases xs with
  | nil => exact ⟨a,b,c,d,rfl⟩
  | cons e rest => simp at hz

theorem shape {α : Type} (xs : Array α 4#usize) :
    ∃ a b c d, xs = Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d] := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,d,h⟩ := list_shape xs.val (by simpa using xs.property)
  refine ⟨a,b,c,d,?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact h

#print axioms shape
end AspisR1.LPf_ArrayFour

    ∃ out, FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.push self value scalar=ok (.Ok (),out) ∧

Dot::finish body. The four input words are independent and unrestricted. -/
theorem source (a b c d : U64) : ∃ z0 z1 z2 z3,
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.finish
      ⟨Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]⟩ = ok (Array.make 4#usize [z0,z1,z2,z3]) ∧
    z0.val = a.val % 2147483647 ∧ z1.val = b.val % 2147483647 ∧
    z2.val = c.val % 2147483647 ∧ z3.val = d.val % 2147483647 ∧
    z0.val < 2147483647 ∧ z1.val < 2147483647 ∧
    z2.val < 2147483647 ∧ z3.val < 2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨z0,h0,v0,c0⟩ := LPf_ReductionWord.native_reduce a
  obtain ⟨z1,h1,v1,c1⟩ := LPf_ReductionWord.native_reduce b
  obtain ⟨z2,h2,v2,c2⟩ := LPf_ReductionWord.native_reduce c
  obtain ⟨z3,h3,v3,c3⟩ := LPf_ReductionWord.native_reduce d
  refine ⟨z0,z1,z2,z3,?_,v0,v1,v2,v3,c0,c1,c2,c3⟩
  have i0 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 0#usize = ok a := rfl
  have i1 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 1#usize = ok b := rfl
  have i2 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 2#usize = ok c := rfl
  have i3 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 3#usize = ok d := rfl
  simp only [FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.finish,i0,i1,i2,i3,

  have i1 (w x y z : U32) : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [w,x,y,z]) 1#usize = ok x := rfl
  have i2 (w x y z : U32) : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [w,x,y,z]) 2#usize = ok y := rfl
  have i3 (w x y z : U32) : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [w,x,y,z]) 3#usize = ok z := rfl

import LPi_PublicPush
import LPf_PublicDotAllStates
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPm_PublicState
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues
abbrev Dot := FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot
abbrev Raw := Array U64 4#usize

def update (s : Dot) (r : Raw) : Dot :=
  ⟨Array.make 4#usize [
    LPf_DotPushFour.update s.sums.val[0]! r.val[0]!,
    LPf_DotPushFour.update s.sums.val[1]! r.val[1]!,
    LPf_DotPushFour.update s.sums.val[2]! r.val[2]!,
    LPf_DotPushFour.update s.sums.val[3]! r.val[3]!]⟩

def values (r : Raw) : Nat×Nat×Nat×Nat :=
  (r.val[0]!.val,r.val[1]!.val,r.val[2]!.val,r.val[3]!.val)

/-- Strengthen inherited totality to the SAME raw values and SAME four
updated state words. The raw-call observation is derived, never supplied. -/
theorem private_source (s : Dot) (a b : LPi_RawValues.Q)
    (ha : LPi_RawValues.Canon a) (hb : LPi_RawValues.Canon b) :
    ∃ r : Raw, FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Q.raw a b=ok r ∧
      values r=LPi_RawValues.spec a b ∧
      FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push s a b=ok (update s r) := by
  obtain ⟨s0,s1,s2,s3,shape⟩ := LPf_ArrayFour.shape s.sums
  obtain ⟨r0,r1,r2,r3,raw,meaning⟩ := LPi_RawValues.source a b ha hb
  have same : s=⟨Array.make 4#usize [s0,s1,s2,s3]⟩ := by
    cases s
    exact congrArg FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.mk shape
  subst s
  refine ⟨Array.make 4#usize [r0,r1,r2,r3],raw,meaning,?_⟩
  simpa only [update,Array.make,List.getElem!_cons_zero,List.getElem!_cons_succ] using
    LPf_DotPushCut.source a b s0 s1 s2 s3 r0 r1 r2 r3 raw

/-- Public push with both actual half-products and complete state updates.
Canonicality and count are the existing public caller domain. -/
theorem source (s : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot) (value : NE) (scalar : NQ)
    (hv : canonE value) (hq : canonQ scalar) (count : s.count.val<4096) :
    ∃ (lo hi : Raw) (out : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot),
      FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.push s value scalar=ok (.Ok (),out) ∧
      values lo=LPi_RawValues.spec (LPi_CheckedInputs.q value.c0) (LPi_CheckedInputs.q scalar) ∧
      values hi=LPi_RawValues.spec (LPi_CheckedInputs.q value.c1) (LPi_CheckedInputs.q scalar) ∧
      out.c0=update s.c0 lo ∧ out.c1=update s.c1 hi ∧ out.count.val=s.count.val+1 := by
  have ca := LPi_CheckedInputs.canonical value.c0 hv.1
  have cb := LPi_CheckedInputs.canonical value.c1 hv.2
  have cq := LPi_CheckedInputs.canonical scalar hq
  obtain ⟨lo,_,lov,left⟩ := private_source s.c0 _ _ ca cq
  obtain ⟨hi,_,hiv,right⟩ := private_source s.c1 _ _ cb cq
  have below : ¬s.count ≥ FIo_Native.fast_pairing.MAX_TERMS := by
    simp only [FIo_Native.fast_pairing.MAX_TERMS]
    scalar_tac
  have i0 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 2#usize
      [LPi_CheckedInputs.q value.c0,LPi_CheckedInputs.q value.c1]) 0#usize =
      ok (LPi_CheckedInputs.q value.c0) := rfl
  have i1 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 2#usize
      [LPi_CheckedInputs.q value.c0,LPi_CheckedInputs.q value.c1]) 1#usize =
      ok (LPi_CheckedInputs.q value.c1) := rfl
  let out : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot :=
    ⟨update s.c0 lo,update s.c1 hi,Usize.wrapping_add s.count 1#usize⟩
  have call : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.push s value scalar=ok (.Ok (),out) := by
    simp only [FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.push,if_neg below,
      LPi_CheckedInputs.from_wide,bind_tc_ok,LPi_CheckedInputs.checked scalar hq,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,i0,i1,left,right,lift]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨other,otherCall,otherCount⟩ := LPi_PublicPush.source s value scalar hv hq count
  have unique : out=other := congrArg Prod.snd (Result.ok.inj (call.symm.trans otherCall))
  exact ⟨lo,hi,out,call,lov,hiv,rfl,rfl,by rw [unique]; exact otherCount⟩

#print axioms private_source
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPm_PublicState

/-- The retained cohort uses THIS same raw operation; an unrelated raw
product with the same name is never substituted. -/
theorem raw_eq (a b : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Q) :
    AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.QRaw a b =
      FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Q.raw a b := by
  change AspisR1CanonicalQRawUnified.canonical.Q.raw a b = _
  exact (LPi_RawAssociation.source_eq a b).symm

theorem state_fields (s : Native) :
    (statePort s).c0.sums=s.c0.sums ∧ (statePort s).c1.sums=s.c1.sums ∧
      (statePort s).count=s.count := ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

#check AspisR1FinishDotSourceABI.finishFromPush_total
