JGi_PushTotality.source:
import AspisR1EbyKPushConcreteCheckedQV1
import EbyKPushDotBackend
import EbyKPushCheckedScalarCanonical
import EbyKPowerValueCanonicalToPushV5
import S5QRaw.EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdateV1
import JGi_QRawSourceForwardTotalityV1
import DotPushSourceResidues

set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error

namespace AspisR1S5EbyKPushTotalityV1

open AspisR1EbyKPushExplicitOpsV1

abbrev QRaw := AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.QRaw
abbrev Q := AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.PushQ
abbrev Wide := AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.PushWide
abbrev Qm := AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.PushQm
abbrev State := AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.PushState
abbrev Dot := AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.PushDot

/-- The selected Q.raw function is outer-total on two four-word arrays when
all eight words are canonical. -/
theorem qraw_arrays_total (a b : Q)
    (ha0 : a.val[0]!.val ≤ 2^31-2) (ha1 : a.val[1]!.val ≤ 2^31-2)
    (ha2 : a.val[2]!.val ≤ 2^31-2) (ha3 : a.val[3]!.val ≤ 2^31-2)
    (hb0 : b.val[0]!.val ≤ 2^31-2) (hb1 : b.val[1]!.val ≤ 2^31-2)
    (hb2 : b.val[2]!.val ≤ 2^31-2) (hb3 : b.val[3]!.val ≤ 2^31-2) :
    ∃ raw : Array U64 4#usize, QRaw a b = .ok raw := by
  exact AspisR1S5QRawSourceTotality.qraw_total_of_canonical_limbs a b
    ha0 ha1 ha2 ha3 hb0 hb1 hb2 hb3

/-- One concrete Dot push succeeds whenever the Q.raw call is supplied by the
canonical-input totality theorem. This is the exact four-coordinate source cut. -/
theorem dot_via_raw_total
    (self : Dot) (a b : Q)
    (ha0 : a.val[0]!.val ≤ 2^31-2) (ha1 : a.val[1]!.val ≤ 2^31-2)
    (ha2 : a.val[2]!.val ≤ 2^31-2) (ha3 : a.val[3]!.val ≤ 2^31-2)
    (hb0 : b.val[0]!.val ≤ 2^31-2) (hb1 : b.val[1]!.val ≤ 2^31-2)
    (hb2 : b.val[2]!.val ≤ 2^31-2) (hb3 : b.val[3]!.val ≤ 2^31-2) :
    ∃ d : Dot, AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.dotViaRaw QRaw self a b = .ok d := by
  obtain ⟨raw, hraw⟩ := qraw_arrays_total a b ha0 ha1 ha2 ha3 hb0 hb1 hb2 hb3
  refine ⟨⟨AspisR1DotPushLocal.Proof.updatedSums self.sums raw⟩, ?_⟩
  unfold AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.dotViaRaw
  rw [AspisR1DotPushLocal.Proof.push_total_from_raw QRaw ⟨self.sums⟩ a b raw hraw]
  rfl

theorem allRun_total (xs : List Std.U32) (c : AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.Closure) :
    ∃ b n, AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.allRun
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.fromLimbsClosureFnMut xs c = .ok (b,n) := by
  induction xs generalizing c with
  | nil => exact ⟨true,0,rfl⟩
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hp : x < AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.P
    · obtain ⟨b,n,hn⟩ := ih c
      refine ⟨b,n+1,?_⟩
      simp [AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.allRun,
        AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.fromLimbsClosureFnMut,
        AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.fromLimbsClosureCallMut,hp,hn]
    · refine ⟨false,1,?_⟩
      simp [AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.allRun,
        AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.fromLimbsClosureFnMut,
        AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.fromLimbsClosureCallMut,hp]

/-- If all four checked-Q limbs satisfy the source predicate, the actual
short-circuit scan returns true and therefore constructs a Q value. -/
theorem allRun_true_of_valid (xs : List Std.U32)
    (c : AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.Closure)
    (hvalid : ∀ x ∈ xs, x.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ n, AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.allRun
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.fromLimbsClosureFnMut xs c = .ok (true,n) := by
  induction xs generalizing c with
  | nil => exact ⟨0,rfl⟩
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hxv := hvalid x (by simp)
    have hx : x < AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.P := by
      simpa [AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.P] using hxv
    have htail : ∀ y ∈ xs, y.val < 2147483647 := by
      intro y hy
      exact hvalid y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hy)
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := ih c htail
    refine ⟨n+1, ?_⟩
    simp [AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.allRun,
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.fromLimbsClosureFnMut,
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.fromLimbsClosureCallMut,hx,hn]

theorem fromLimbsWithAll_outer_total (x : Q) :
    ∃ o, AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.fromLimbsWithAll
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.concreteAll x = .ok o := by
  rw [AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.fromLimbs_model_eq]
  obtain ⟨b,n,hn⟩ := allRun_total x.val ()
  cases b <;> simp [hn]

theorem fromLimbsWithAll_success_of_valid (x : Q)
    (hvalid : ∀ v ∈ x.val, v.val < 2147483647) :
    AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.fromLimbsWithAll
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.concreteAll x = .ok (some x) := by
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := allRun_true_of_valid x.val () hvalid
  rw [AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.fromLimbs_model_eq]
  simp [hn]

theorem checked_q_success_of_valid (s : Qm)
    (hvalid : ∀ v ∈ (AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ s).val,
      v.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ q, AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.checkedQWithAll
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.concreteAll s = .ok (.Ok q) := by
  let words := AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ s
  have hwords : ∀ v ∈ words.val, v.val < 2147483647 := by
    simpa [words] using hvalid
  have hfrom := fromLimbsWithAll_success_of_valid words hwords
  refine ⟨words, ?_⟩
  unfold AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.checkedQWithAll
  simp only [AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.limbsOf, bind_tc_ok]
  rw [hfrom]
  simp [AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.optionOkOr]

/-- The actual checked-Q path is outer-total even when its validity scan
rejects arbitrary scalar limbs; that case is a successful outer Err return. -/
theorem checked_q_outer_total (s : Qm) :
    ∃ r, AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.checkedQWithAll
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.concreteAll s = .ok r := by
  unfold AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.checkedQWithAll
  simp only [AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.limbsOf, bind_tc_ok]
  obtain ⟨o, ho⟩ := fromLimbsWithAll_outer_total
    (Array.make 4#usize [s.c0.a,s.c0.b,s.c1.a,s.c1.b])
  rw [ho]
  cases o <;> simp [AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.optionOkOr]

/-- Source `fromWide` returns the exact pair of four-limb arrays. -/
theorem from_wide_array_indices (v : Wide) :
    ∃ (arr : Array Q 2#usize) (x0 x1 : Q),
      AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.fromWide v = .ok arr ∧
      Array.index_usize arr 0#usize = .ok x0 ∧
      Array.index_usize arr 1#usize = .ok x1 ∧
      x0 = AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueLo v ∧
      x1 = AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueHi v := by
  refine ⟨AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.pairFromCoords
      v.c0.c0.a v.c0.c0.b v.c0.c1.a v.c0.c1.b
      v.c1.c0.a v.c1.c0.b v.c1.c1.a v.c1.c1.b,
    AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueLo v,
    AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueHi v,
    AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.fromWide_coordinates v, ?_, ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
  · simp [AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.pairFromCoords,
      AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords, Array.index_usize, Array.make]
  · simp [AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.pairFromCoords,
      AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords, Array.index_usize, Array.make]

/-- Concrete successful push branch, with all potentially failing source calls
shown explicitly. The checked-Q rejection case is handled separately by the
caller and does not assume scalar canonicality. -/
theorem push_ops_continue_success
    (self : State) (value : Wide) (scalar : Qm)
    (arr : Array Q 2#usize) (x0 x1 q : Q) (d0 d1 : Dot) (i : Usize)
    (hcount : self.count < maxTerms)
    (hfrom : AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.fromWide value = .ok arr)
    (hx0 : Array.index_usize arr 0#usize = .ok x0)
    (hx1 : Array.index_usize arr 1#usize = .ok x1)
    (hq : AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.checkedQWithAll
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.concreteAll scalar = .ok (.Ok q))
    (hd0 : AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.dotViaRaw QRaw self.c0 x0 q = .ok d0)
    (hd1 : AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.dotViaRaw QRaw self.c1 x1 q = .ok d1)
    (hadd : UScalar.add self.count 1#usize = .ok i) :
    AspisR1EbyKPushConcreteCheckedQV1.pushWithConcreteCheckedQ
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.concreteAll
      (AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.dotViaRaw QRaw) self value scalar =
        .ok (.Ok (), { c0 := d0, c1 := d1, count := i }) := by
  unfold AspisR1EbyKPushConcreteCheckedQV1.pushWithConcreteCheckedQ
    AspisR1EbyKPushSourceConversionV1.pushWithSourceCheckedAdd
    AspisR1EbyKPushSourceConversionV1.pushWithSourceConversion
    AspisR1EbyKPushExplicitOpsV1.pushWithOps
  simp only [if_neg (not_le_of_gt hcount), hfrom, bind_tc_ok, hx0, hx1, hq,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, hd0, hd1, hadd, bind_tc_ok]

/-- Successful scalar rejection is represented by an ordinary inner Err while
retaining the original state; it is not an outer failure/divergence. -/
theorem push_ops_checked_q_reject
    (self : State) (value : Wide) (scalar : Qm)
    (arr : Array Q 2#usize) (x0 x1 : Q) (e : Unit)
    (hcount : self.count < maxTerms)
    (hfrom : AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.fromWide value = .ok arr)
    (hx0 : Array.index_usize arr 0#usize = .ok x0)
    (hx1 : Array.index_usize arr 1#usize = .ok x1)
    (hq : AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.checkedQWithAll
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.concreteAll scalar = .ok (.Err e)) :
    AspisR1EbyKPushConcreteCheckedQV1.pushWithConcreteCheckedQ
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.concreteAll
      (AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.dotViaRaw QRaw) self value scalar =
        .ok (.Err (), self) := by
  unfold AspisR1EbyKPushConcreteCheckedQV1.pushWithConcreteCheckedQ
    AspisR1EbyKPushSourceConversionV1.pushWithSourceCheckedAdd
    AspisR1EbyKPushSourceConversionV1.pushWithSourceConversion
    AspisR1EbyKPushExplicitOpsV1.pushWithOps
  simp only [if_neg (not_le_of_gt hcount), hfrom, bind_tc_ok, hx0, hx1, hq,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, bind_tc_ok,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual]

private theorem checked_count_add_total (n : Usize) (hn : n < maxTerms) :
    ∃ i, UScalar.add n 1#usize = .ok i := by
  unfold AspisR1EbyKPushExplicitOpsV1.maxTerms at hn
  have hnval : n.val < 4096 := by
    simpa using hn
  have hroom : n.val + 1 ≤ Std.Usize.max := by
    have hmax : 4096 ≤ Std.Usize.max := by scalar_tac
    omega
  have haddSpec : UScalar.add n 1#usize ⦃z => z.val = n.val + 1⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    have hsum : n.val + (1#usize).val ≤ Std.Usize.max := by simpa using hroom
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using hsum
  obtain ⟨i, hadd, _⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists haddSpec
  exact ⟨i,hadd⟩

/-- The full selected source-model EbyK push has an outer Result value on every
canonical value and every pre-call count admitted by the source guard. The
inner checked-Q rejection remains a normal `.Err` result, so scalar inputs need
not be canonical for outer totality. -/
theorem push_outer_total
    (self : State) (value : Wide) (scalar : Qm)
    (hcanonical : AspisR1EbyKPowerValueCanonicalToPush.pushCanonical value)
    (hcount : self.count < maxTerms) :
    ∃ answer,
      AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.pushWithDotBackend QRaw self value scalar =
        .ok answer := by
  obtain ⟨checked, hchecked⟩ := checked_q_outer_total scalar
  obtain ⟨arr,x0,x1,hfrom,hx0,hx1,hx0v,hx1v⟩ := from_wide_array_indices value
  cases checked with
  | Err e =>
    refine ⟨(.Err (),self), ?_⟩
    simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.pushWithDotBackend] using
      push_ops_checked_q_reject self value scalar arr x0 x1 e hcount hfrom hx0 hx1 hchecked
  | Ok q =>
    have hq : AspisR1EbyKCheckedQAllParamV1.checkedQWithAll
      AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.concreteAll scalar = .ok (.Ok q) := hchecked
    have hqcanon := AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.checkedQ_success_canonical scalar q hq
    have hb := AspisR1EbyKPowerValueCanonicalToPush.canonical_push_limb_bounds value hcanonical
    have hq0 : q.val[0]!.val ≤ 2^31-2 := by
      have hm : scalar.c0.a ∈ q.val := by rw [hqcanon.1]; simp [Array.make]
      have hs := hqcanon.2 scalar.c0.a hm
      have hv : q.val[0]!.val = scalar.c0.a.val := by
        rw [hqcanon.1]
        simp [Array.make]
      rw [hv]
      omega
    have hq1 : q.val[1]!.val ≤ 2^31-2 := by
      have hm : scalar.c0.b ∈ q.val := by rw [hqcanon.1]; simp [Array.make]
      have hs := hqcanon.2 scalar.c0.b hm
      have hv : q.val[1]!.val = scalar.c0.b.val := by
        rw [hqcanon.1]
        simp [Array.make]
      rw [hv]
      omega
    have hq2 : q.val[2]!.val ≤ 2^31-2 := by
      have hm : scalar.c1.a ∈ q.val := by rw [hqcanon.1]; simp [Array.make]
      have hs := hqcanon.2 scalar.c1.a hm
      have hv : q.val[2]!.val = scalar.c1.a.val := by
        rw [hqcanon.1]
        simp [Array.make]
      rw [hv]
      omega
    have hq3 : q.val[3]!.val ≤ 2^31-2 := by
      have hm : scalar.c1.b ∈ q.val := by rw [hqcanon.1]; simp [Array.make]
      have hs := hqcanon.2 scalar.c1.b hm
      have hv : q.val[3]!.val = scalar.c1.b.val := by
        rw [hqcanon.1]
        simp [Array.make]
      rw [hv]
      omega
    have hdot0 := dot_via_raw_total self.c0 x0 q
      (by rw [hx0v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueLo,
        AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.1)
      (by rw [hx0v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueLo,
        AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.1)
      (by rw [hx0v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueLo,
        AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.2.1)
      (by rw [hx0v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueLo,
        AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.2.2.1)
      hq0 hq1 hq2 hq3
    have hdot1 := dot_via_raw_total self.c1 x1 q
      (by rw [hx1v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueHi,
        AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.2.2.2.1)
      (by rw [hx1v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueHi,
        AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.2.2.2.2.1)
      (by rw [hx1v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueHi,
        AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.2.2.2.2.2.1)
      (by rw [hx1v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueHi,
        AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.2.2.2.2.2.2)
      hq0 hq1 hq2 hq3
    obtain ⟨d0,hd0⟩ := hdot0
    obtain ⟨d1,hd1⟩ := hdot1
    obtain ⟨i,hadd⟩ := checked_count_add_total self.count hcount
    refine ⟨(.Ok (),{c0:=d0,c1:=d1,count:=i}),?_⟩
    apply push_ops_continue_success self value scalar arr x0 x1 q d0 d1 i
      hcount hfrom hx0 hx1 hq hd0 hd1 hadd

/-- When the scalar's four source limbs pass the actual checked-Q predicate,
the selected EbyK push succeeds (with both Q.raw-backed Dot updates and the
checked numeric count increment). -/
theorem push_success_of_valid_scalar
    (self : State) (value : Wide) (scalar : Qm)
    (hcanonical : AspisR1EbyKPowerValueCanonicalToPush.pushCanonical value)
    (hcount : self.count < maxTerms)
    (hscalar : ∀ x ∈ (AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ scalar).val,
      x.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ out, AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.pushWithDotBackend QRaw self value scalar =
      .ok (.Ok (),out) := by
  have hvalid : ∀ x ∈
      (AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ scalar).val,
      x.val < 2147483647 := by
    exact hscalar
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := checked_q_success_of_valid scalar hvalid
  have hqcanon := AspisR1EbyKCheckedQConcreteAll.checkedQ_success_canonical
    scalar q hq
  obtain ⟨arr,x0,x1,hfrom,hx0,hx1,hx0v,hx1v⟩ := from_wide_array_indices value
  have hb := AspisR1EbyKPowerValueCanonicalToPush.canonical_push_limb_bounds
    value hcanonical
  have hq0 : q.val[0]!.val ≤ 2^31-2 := by
    have hv : q.val[0]!.val = scalar.c0.a.val := by
      rw [hqcanon.1]
      simp [Array.make]
    have hm : scalar.c0.a ∈ (AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ scalar).val := by
      simp [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ, Array.make]
    rw [hv]
    have hs := hscalar scalar.c0.a hm
    omega
  have hq1 : q.val[1]!.val ≤ 2^31-2 := by
    have hv : q.val[1]!.val = scalar.c0.b.val := by
      rw [hqcanon.1]
      simp [Array.make]
    have hm : scalar.c0.b ∈ (AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ scalar).val := by
      simp [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ, Array.make]
    rw [hv]
    have hs := hscalar scalar.c0.b hm
    omega
  have hq2 : q.val[2]!.val ≤ 2^31-2 := by
    have hv : q.val[2]!.val = scalar.c1.a.val := by
      rw [hqcanon.1]
      simp [Array.make]
    have hm : scalar.c1.a ∈ (AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ scalar).val := by
      simp [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ, Array.make]
    rw [hv]
    have hs := hscalar scalar.c1.a hm
    omega
  have hq3 : q.val[3]!.val ≤ 2^31-2 := by
    have hv : q.val[3]!.val = scalar.c1.b.val := by
      rw [hqcanon.1]
      simp [Array.make]
    have hm : scalar.c1.b ∈ (AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ scalar).val := by
      simp [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ, Array.make]
    rw [hv]
    have hs := hscalar scalar.c1.b hm
    omega
  have hdot0 := dot_via_raw_total self.c0 x0 q
    (by rw [hx0v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueLo,
      AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.1)
    (by rw [hx0v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueLo,
      AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.1)
    (by rw [hx0v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueLo,
      AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.2.1)
    (by rw [hx0v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueLo,
      AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.2.2.1)
    hq0 hq1 hq2 hq3
  have hdot1 := dot_via_raw_total self.c1 x1 q
    (by rw [hx1v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueHi,
      AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.2.2.2.1)
    (by rw [hx1v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueHi,
      AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.2.2.2.2.1)
    (by rw [hx1v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueHi,
      AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.2.2.2.2.2.1)
    (by rw [hx1v]; simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.valueHi,
      AspisR1EbyKPushWideToQ.qFromCoords,Array.make] using hb.2.2.2.2.2.2.2)
    hq0 hq1 hq2 hq3
  obtain ⟨d0,hd0⟩ := hdot0
  obtain ⟨d1,hd1⟩ := hdot1
  obtain ⟨i,hadd⟩ := checked_count_add_total self.count hcount
  have hpush := push_ops_continue_success self value scalar arr x0 x1 q d0 d1 i
    hcount hfrom hx0 hx1 hq hd0 hd1 hadd
  refine ⟨{c0:=d0,c1:=d1,count:=i}, ?_⟩
  simpa [AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.pushWithDotBackend] using hpush

/-- The successful valid-scalar branch of the concrete emitted push carries
the retained QRaw arithmetic law for both Dot accumulators.  The two
`2^46` accumulator bounds remain explicit state invariants. -/
theorem push_success_product_update_of_valid_scalar
    (self : State) (value : Wide) (scalar : Qm)
    (hcanonical : AspisR1EbyKPowerValueCanonicalToPush.pushCanonical value)
    (hcount : self.count < maxTerms)
    (hscalar : ∀ x ∈ (AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ scalar).val,
      x.val < 2147483647)
    (hacc0 : ∀ x ∈ self.c0.sums.val, x.val < 2^46)
    (hacc1 : ∀ x ∈ self.c1.sums.val, x.val < 2^46) :
    ∃ out,
      AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.pushWithDotBackend QRaw self value scalar =
        .ok (.Ok (),out) ∧
      AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.castSums out.c0.sums =
        AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.tupleAdd
          (AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.castSums self.c0.sums)
          (AspisR1.R22RawQmProductResidues.qmulCoefficients
            ((value.c0.c0.a.val,value.c0.c0.b.val),
             (value.c0.c1.a.val,value.c0.c1.b.val))
            ((scalar.c0.a.val,scalar.c0.b.val),
             (scalar.c1.a.val,scalar.c1.b.val))) ∧
      AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.castSums out.c1.sums =
        AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.tupleAdd
          (AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.castSums self.c1.sums)
          (AspisR1.R22RawQmProductResidues.qmulCoefficients
            ((value.c1.c0.a.val,value.c1.c0.b.val),
             (value.c1.c1.a.val,value.c1.c1.b.val))
            ((scalar.c0.a.val,scalar.c0.b.val),
             (scalar.c1.a.val,scalar.c1.b.val))) := by
  obtain ⟨out,hrun⟩ := push_success_of_valid_scalar self value scalar
    hcanonical hcount hscalar
  have hupdate :=
    AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.successful_push_decoded_product_update
      self value scalar out hcanonical hacc0 hacc1 hrun
  exact ⟨out,hrun,hupdate.1,hupdate.2⟩

import LPm_DotPort
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPm_PublicPort
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPm_RawPort LPm_UpdatePort

 theorem raw_values_injective (x y : LPm_PublicState.Raw)
    (same : LPm_PublicState.values x=LPm_PublicState.values y) : x=y := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,d,hx⟩ := LPf_ArrayFour.shape x
  obtain ⟨e,f,g,h,hy⟩ := LPf_ArrayFour.shape y
  subst x; subst y
  simp only [LPm_PublicState.values,Array.make,List.getElem!_cons_zero,
    List.getElem!_cons_succ,Prod.mk.injEq] at same
  rcases same with ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd⟩
  simp only [UScalar.eq_of_val_eq ha,UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hb,
    UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hc,UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hd]

theorem raw_meaning (a b : LPi_RawValues.Q) (ha : LPi_RawValues.Canon a)
    (hb : LPi_RawValues.Canon b) (r : LPm_PublicState.Raw)
    (call : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.Q.raw a b=ok r) :
    LPm_PublicState.values r=LPi_RawValues.spec a b := by
  obtain ⟨r0,r1,r2,r3,actual,meaning⟩ := LPi_RawValues.source a b ha hb
  have unique := Result.ok.inj (call.symm.trans actual)
  rw [unique]
  exact meaning

theorem state_ext (x y : State) (lo : x.c0.sums=y.c0.sums)
    (hi : x.c1.sums=y.c1.sums) (count : x.count=y.count) : x=y := by
  rcases x with ⟨⟨a⟩,⟨b⟩,c⟩
  rcases y with ⟨⟨d⟩,⟨e⟩,f⟩
  simp_all only

/-- The concrete native public step and the retained concrete cohort step
return the SAME complete eight-word state. All call/value observations are
derived from their total source theorems, not supplied as whole step equality. -/
theorem source (s : Native) (v : NE) (q : NQ)
    (hv : canonE v) (hq : canonQ q) (count : s.count.val<4096) :
    ∃ out, FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.push s v q=ok (.Ok (),out) ∧
      AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.pushWithDotBackend AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.QRaw
        (statePort s) (AspisR1S5ClaimDotConcreteAdapter.toPushWide (ePort v))
        (AspisR1S5ClaimDotConcreteAdapter.toPushQm (qPort q))=ok (.Ok (),statePort out) := by
  let vm := AspisR1S5ClaimDotConcreteAdapter.toPushWide (ePort v)
  let qm := AspisR1S5ClaimDotConcreteAdapter.toPushQm (qPort q)
  have cv : AspisR1EbyKPowerValueCanonicalToPush.pushCanonical vm := hv
  have cc : (statePort s).count < AspisR1EbyKPushExplicitOpsV1.maxTerms := by
    simp only [statePort,AspisR1EbyKPushExplicitOpsV1.maxTerms]
    scalar_tac
  have cq : ∀ x ∈ (AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ qm).val,x.val<2147483647 := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [qm,AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.scalarQ,
      AspisR1S5ClaimDotConcreteAdapter.toPushQm,qPort,Array.make,
      List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl
    · exact hq.1.1
    · exact hq.1.2
    · exact hq.2.1
    · exact hq.2.2
  obtain ⟨lo,hi,out,ncall,lv,hv0,h0,h1,inc⟩ := LPm_PublicState.source s v q hv hq count
  obtain ⟨model,mcall⟩ := AspisR1S5EbyKPushTotalityV1.push_success_of_valid_scalar
    (statePort s) vm qm cv cc cq
  obtain ⟨ml,mr,mlcall,mrcall,mlsum,mrsum,_,minc,_⟩ :=
    AspisR1EbyKPushDotBackend.successful_push_exact_backend
      AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.QRaw (statePort s) vm qm model mcall
  change AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.QRaw (LPi_CheckedInputs.q v.c0)
    (LPi_CheckedInputs.q q)=ok ml at mlcall
  change AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.QRaw (LPi_CheckedInputs.q v.c1)
    (LPi_CheckedInputs.q q)=ok mr at mrcall
  rw [raw_eq] at mlcall mrcall
  have mlval := raw_meaning _ _ (LPi_CheckedInputs.canonical v.c0 hv.1)
    (LPi_CheckedInputs.canonical q hq) ml mlcall
  have mrval := raw_meaning _ _ (LPi_CheckedInputs.canonical v.c1 hv.2)
    (LPi_CheckedInputs.canonical q hq) mr mrcall
  have mleq := raw_values_injective ml lo (mlval.trans lv.symm)
  have mreq := raw_values_injective mr hi (mrval.trans hv0.symm)
  subst ml; subst mr
  have loeq : model.c0.sums=(statePort out).c0.sums := by
    change model.c0.sums=out.c0.sums
    rw [mlsum,h0]
    exact (sums s.c0 lo).symm
  have hieq : model.c1.sums=(statePort out).c1.sums := by
    change model.c1.sums=out.c1.sums
    rw [mrsum,h1]
    exact (sums s.c1 hi).symm
  have ceq : model.count=(statePort out).count := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (minc.trans inc.symm)
  have same := state_ext model (statePort out) loeq hieq ceq
  rw [same] at mcall
  exact ⟨out,ncall,mcall⟩

#print axioms raw_meaning
#print axioms state_ext
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPm_PublicPort

theorem source (s : Native) : ∃ out,

LPm_WordFold.source:
import LPf_DotResidueStep
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPm_WordFold
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
abbrev bound := LPf_DotWordStep.bound

def run (sum : U64) : List U64 → U64
  | [] => sum
  | raw::xs => run (LPf_DotPushFour.update sum raw) xs

/-- Every reached count supplies the next native step's no-wrap invariant.
All raw representatives are included; no multiplication is evaluated here. -/
theorem bounded (xs : List U64) (sum : U64) (n : Nat)
    (fits : n+xs.length ≤ 4096) (hs : sum.val ≤ n*bound) :
    (run sum xs).val ≤ (n+xs.length)*bound := by
  induction xs generalizing sum n with
  | nil => simpa only [run,List.length_nil,Nat.add_zero] using hs
  | cons raw xs ih =>
    have hn : n<4096 := by simp only [List.length_cons] at fits; omega
    have update := (LPf_DotWordStep.value sum raw n hn hs).2
    have tail := ih (LPf_DotPushFour.update sum raw) (n+1)
      (by simp only [List.length_cons] at fits; omega) update
    simpa only [run,List.length_cons,Nat.add_assoc,Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_left_comm] using tail

/-- Product-sum value invariant for an arbitrary source-shaped prefix, on
EVERY raw u64 sequence fitting the public count cap. -/
theorem residues (xs : List U64) (sum : U64) (n : Nat)
    (fits : n+xs.length ≤ 4096) (hs : sum.val ≤ n*bound) :
    (run sum xs).val%2147483647 =
      (sum.val+(xs.map UScalar.val).sum)%2147483647 := by
  induction xs generalizing sum n with
  | nil => simp only [run,List.map_nil,List.sum_nil,Nat.add_zero]
  | cons raw xs ih =>
    have hn : n<4096 := by simp only [List.length_cons] at fits; omega
    have update := (LPf_DotWordStep.value sum raw n hn hs).2
    have tail := ih (LPf_DotPushFour.update sum raw) (n+1)
      (by simp only [List.length_cons] at fits; omega) update
    rw [run,tail]
    rw [Nat.add_mod,LPf_DotResidueStep.source sum raw n hn hs,←Nat.add_mod]
    simp only [List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,Nat.add_assoc]

theorem twenty_nine (xs : List U64) (size : xs.length=29) :
    (run 0#u64 xs).val ≤ 29*bound ∧
    (run 0#u64 xs).val%2147483647 = (xs.map UScalar.val).sum%2147483647 := by
  constructor
  · simpa only [size,Nat.zero_add] using bounded xs 0#u64 0 (by omega) (by decide)
  · simpa only [show (0#u64).val=0 from rfl,Nat.zero_add] using
      residues xs 0#u64 0 (by omega) (by decide)

#print axioms bounded
#print axioms residues
#print axioms twenty_nine
end AspisR1.LPm_WordFold

LPm_PublicFold.source:
import LPm_PublicPort
import LPm_WordFold
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPm_PublicFold
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPm_RawPort
abbrev B := LPf_DotWordStep.bound
abbrev M := AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.M
abbrev Quad := M×M×M×M
abbrev Eight := Quad×Quad

def Bounded (s : Native) (n : Nat) : Prop := s.count.val=n ∧
  (∀ x∈s.c0.sums.val,x.val≤n*B) ∧ (∀ x∈s.c1.sums.val,x.val≤n*B)

def meaning (s : Native) : Eight :=
  (AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.castSums s.c0.sums,
   AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.castSums s.c1.sums)

def plus (a b : Eight) : Eight :=
  (AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.tupleAdd a.1 b.1,
   AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.tupleAdd a.2 b.2)

def contribution (v : NE) (q : NQ) : Eight :=
  let x := AspisR1S5ClaimDotConcreteAdapter.toPushWide (ePort v)
  let y := AspisR1S5ClaimDotConcreteAdapter.toPushQm (qPort q)
  let scalar := (((y.c0.a.val : M),(y.c0.b.val : M)),(y.c1.a.val : M),(y.c1.b.val : M))
  (R22RawQmProductResidues.qmulCoefficients
    (((x.c0.c0.a.val : M),(x.c0.c0.b.val : M)),(x.c0.c1.a.val : M),(x.c0.c1.b.val : M)) scalar,
   R22RawQmProductResidues.qmulCoefficients
    (((x.c1.c0.a.val : M),(x.c1.c0.b.val : M)),(x.c1.c1.a.val : M),(x.c1.c1.b.val : M)) scalar)

def fold (initial : Eight) : List (NE×NQ) → Eight
  | [] => initial
  | (v,q)::xs => fold (plus initial (contribution v q)) xs

theorem dot_bound (s : LPm_PublicState.Dot) (r : LPm_PublicState.Raw) (n : Nat)
    (hn : n<4096) (hs : ∀ x∈s.sums.val,x.val≤n*B) :
    ∀ x∈(LPm_PublicState.update s r).sums.val,x.val≤(n+1)*B := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,d,shape⟩ := LPf_ArrayFour.shape s.sums
  obtain ⟨e,f,g,h,raw⟩ := LPf_ArrayFour.shape r
  intro x hx
  simp only [LPm_PublicState.update,shape,raw,Array.make,List.getElem!_cons_zero,
    List.getElem!_cons_succ,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at hx
  rcases hx with rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl
  all_goals
    apply (LPf_DotWordStep.value _ _ n hn _).2
    apply hs
    simp only [shape,Array.make,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false]
    tauto

theorem below46 (x : U64) (n : Nat) (hn : n≤4096) (hx : x.val≤n*B) : x.val<2^46 := by
  norm_num only [Nat.reducePow]
  dsimp only [B,LPf_DotWordStep.bound] at hx
  omega

/-- Full native/cohort step and decoded FIELD product-sum update. The imported
R22 theorem supplies the multiplication interpretation; it is not re-proved. -/
theorem step (s : Native) (v : NE) (q : NQ) (n : Nat) (hn : n<29)
    (hs : Bounded s n) (hv : canonE v) (hq : canonQ q) :
    ∃ out, FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.push s v q=ok (.Ok (),out) ∧
      Bounded out (n+1) ∧ meaning out=plus (meaning s) (contribution v q) := by
  have count : s.count.val<4096 := by rw [hs.1]; omega
  obtain ⟨out,native,model⟩ := LPm_PublicPort.source s v q hv hq count
  obtain ⟨lo,hi,other,otherCall,_,_,h0,h1,inc⟩ := LPm_PublicState.source s v q hv hq count
  have same : out=other := congrArg Prod.snd (Result.ok.inj (native.symm.trans otherCall))
  subst other
  have bounds : Bounded out (n+1) := by
    refine ⟨by rw [inc,hs.1],?_,?_⟩
    · rw [h0]; exact dot_bound s.c0 lo n (by omega) hs.2.1
    · rw [h1]; exact dot_bound s.c1 hi n (by omega) hs.2.2
  have cv : AspisR1EbyKPowerValueCanonicalToPush.pushCanonical
      (AspisR1S5ClaimDotConcreteAdapter.toPushWide (ePort v)) := hv
  have acc0 : ∀ x∈(statePort s).c0.sums.val,x.val<2^46 := by
    intro x hx; exact below46 x n (by omega) (hs.2.1 x hx)
  have acc1 : ∀ x∈(statePort s).c1.sums.val,x.val<2^46 := by
    intro x hx; exact below46 x n (by omega) (hs.2.2 x hx)
  have values := AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.successful_push_decoded_product_update
    (statePort s) _ _ (statePort out) cv acc0 acc1 model
  exact ⟨out,native,bounds,Prod.ext values.1 values.2⟩

inductive Trace : List (NE×NQ) → Native → Native → Prop where
  | done (s : Native) : Trace [] s s
  | step {v : NE} {q : NQ} {xs : List (NE×NQ)} {s next out : Native}
      (canonicalV : canonE v) (canonicalQ : canonQ q)
      (call : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.push s v q=ok (.Ok (),next))
      (tail : Trace xs next out) : Trace ((v,q)::xs) s out

/-- Ordered public fold for every source-shaped successful prefix, including
all29 iterations at every one of the six points. No sum-value invariant is an
input hypothesis; it follows from the source calls and zero-prefix bounds. -/
theorem trace_value {xs : List (NE×NQ)} {s out : Native} (tr : Trace xs s out)
    (n : Nat) (fits : n+xs.length≤29) (hs : Bounded s n) :
    Bounded out (n+xs.length) ∧ meaning out=fold (meaning s) xs := by
  induction tr generalizing n with
  | done s => exact ⟨by simpa only [List.length_nil,Nat.add_zero] using hs,rfl⟩
  | @step v q xs s next out hv hq call tail ih =>
    have hn : n<29 := by simp only [List.length_cons] at fits; omega
    obtain ⟨actual,actualCall,hbound,hvalue⟩ := step s v q n hn hs hv hq
    have same : actual=next := congrArg Prod.snd (Result.ok.inj (actualCall.symm.trans call))
    subst actual
    obtain ⟨last,value⟩ := ih (n+1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at fits; omega) hbound
    constructor
    · simpa only [List.length_cons,Nat.add_assoc,Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_left_comm] using last
    · rw [fold,←hvalue]
      exact value

#print axioms dot_bound
#print axioms below46
#print axioms step
#print axioms trace_value
end AspisR1.LPm_PublicFold

import LPm_PublicFold

namespace AspisR1.LPm_PublicTwentyNine

def zero : Native :=
  ⟨⟨Array.repeat 4#usize 0#u64⟩,⟨Array.repeat 4#usize 0#u64⟩,0#usize⟩

theorem source_new : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.new=ok zero := rfl

theorem initial_bound : Bounded zero 0 := by
  refine ⟨rfl,?_,?_⟩
  all_goals
    intro x hx
    simp only [zero,Array.repeat,List.mem_replicate] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨_,rfl⟩
    simp only [Nat.zero_mul]
    decide

/-- ONE theorem applies to each of the six actual point traces. The local
native calls determine the value; no public field-sum equality is assumed. -/
theorem source (xs : List (NE×NQ)) (out : Native) (size : xs.length=29)
    (tr : Trace xs zero out) :
    Bounded out 29 ∧ meaning out=fold (meaning zero) xs := by
  have result := trace_value tr 0 (by omega) initial_bound
  simpa only [size,Nat.zero_add] using result

#print axioms source_new
#print axioms initial_bound
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPm_PublicTwentyNine

import LPm_FinishPort
import LPm_PublicTwentyNine
import LPm_SemanticSelections
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPm_PointLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow LPi_FieldValues LPm_RawPort
open AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim
abbrev ops := AspisR1S5ClaimDotConcreteAdapter.concreteOps AspisR1EbyKPushDecodedProductUpdate.QRaw
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize

/-- Linked local observations of the actual scalar loop. The read and weight
ports identify the caller's arguments; no loop Result or sum is assumed. -/
inductive Trace {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8)
    (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (point : Usize) :
    Range → Native → List (NE×NQ) → NE → Prop where
  | done (iter iter' : Range) (s : Native) (out : NE)
      (next : core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter=ok (none,iter'))
      (finish : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.finish s=ok out) :
      Trace sem y1 g point iter s [] out
  | step {iter iter' : Range} {s s' : Native} {out : NE} {xs : List (NE×NQ)}
      (l : Usize) (v : NE) (q : NQ)
      (next : core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter=ok (some l,iter'))
      (read : ClaimScalar.read ops sem y1 point l=ok (qPort q))
      (weight : Array.index_usize g l=ok (ePort v))
      (cv : canonE v) (cq : canonQ q) (count : s.count.val<29)
      (push : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.push s v q=ok (.Ok (),s'))
      (tail : Trace sem y1 g point iter' s' xs out) :
      Trace sem y1 g point iter s ((v,q)::xs) out

theorem model_push (s s' : Native) (v : NE) (q : NQ)
    (cv : canonE v) (cq : canonQ q) (count : s.count.val<29)
    (push : FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.push s v q=ok (.Ok (),s')) :
    ops.pushDot (statePort s) (ePort v) (qPort q)=ok (.Ok (),statePort s') := by
  obtain ⟨actual,native,model⟩ := LPm_PublicPort.source s v q cv cq (by omega)
  have same : actual=s' := congrArg Prod.snd (Result.ok.inj (native.symm.trans push))
  subst actual
  exact model

theorem source {H : Type} (inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    {sem : r1_semantic.Verified H} {y1 : Slice U8} {g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize}
    {point : Usize} {iter : Range} {s : Native} {xs : List (NE×NQ)} {out : NE}
    (tr : Trace sem y1 g point iter s xs out) :
    verifier.prepared_claim_dot_loop ops inst iter sem y1 g point (statePort s)=
      ok (.Ok (ePort out)) := by
  induction tr with
  | done iter iter' s out next finish =>
    obtain ⟨actual,native,model⟩ := LPm_FinishPort.source s
    have same := Result.ok.inj (native.symm.trans finish)
    subst actual
    have body : verifier.prepared_claim_dot_loop.body ops inst y1 g iter sem point (statePort s)=
        ok (ControlFlow.done (.Ok (ePort out))) := by
      rw [ClaimScalar.body_eq_source]
      simp only [ClaimScalar.body,next,bind_tc_ok,model]
    change Aeneas.Std.loop _ _ = _
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    dsimp only
    rw [body]
  | @step iter iter' s s' out xs l v q next read weight cv cq count push tail ih =>
    have model := model_push s s' v q cv cq count push
    have body : verifier.prepared_claim_dot_loop.body ops inst y1 g iter sem point (statePort s)=
        ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter',sem,point,statePort s')) := by
      rw [ClaimScalar.body_eq_source]
      simp only [ClaimScalar.body,next,bind_tc_ok,read,weight,model,
        core.result.Result.map_err,
        verifier.prepared_claim_dot.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleTupleError.call_once,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
    change Aeneas.Std.loop _ _ = _
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    dsimp only
    rw [body]
    exact ih

#print axioms model_push
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPm_PointLoop

import LPm_PointLoop
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPm_SixPoints
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPm_RawPort AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim

theorem erase {H : Type} {sem : r1_semantic.Verified H} {y1 : Slice U8}
    {g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize} {point : Usize} {iter : LPm_PointLoop.Range}
    {s : Native} {xs : List (NE×NQ)} {out : NE}
    (tr : LPm_PointLoop.Trace sem y1 g point iter s xs out) :
    ∃ last, LPm_PublicFold.Trace xs s last ∧
      FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.finish last=ok out := by
  induction tr with
  | done iter iter' s out next finish => exact ⟨s,.done s,finish⟩
  | @step iter iter' s s' out xs l v q next read weight cv cq count push tail ih =>
    obtain ⟨last,steps,finish⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨last,.step cv cq push steps,finish⟩

/-- All six point folds share the SAME caller sem/y1/g. The full cohort loop
Result and its 29-step field sum follow from linked local native transitions.
This theorem does not supply the missing native whole prepared_claim join. -/
theorem all_six {H : Type} (inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8) (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize)
    (point : Fin 6 → Usize) (number : ∀ i, (point i).val=i.val)
    (xs : Fin 6 → List (NE×NQ)) (out : Fin 6 → NE)
    (size : ∀ i, (xs i).length=29)
    (tr : ∀ i, LPm_PointLoop.Trace sem y1 g (point i)
      {start:=0#usize, «end»:=29#usize} LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero (xs i) (out i)) :
    ∀ i, (point i).val<6 ∧
      verifier.prepared_claim_dot_loop LPm_PointLoop.ops inst
        {start:=0#usize, «end»:=29#usize} sem y1 g (point i)
        (statePort LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero)=ok (.Ok (ePort (out i))) ∧
      ∃ last, LPm_PublicFold.Bounded last 29 ∧
        LPm_PublicFold.meaning last=LPm_PublicFold.fold
          (LPm_PublicFold.meaning LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero) (xs i) ∧
        FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.finish last=ok (out i) := by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨last,steps,finish⟩ := erase (tr i)
  obtain ⟨bound,value⟩ := LPm_PublicTwentyNine.source (xs i) last (size i) steps
  exact ⟨by rw [number]; exact i.isLt,
    LPm_PointLoop.source inst (tr i),last,bound,value,finish⟩

#print axioms erase
#print axioms all_six
end AspisR1.LPm_SixPoints

import LPm_SixPoints
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPm_PointLength
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPm_RawPort AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim

theorem length {H : Type} {sem : r1_semantic.Verified H} {y1 : Slice U8}
    {g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize} {point : Usize} {iter : LPm_PointLoop.Range}
    {s : Native} {xs : List (NE×NQ)} {out : NE}
    (tr : LPm_PointLoop.Trace sem y1 g point iter s xs out)
    (last : iter.end.val=29) (bound : iter.start.val≤29) :
    xs.length=29-iter.start.val := by
  induction tr with
  | done iter iter' s out next finish =>
    have h := ClaimTrace.next_none_bound iter iter' next
    simp only [List.length_nil]
    omega
  | @step iter iter' s s' out xs l v q next read weight cv cq count push tail ih =>
    obtain ⟨hl,active,start,finish⟩ := ClaimTrace.next_some_step iter iter' l next
    have e : iter'.end.val=29 := by rw [finish]; exact last
    have b : iter'.start.val≤29 := by omega
    have n := ih e b
    simp only [List.length_cons]
    omega

/-- The actual iterator observations determine every one of the six fold
lengths. No supplied length, public sum, or whole-loop equality is required. -/
theorem all_six {H : Type} (inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8) (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize)
    (point : Fin 6 → Usize) (number : ∀ i, (point i).val=i.val)
    (xs : Fin 6 → List (NE×NQ)) (out : Fin 6 → NE)
    (tr : ∀ i, LPm_PointLoop.Trace sem y1 g (point i)
      {start:=0#usize, «end»:=29#usize} LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero (xs i) (out i)) :
    ∀ i, (xs i).length=29 ∧ (point i).val<6 ∧
      verifier.prepared_claim_dot_loop LPm_PointLoop.ops inst
        {start:=0#usize, «end»:=29#usize} sem y1 g (point i)
        (statePort LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero)=ok (.Ok (ePort (out i))) ∧
      ∃ last, LPm_PublicFold.Bounded last 29 ∧
        LPm_PublicFold.meaning last=LPm_PublicFold.fold
          (LPm_PublicFold.meaning LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero) (xs i) ∧
        FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.finish last=ok (out i) := by
  have sizes : ∀ i, (xs i).length=29 := by
    intro i
    have h := length (tr i) rfl (by decide)
    change (xs i).length=29-0 at h
    exact h
  intro i
  exact ⟨sizes i,LPm_SixPoints.all_six inst sem y1 g point number xs out sizes tr i⟩

#print axioms length
#print axioms all_six
end AspisR1.LPm_PointLength

XRw_GenericDriver.source:
import Std
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRw_GenericDriver
/-- The effect constructor includes its arbitrary error carrier (for example
Except E, or a three-way Result with failure and divergence). -/
def guarded {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] {S I : Type}
    (stage : S → I → M S) (stopped : S → Bool) (s : S) (i : I) : M S :=
  if stopped s then pure s else stage s i

def unrolled {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] {S I : Type}
    (stage : S → I → M S) (stopped : S → Bool) : List I → S → M S
  | [], s => pure s
  | i :: rest, s => if stopped s then pure s else do
      let next ← stage s i
      unrolled stage stopped rest next

/-- Whole effect equality: finish, error and selected state are preserved.
Only the pure/bind identity is needed; no stage success or totality premise. -/
theorem first_stop_fold {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] {S I O : Type}
    (pure_bind : ∀ (s : S) (k : S → M S), (pure s >>= k) = k s)
    (stage : S → I → M S) (stopped : S → Bool)
    (finish : S → M O) (indices : List I) (s : S) :
    (unrolled stage stopped indices s >>= finish) =
      (indices.foldlM (guarded stage stopped) s >>= finish) := by
  have hold : ∀ (is : List I) (s : S), stopped s = true →
      is.foldlM (guarded stage stopped) s = pure s := by
    intro is s hs
    induction is with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons i rest ih =>
      rw [List.foldlM_cons]
      change (guarded stage stopped s i >>= _) = _
      rw [show guarded stage stopped s i = pure s by simp only [guarded, hs, ↓reduceIte]]
      rw [pure_bind]
      exact ih
  have he : ∀ (is : List I) (s : S),
      unrolled stage stopped is s = is.foldlM (guarded stage stopped) s := by
    intro is
    induction is with
    | nil => intro s; rfl
    | cons i rest ih =>
      intro s
      by_cases hs : stopped s = true
      · rw [hold (i::rest) s hs]
        simp only [unrolled, hs, ↓reduceIte]
      · simp only [unrolled, guarded, hs, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.foldlM_cons]
        congr 1
        funext next
        exact ih next
  rw [he]
#print axioms first_stop_fold
end XRw_GenericDriver

LPk_Step.source:
import GammaCandidateLowQuotient
import ExtractedQM31SamplerPass
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPk_Step
open AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds AspisR1.SamplerWord

/-- Natural relation checked for a native step. No division equivalence is
assumed by callers of the stub. -/
def Relation (rem limb q r : Nat) : Prop :=
  q * P + r = rem * B + limb ∧ r < P

theorem unique (rem limb q r : Nat) (h : Relation rem limb q r) :
    q = (rem * B + limb) / P ∧ r = (rem * B + limb) % P := by
  obtain ⟨he,hr⟩ := h
  have hq : (rem * B + limb) / P = q := by
    apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le
    · omega
    · rw [← he, Nat.add_mul, one_mul]
      omega
  refine ⟨hq.symm, ?_⟩
  have hm := Nat.mod_add_div (rem * B + limb) P
  rw [hq, Nat.mul_comm P q] at hm
  omega

/-- Pairing theorem for the step stub, on the complete native domain. -/
theorem machine_step (rem : UInt64) (limb : UInt32) (hr : rem.toNat < P) :
    Relation rem.toNat limb.toNat (machineStep rem limb).1.toNat
      (machineStep rem limb).2.toNat := by
  rw [Relation, machineStep_quotient_toNat limb hr, machineStep_remainder_toNat limb hr]
  constructor
  · change ((rem.toNat * 2^32 + limb.toNat) / P) * P +
      (rem.toNat * 2^32 + limb.toNat) % P = rem.toNat * 2^32 + limb.toNat
    have h := Nat.mod_add_div (rem.toNat * 2^32 + limb.toNat) P
    rw [Nat.mul_comm P] at h
    omega
  · exact Nat.mod_lt _ P_pos

theorem step_join (rem : UInt64) (limb q r : UInt32)
    (hr : rem.toNat < P) (h : Relation rem.toNat limb.toNat q.toNat r.toNat) :
    (q,r) = machineStep rem limb := by
  have hu := unique _ _ _ _ h
  apply Prod.ext <;> apply UInt32.toNat.inj
  · exact hu.1.trans (machineStep_quotient_toNat limb hr).symm
  · exact hu.2.trans (machineStep_remainder_toNat limb hr).symm
#print axioms unique
#print axioms machine_step
#print axioms step_join
end LPk_Step

LPk_Cohort.source:
import LPk_Step
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LPk_Cohort
open AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerPass
open AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank AspisR1GammaCaller.DigitsModel
open AspisR1.SamplerNatModel

theorem body_eq (a : Array U32 8#usize) (r : U64) (j : Usize) :
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.qm31_div_pass_loop.body a r j =
    AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.sampler.qm31_div_pass_loop.body a r j := by
  simp only [AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.qm31_div_pass_loop.body,
    AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.sampler.qm31_div_pass_loop.body,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.P, AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.field.P]

/-- Exact cohort Result, including the quotient writeback, paired to the
native relation on all bounded remainders and all u32 limbs at valid indices. -/
theorem step_result (a : Array U32 8#usize) (r : U64) (j : Usize)
    (hr : r.val < P) (hj0 : 0 < j.val) (hj8 : j.val ≤ 8) :
    ∃ (j1 : Usize) (q : U32) (r1 : U64),
      AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.qm31_div_pass_loop.body a r j =
        ok (cont (a.set j1 q, r1, j1)) ∧ j1.val = j.val - 1 ∧
      LPk_Step.Relation r.val
        (a.val[j.val - 1]'(by have := a.property; change a.val.length = 8 at this; omega)).val
        q.val r1.val := by
  obtain ⟨j1,q,r1,he,hj,hq,hm,hb⟩ := body_success a r j hr hj0 hj8
  refine ⟨j1,q,r1, (body_eq a r j).trans he, hj, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨?_, hb⟩
  rw [hq,hm]
  have h := Nat.mod_add_div (r.val * B + (a.val[j.val-1]'(by
    have := a.property; change a.val.length = 8 at this; omega)).val) P
  rw [Nat.mul_comm P] at h
  omega

/-- All 32-byte blocks succeed in the cohort and have eight base-P digits,
a canonical digit range, and the final quotient at most 256. This reuses the
cohort's checked eight-limb and eight-digit inductions. -/
theorem all_blocks (block : Array U8 32#usize) :
    ∃ (ds : Array U32 8#usize) (q : U32),
      AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.low_base_p_digits block = ok (ds,q) ∧
      values ds = ordinaryDigits (rank block) ∧
      q.val = rank block / P^8 ∧ q.val ≤ 256 ∧
      ∀ d ∈ values ds, d < P := by
  obtain ⟨_,ds,q,he,_,_,_⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerIndexedOutputSuccessV5.low_base_p_digits_success block
  have h := low_candidate_refines block ds q he
  refine ⟨ds,q,he,h.1,h.2,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [h.2]; exact rank_div_P8_le_256 (rank_lt block)
  · rw [h.1]; exact lowDigits_canonical P_pos 8 (rank block)
#print axioms body_eq
#print axioms step_result
#print axioms all_blocks
end LPk_Cohort

LPk_Induction.source:
import LPk_Cohort
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace LPk_Induction
open AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds AspisR1.SamplerWord AspisR1.SamplerWordPass
open AspisR1.SamplerRepeatedPass AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank

/-- An execution trace of native high-to-low limb steps, specified only by
the relation checked by Kani. The list order is supplied by the traversal gate. -/
inductive Pass : UInt64 → List UInt32 → UInt64 → List UInt32 → Prop where
  | nil (r : UInt64) : Pass r [] r []
  | cons {r : UInt64} {d q : UInt32} {r1 r2 : UInt64} {ds qs : List UInt32}
      (step : LPk_Step.Relation r.toNat d.toNat q.toNat r1.toNat)
      (tail : Pass r1 ds r2 qs) : Pass r (d::ds) r2 (q::qs)

theorem pass_join {r out : UInt64} {xs qs : List UInt32}
    (trace : Pass r xs out qs) (hr : r.toNat < P) :
    (out,qs) = machineProcess r xs := by
  induction trace with
  | nil r => rfl
  | @cons r d q r1 r2 ds qs hs ht ih =>
    have hu := LPk_Step.unique _ _ _ _ hs
    have hq : q = (machineStep r d).1 := UInt32.toNat.inj
      (hu.1.trans (machineStep_quotient_toNat d hr).symm)
    have hre : r1 = UInt64.ofNat (machineStep r d).2.toNat := by
      apply UInt64.toNat.inj
      rw [uint32_to_uint64_toNat]
      exact hu.2.trans (machineStep_remainder_toNat d hr).symm
    have hi := ih hs.2
    simp only [machineProcess]
    rw [←hq, ←hre, ←hi]

/-- Eight ordered shared-capture callbacks compose eight division passes.
The native from_fn gate supplies this order; this is not an assumption of
whole-function equality. -/
inductive Digits : Nat → List UInt32 → List Nat → List UInt32 → Prop where
  | nil (xs : List UInt32) : Digits 0 xs [] xs
  | cons {n : Nat} {xs qs out : List UInt32} {r : UInt64} {ds : List Nat}
      (pass : Pass 0 xs r qs) (tail : Digits n qs ds out) :
      Digits (n+1) xs (r.toNat::ds) out

theorem digits_join {n : Nat} {xs out : List UInt32} {ds : List Nat}
    (trace : Digits n xs ds out) : (ds,out) = run n xs := by
  induction trace with
  | nil xs => rfl
  | @cons n xs qs out r ds hp ht ih =>
    have he := pass_join hp (show (0 : UInt64).toNat < P from P_pos)
    simp only [run]
    rw [←he, ←ih]

theorem eight_digits {block : Array U8 32#usize} {out : List UInt32} {ds : List Nat}
    (trace : Digits 8 (AspisR1.SamplerBytePass.digits block) ds out) :
    ds = AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.ordinaryDigits (rank block) ∧
    wordValue out = rank block / P^8 ∧ wordValue out ≤ 256 := by
  have he := digits_join trace
  have hd := congrArg Prod.fst he
  have ho := congrArg Prod.snd he
  dsimp only [Prod.fst] at hd
  dsimp only [Prod.snd] at ho
  refine ⟨hd.trans (run8_bytes block), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ho]; exact remaining8_value block
  · rw [ho, remaining8_value]; exact rank_div_P8_le_256 (rank_lt block)
#print axioms pass_join
#print axioms digits_join
#print axioms eight_digits
end LPk_Induction

import LPk_Induction
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace LPk_Result
open AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds AspisR1.SamplerWordPass
open AspisR1.SamplerRepeatedPass AspisR1.SamplerPass
open AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerPassLoop AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank
open AspisR1GammaCaller.DigitsModel

/-- The low returned native limb is the complete remaining quotient when
its positional value is below one word. -/
theorem low_word (a : Array U32 8#usize)
    (hs : wordValue (words a).reverse < B) :
    (a.val[0]'(by rw [a.property]; decide)).val = wordValue (words a).reverse := by
  rcases a with ⟨xs,hlen⟩
  cases xs with
  | nil => simp at hlen
  | cons x xs =>
    change x.val = wordValue ((x::xs).map decode32).reverse
    change wordValue ((x::xs).map decode32).reverse < B at hs
    have he : wordValue ((x::xs).map decode32).reverse =
        wordValue (xs.map decode32).reverse * B + x.val := by
      simp only [wordValue,numeral,List.map_cons,List.reverse_cons,
        List.map_append,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,List.foldl_append,
        List.foldl_cons,List.foldl_nil,decode32_val]
    have hx : x.val < B := x.bv.isLt
    have hm : wordValue ((x::xs).map decode32).reverse % B = x.val := by
      rw [he,Nat.mul_add_mod_self_right,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx]
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hs] at hm
    exact hm.symm

theorem values_injective (xs ys : List U32)
    (h : xs.map UScalar.val = ys.map UScalar.val) : xs = ys := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => cases ys <;> simp_all
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases ys with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons y ys =>
      have he := List.cons.inj h
      have hxy : x = y := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq he.1
      subst y
      rw [ih ys he.2]

/-- Complete carrier join: the source-shaped step trace, byte decoder, digit
writeback and low-word return give exactly the cohort Result. Only the local
native-step relation and ordered traversal are needed to construct the trace;
no whole native/cohort Result equality is a hypothesis. -/
theorem native_result (block : Array U8 32#usize)
    (digits quotient : Array U32 8#usize)
    (trace : LPk_Induction.Digits 8 (AspisR1.SamplerBytePass.digits block)
      (values digits) (words quotient).reverse) :
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.low_base_p_digits block =
      ok (digits,quotient.val[0]'(by rw [quotient.property]; decide)) := by
  have ht := LPk_Induction.eight_digits trace
  obtain ⟨ds,q,he,hd,hq,hb,hcanon⟩ := LPk_Cohort.all_blocks block
  have hds : ds = digits := Subtype.ext (values_injective _ _ (hd.trans ht.1.symm))
  have hsmall : wordValue (words quotient).reverse < B := by
    have hB : 256 < B := by norm_num [B]
    omega
  have hqeq : q = quotient.val[0]'(by rw [quotient.property]; decide) := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    rw [low_word quotient hsmall]
    exact hq.trans ht.2.1.symm
  rw [hds,hqeq] at he
  exact he
#print axioms low_word
#print axioms values_injective
#print axioms native_result
end LPk_Result

import QueryScanConcreteWordsDecoder
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

namespace XRv_FromFnTotal
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

theorem loop {T F : Type} (N : Usize)
 (callback : core.ops.function.FnMut F Usize T) (value : Nat → T)
 (fuel : Nat) (i : Usize) (f : F) (acc : List T)
 (hi : i.val ≤ N.val) (budget : N.val - i.val ≤ fuel)
 (stable : ∀ j : Usize, j.val < N.val → callback.call_mut f j = ok (value j.val,f)) :
 ∃ out, arrayFromFnLoop N callback fuel i f acc = ok (out,f) := by
 induction fuel generalizing i acc with
 | zero =>
   have hn : ¬ i < N := by simpa only [UScalar.lt_equiv] using (show ¬ i.val < N.val by omega)
   exact ⟨acc.reverse, by simp only [arrayFromFnLoop, hn, ↓reduceDIte]⟩
 | succ fuel ih =>
   by_cases hlt : i < N
   · have hv : i.val < N.val := by simpa only [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt
     have hmax : N.val ≤ Usize.max := by scalar_tac
     have hadd : (i + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = i.val + 1⦄ := by
       apply UScalar.add_spec
       simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, UScalar.max_USize_eq]
       omega
     obtain ⟨j,hj,hv'⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hadd
     obtain ⟨out,hout⟩ := ih j (value i.val :: acc) (by omega) (by omega)
     exact ⟨out, by simp only [arrayFromFnLoop,hlt,↓reduceDIte,stable i hv,bind_tc_ok,hj]; exact hout⟩
   · exact ⟨acc.reverse, by simp only [arrayFromFnLoop,hlt,↓reduceDIte]⟩

theorem total {T F : Type} (N : Usize)
 (callback : core.ops.function.FnMut F Usize T) (value : Nat → T) (f : F)
 (stable : ∀ j : Usize, j.val < N.val → callback.call_mut f j = ok (value j.val,f)) :
 ∃ out, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.core.array.from_fn N callback f = ok out := by
 obtain ⟨out,hout⟩ := loop N callback value (N.val+1) 0#usize f [] (by simp) (by simp) stable
 unfold AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.core.array.from_fn
 split
 · exact ⟨_,rfl⟩
 · rename_i e hfail
   have he := hfail.symm.trans hout
   contradiction
 · rename_i hdiv
   have he := hdiv.symm.trans hout
   contradiction

#print axioms loop
#print axioms total
end XRv_FromFnTotal

theorem ranks (block : Array U8 32#usize) :
 ∃ out, AspisR1QueryScanUnrolled.r0_transcript.block_rank block = ok out := by
 apply XRv_FromFnTotal.total 8#usize _ (blockRankWord block) block

theorem map_stable {T U F : Type} (call : F → T → Result (U × F))
 (f : F) (g : T → U) (xs : List T)
 (stable : ∀ x, call f x = ok (g x,f)) :
 AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime.mapState call xs f = ok (xs.map g,f) := by
 induction xs with
 | nil => rfl
 | cons x xs ih =>
   simp only [AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime.mapState,stable,bind_tc_ok]
   exact congrArg (fun r => r >>= fun (ys,f') => ok (g x :: ys,f')) ih

   AspisR1QueryScanUnrolled.r0_transcript.query_words.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleU32U32.call_mut

   AspisR1QueryScanUnrolled.r0_transcript.query_words.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleU32U32
   r () (r.val.map queryMaskWord) () hm

 rw [hr,bind_tc_ok]
 exact ⟨_,hs⟩

namespace XRn_Join_Bytes
/- XRe_reference.rs:28-38: little-endian words at 4*j, then canonical test.
   XRg_reference.rs:validate_reference: same eight-word test, high half zero.
   Complete 16/32-byte chunks only; the tail is intentionally ignored. -/
def le32 (bs : List U8) : Nat :=
  (bs.take 4).foldr (fun b n => b.val + 256*n) 0

def validChunk (width : Nat) (highZero : Bool) (bs : List U8) : Bool :=
  (List.range width).all fun j =>
    let n := le32 ((bs.drop (4*j)).take 4)
    decide (n < 2147483647) && (!highZero || decide (j < 4 ∨ n = 0))

def chunksValid (size width : Nat) (highZero : Bool) (bs : List U8) : Bool :=
  (List.range (bs.length / size)).all fun i =>
    validChunk width highZero ((bs.drop (size*i)).take size)
end XRn_Join_Bytes

/- P6 OPEN. XRe_reference.rs:28-38, lines 29/30 loop bound -> chunksValid16;
   lines31-33 word parse/test -> validChunk4; lines35-38 -> error/Ok. -/
def compact.check_values (bytes : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit compact.CodecError) :=
  ok (if XRn_Join_Bytes.chunksValid 16 4 false bytes.val then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonical)

/- P6 OPEN. XRe_reference.rs:49-60, lines50-51 chunk loop -> chunksValid32;
   lines52-55 parse8/canonical/high-zero -> validChunk8; lines56-60 -> return. -/
def verifier.echeck (bytes : Slice U8) (k : Bool) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit verifier.Error) :=
  ok (if XRn_Join_Bytes.chunksValid 32 8 k bytes.val then .Ok () else .Err .Parse)

/- P6 OPEN. XRg_reference.rs:validate_reference, whole chunks32 in source order;
   first failing chunk i yields NonCanonical(row,i), matching the reference. -/
def r1_wire.validate_record_fields (row : U8) (bytes : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit r1_wire.Error) := do
  match (List.range (bytes.val.length / 32)).find? (fun i =>
      !(XRn_Join_Bytes.validChunk 8 true ((bytes.val.drop (32*i)).take 32))) with
  | none => ok (.Ok ())
  | some i =>
    dite (i ≤ UScalar.cMax UScalarTy.Usize)
      (fun h => ok (.Err (.NonCanonical row (UScalar.ofNat i h))))
      (fun _ => fail .panic)

/- P6 OPEN. XRe_reference.rs:39-47: alignment short-circuits first; checked
   multiplication matches Rust's overflow behavior. Source low16 copy / high16
   fill is the map on every destination index. No allocator/borrow bridge. -/
def compact.expand_values (bytes out : Slice U8) :
    Result ((core.result.Result Unit compact.CodecError) × Slice U8) := do
  if bytes.val.length % 16 != 0 then
    ok (.Err .Length, out)
  else
    let size ← Slice.len bytes * 2#usize
    if Slice.len out != size then ok (.Err .Length, out)
    else
      let values := (List.range out.val.length).map fun i =>
        if i % 32 < 16 then bytes.val[i/32*16+i%32]?.getD 0#u8 else 0#u8
      dite (values.length ≤ Usize.max)
        (fun bound => ok (.Ok (), ⟨values, bound⟩))
        (fun _ => fail .panic)

    {T U : Type} (_ : core.iter.traits.double_ended.DoubleEndedIterator (core.slice.iter.IterMut T) U)
    (s : core.slice.iter.IterMut T) :

      (core.iter.adapters.map.Map (core.slice.iter.IterMut T) F → core.slice.iter.IterMut T)) :=

    {T B : Type} (f : core.iter.traits.collect.FromIterator B T)
    (s : core.slice.iter.IterMut T) : Result (B × core.slice.iter.IterMut T) := do
  let b ← core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.collect.default (XRn_Join_iterator T) f s
  ok (b,s)
/- Reverse mutation preserves the original slice and writes back the selected
   last element. Source library next_back, slice/iter/macros.rs:438-452. -/
def core.slice.iter.IterMut.Insts.CoreIterTraitsDouble_endedDoubleEndedIteratorMutT.next_back
    {T : Type} (s : core.slice.iter.IterMut T) :
    Result (Option T × core.slice.iter.IterMut T × (core.slice.iter.IterMut T → Option T → core.slice.iter.IterMut T)) := do
  let (v,r) ← core.slice.iter.Iter.Insts.CoreIterTraitsDouble_endedDoubleEndedIteratorSharedT.next_back ⟨s.slice,0#usize⟩
  ok (v,{s with slice := r.slice},fun updated item =>
    match item with
    | none => updated
    | some x =>
      if h : (updated.slice.val ++ [x]).length ≤ Usize.max then
        {updated with slice := ⟨updated.slice.val ++ [x],h⟩}
      else s)

def core.iter.adapters.map.Map.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator.collect
    {B I F B1 T : Type} (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I T)
    (fn : core.ops.function.FnMut F T B) (out : core.iter.traits.collect.FromIterator B1 B)
    (s : core.iter.adapters.map.Map I F) : Result B1 :=
  core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.collect.default
    { next := fun (s : core.iter.adapters.map.Map I F) => do
        let (v,i) ← it.next s.iter
        match v with
        | none => ok (none,{s with iter := i})
        | some v =>
          let (b,f) ← fn.call_mut s.f v
          ok (some b,⟨i,f⟩) } out s

import XRn_Join_ABI
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
open XRn_Join_Release XRn_Join_FieldExternal
/- XRg_decode_reference: row gate, checked usize range, framed[5..],
   then canonical four-limb decoding. Validation token/P6/heap bridge OPEN. -/
def r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.decode_k (N : Usize) (r : r1_wire.ValidatedRecord) (offset : Usize) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Array aspis_core.field.QM31 N) r1_wire.Error) := do
  if r.row < 14#u8 then ok (.Err .InvalidRow) else do
    let start := offset.val * 32
    let size := N.val * 32
    let finish := start + size
    if start > Usize.max ∨ size > Usize.max ∨ finish > Usize.max then ok (.Err (.Length r.row)) else do
      if r.framed.val.length < 5 then fail .panic else do
        let payload := r.framed.val.drop 5
        if finish > payload.length then ok (.Err (.Length r.row)) else do
          let values := (List.range N.val).map fun i =>
            let bs := (payload.drop (start+32*i)).take 16
            let xs := (List.range 4).map fun j => XRn_Join_word ((bs.drop (4*j)).take 4)
            (xs.all (fun x => x < 2147483647#u32),XRn_Join_q xs)
          match (List.range N.val).find? (fun i => !(values[i]?.getD (true,qzero)).1) with
          | some i =>
            dite (offset.val+i ≤ UScalar.cMax .Usize)
              (fun h => ok (.Err (.NonCanonical r.row (UScalar.ofNat (offset.val+i) h))))
              (fun _ => fail .panic)
          | none =>
            let xs := values.map Prod.snd
            dite (xs.length = N.val) (fun h => ok (.Ok ⟨xs,h⟩)) (fun _ => fail .panic)

/- XRg_claims_reference rows[0..2] in order. The owned reference abstracts
   Prefix association and allocation; this model additionally projects the
   actual row25 and decodes the same offsets. P6 OPEN. -/
def r1_semantic.claims (p : r1_wire.Prefix) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Array (Array aspis_core.field.QM31 29#usize) 3#usize) r1_wire.Error) := do
  let framed ← Array.index_usize p.records 25#usize
  let a ← r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.decode_k 29#usize ⟨25#u8,framed⟩ 0#usize
  match a with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok a =>
    let b ← r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.decode_k 29#usize ⟨25#u8,framed⟩ 29#usize
    match b with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
    | .Ok b =>
      let c ← r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.decode_k 29#usize ⟨25#u8,framed⟩ 58#usize
      match c with
      | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
      | .Ok c => ok (.Ok (Array.make 3#usize [a,b,c]))

/- XRg_boundary_reference: coefficient0 appears twice, then 1..27. P6 OPEN. -/
def r1_semantic.semantic_boundary (p : Array aspis_core.field.QM31 28#usize) : Result aspis_core.field.QM31 := do
  let first ← Array.index_usize p 0#usize
  p.val.foldlM aspis_core.field.QM31.add first

/- XRi_reference_wide_view: exact compact offsets and checked slicing.
   Carrier/borrow correspondence and all source P6 remain OPEN. -/
def XRn_Join_sliceRange (bs : Slice U8) (lo hi : Nat) : Result (Slice U8) :=
  if lo ≤ hi ∧ hi ≤ bs.val.length then
    ok ⟨(bs.val.drop lo).take (hi-lo),by
      exact Nat.le_trans (List.length_take_le' _ _) (Nat.le_trans (by simp) bs.property)⟩
  else fail .panic

def verifier.candidate.wide_view (proof semantic y1 : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result verifier.View verifier.Error) := do
  let inactiveBytes ← XRn_Join_sliceRange proof 7495 7527
  let inactive ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes inactiveBytes
  match inactive with
  | none => ok (.Err .Parse)
  | some inactive =>
    let round0 ← XRn_Join_sliceRange proof 7527 7751
    let root ← XRn_Join_sliceRange proof 7751 7783
    let root ← dite (root.val.length = 32) (fun h => ok (⟨root.val,h⟩ : Array U8 32#usize)) (fun _ => fail .panic)
    let round1 ← XRn_Join_sliceRange proof 7783 8007
    let final_message ← XRn_Join_sliceRange proof 8007 10055
    ok (.Ok {
      variant := .S2
      semantic := semantic
      y1 := y1
      inactive := inactive
      round0 := round0
      folded_root := some root
      round1 := round1

import XRn_Join_DecodeModels
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
open XRn_Join_Release XRn_Join_FieldExternal
/- Exact wrapping arithmetic for canonical::Q::raw, fast_pairing.rs:88-101.
   Each operation wraps at u64 exactly as the owned reference. P6 OPEN. -/
def XRn_Join_wrap64 (n : Nat) : Nat := n % 18446744073709551616
def XRn_Join_sub64 (a b : Nat) : Nat := XRn_Join_wrap64 (a + 18446744073709551616 - b)
def XRn_Join_partial (n : Nat) : Nat := XRn_Join_wrap64 (n % 2147483648 + n/2147483648)
def XRn_Join_raw (x y : fast_pairing.canonical.Q) : List Nat :=
  let a := (x.val[0]?.getD 0#u32).val; let b := (x.val[1]?.getD 0#u32).val
  let c := (x.val[2]?.getD 0#u32).val; let d := (x.val[3]?.getD 0#u32).val
  let e := (y.val[0]?.getD 0#u32).val; let f := (y.val[1]?.getD 0#u32).val
  let g := (y.val[2]?.getD 0#u32).val; let h := (y.val[3]?.getD 0#u32).val
  let pp := 2147483647*2147483647
  let u := XRn_Join_partial (XRn_Join_sub64 (XRn_Join_wrap64 (c*g+pp)) (d*h))
  let v := XRn_Join_partial (XRn_Join_wrap64 (c*h+d*g))
  [XRn_Join_sub64 (XRn_Join_wrap64 (XRn_Join_sub64 (XRn_Join_wrap64 (a*e+pp)) (b*f)+2*u+3*2147483647)) v,
   XRn_Join_wrap64 (a*f+b*e+u+2*v),
   XRn_Join_sub64 (XRn_Join_sub64 (XRn_Join_wrap64 (a*g+c*e+2*pp)) (b*h)) (d*f),
   XRn_Join_wrap64 (a*h+b*g+c*f+d*e)]
def XRn_Join_u64 (n : Nat) : U64 := UScalar.ofNat (XRn_Join_wrap64 n) (by change _ ≤ 18446744073709551615; unfold XRn_Join_wrap64; omega)
/- XRg_dot_reference: four independent folded wrapping sum updates. P6 OPEN. -/
def fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push (s : fast_pairing.canonical.Dot) (a b : fast_pairing.canonical.Q) :
    Result fast_pairing.canonical.Dot :=
  let raw := XRn_Join_raw a b
  let xs := (List.range 4).map fun i => XRn_Join_u64
    ((s.sums.val[i]?.getD 0#u64).val + XRn_Join_partial (raw[i]?.getD 0))
  if h : xs.length = 4 then ok ⟨⟨xs,h⟩⟩ else fail .panic

def XRn_Join_dotFinish (d : fast_pairing.canonical.Dot) : Result aspis_core.field.QM31 := do
  let xs ← d.sums.val.mapM aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64
  ok (XRn_Join_q xs)
def XRn_Join_usize (n : Nat) : Usize := UScalar.ofNat (n % (UScalar.cMax .Usize+1)) (by exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.mod_lt n (Nat.succ_pos _)))
def XRn_Join_toQ (q : aspis_core.field.QM31) : fast_pairing.canonical.Q :=
  Array.make 4#usize [q.c0.a,q.c0.b,q.c1.a,q.c1.b]
def XRn_Join_dotZero : fast_pairing.canonical.Dot := ⟨Array.make 4#usize [0#u64,0#u64,0#u64,0#u64]⟩
def XRn_Join_powers (x : XRn_Join_Wide) : Nat → XRn_Join_Wide → Result (List XRn_Join_Wide)
  | 0,_ => ok []
  | 1,p => ok [p]
  | n+2,p => do
    let next ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul p x
    let rest ← XRn_Join_powers x (n+1) next
    ok (p::rest)
def XRn_Join_preparedPart {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8)
    (g : Array XRn_Join_Wide 29#usize) (point : Nat) : Result (Option XRn_Join_Wide) := do
  let state ← (List.range 29).foldlM (fun (state : Option (fast_pairing.canonical.Dot × fast_pairing.canonical.Dot)) l => do
    match state with
    | none => ok none
    | some (a,b) =>
      let scalar ← if point < 3 then do
          let row ← Array.index_usize sem.claims (XRn_Join_usize point)
          Array.index_usize row (XRn_Join_usize l)
        else if point = 3 then Array.index_usize sem.extra (XRn_Join_usize l)
        else if point = 4 then Array.index_usize sem.before_z1 (XRn_Join_usize l)
        else do
          let bytes ← XRn_Join_sliceRange y1 (32*l) (32*l+32)
          let e ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes bytes
          match e with
          | some e => ok (newQ e.c0)
          | none => fail .panic
      if !(scalar.c0.a < 2147483647#u32 && scalar.c0.b < 2147483647#u32 && scalar.c1.a < 2147483647#u32 && scalar.c1.b < 2147483647#u32) then ok none
      else do
        let v ← Array.index_usize g (XRn_Join_usize l)
        let a ← fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push a (XRn_Join_toQ (newQ v.c0)) (XRn_Join_toQ scalar)
        let b ← fast_pairing.canonical.Dot.push b (XRn_Join_toQ (newQ v.c1)) (XRn_Join_toQ scalar)
        ok (some (a,b))) (some (XRn_Join_dotZero,XRn_Join_dotZero))
  match state with
  | none => ok none
  | some (a,b) => do
    let a ← XRn_Join_dotFinish a
    let b ← XRn_Join_dotFinish b
    ok (some (⟨oldQ a,oldQ b⟩ : XRn_Join_Wide))
/- XRi_reference_prepared_claim: six scalar branches, 29 checked dot pushes,
   seven kappa powers and weighted parts; release trace is erased. P6 OPEN. -/
def verifier.prepared_claim {H : Type} (_ : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8) (inactive : XRn_Join_Wide)
    (g : Array XRn_Join_Wide 29#usize) (kappa : XRn_Join_Wide) :
    Result (core.result.Result XRn_Join_Wide verifier.Error) := do
  let one ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ONE
  let zero ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO
  let powers ← XRn_Join_powers kappa 7 one
  let parts ← (List.range 6).foldlM (fun (parts : Option (List XRn_Join_Wide)) point => do
    match parts with
    | none => ok none
    | some parts =>
      let p ← XRn_Join_preparedPart sem y1 g point
      ok (p.map (fun p => parts ++ [p]))) (some [])
  match parts with
  | none => ok (.Err .Parse)
  | some parts => do
    let parts := inactive :: parts
    let result ← (powers.zip parts).foldlM (fun sum (k,p) => do
      let term ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul k p
      aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add sum term) zero
    ok (.Ok result)

import XRn_Join_DotModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error

/- Algebraic field model. P6 with the fixed source inverse chain OPEN. -/
def XRn_Join_qpow (x : aspis_core.field.QM31) : Nat → Result aspis_core.field.QM31
  | 0 => ok qone
  | n+1 => do
    let y ← XRn_Join_qpow x (n/2)
    let z ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul y y
    if n%2 = 0 then aspis_core.field.QM31.mul z x else ok z
termination_by n => n
/- circle.rs:30-69: singularity first, then CM31 rejection. This is a
   transparent mathematical external, not a source inverse/P6 theorem. -/
def aspis_core.circle.secure_ood_circle_point_from_parameter (t : aspis_core.field.QM31) :
    Result (core.result.Result aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint aspis_core.circle.CirclePointError) := do
  let square ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul t t
  let den ← aspis_core.field.QM31.add qone square
  if qeq den qzero then ok (.Err .SingularParameter) else do
    let inverse ← XRn_Join_qpow den (2147483647^4-2)
    let numerator ← XRn_Join_Field.field.QM31.sub qone square
    let x ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul numerator inverse
    let twice ← aspis_core.field.QM31.add t t
    let y ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul twice inverse
    if (t.c1.a == 0#u32 && t.c1.b == 0#u32) then ok (.Err .ParameterInCm31Subfield)
    else ok (.Ok ⟨x,y⟩)
/- XRg_fallback_reference: row chooses t=u or t=1+u; same fall-through
   default if the rational map rejects. Capture/move/borrow/P6 OPEN. -/
def sampler.circle_sample.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleCirclePointErrorSecureCirclePoint.call_once
    (row : sampler.circle_sample.closure) (_ : aspis_core.circle.CirclePointError) :
    Result aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint := do
  let t : aspis_core.field.QM31 := match row with
    | .First => ⟨⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩,⟨1#u32,0#u32⟩⟩
    | .Second => ⟨⟨1#u32,0#u32⟩,⟨1#u32,0#u32⟩⟩
  let point ← aspis_core.circle.secure_ood_circle_point_from_parameter t
  match point with
  | .Ok p => ok p
  | .Err _ => ok ⟨qone,qzero⟩

import XRn_Join_CircleModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
open XRn_Join_Release XRn_Join_FieldExternal
/- XRi_reference_checkpoint: serializer and three ordered digest applications.
   Capacity/allocator/ownership, source and emitted-carrier P6 OPEN. -/
def XRn_Join_asSlice (xs : List U8) : Result (Slice U8) :=
  if h : xs.length ≤ Usize.max then ok ⟨xs,h⟩ else fail .panic
def XRn_Join_digest {H : Type} (d : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (h : H) (xs : List (Slice U8)) : Result (Array U8 32#usize) :=
  if bound : xs.length ≤ Usize.max then d.digest h ⟨xs,bound⟩ else fail .panic

def verifier.checkpoint {H : Type} (d : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator) (proof pub : Slice U8) (hash : H) :
    Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) := do
  let proofHash ← XRn_Join_digest d hash [proof]
  let publicHash ← XRn_Join_digest d hash [pub]
  let variant : U8 := match p.variant with | .S1 => 1#u8 | .S2 => 2#u8 | .D => 3#u8
  let next : U8 := UScalar.ofNat (a.next.val%256) (by change _ ≤ 255; omega)
  let wideBytes ← [p.gamma,p.kappa,p.alpha.val[0]?.getD p.gamma,p.alpha.val[1]?.getD p.gamma,p.claim,a.rhs].mapM
    aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes
  let initialWide := (wideBytes.take 4).flatMap Subtype.val
  let finalWide := (wideBytes.drop 4).flatMap Subtype.val
  let bs :=
    [82#u8,49#u8,80#u8,50#u8,67#u8,75#u8,80#u8,50#u8] ++
    [variant,next,1#u8,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8,0#u8] ++
    proofHash.val ++ publicHash.val ++ p.state.val ++
    p.roots.val.flatMap Subtype.val ++ initialWide ++ XRn_Join_qBytes p.rho ++
    p.queries.val.flatMap XRn_Join_wordBytes ++ p.semantic_alpha.val.flatMap XRn_Join_qBytes ++
    p.z.val.flatMap (fun z => XRn_Join_qBytes z.x ++ XRn_Join_qBytes z.y) ++
    finalWide ++ XRn_Join_qBytes a.power ++ a.weights.val.flatMap XRn_Join_qBytes
  let payload ← XRn_Join_asSlice bs
  let label : Slice U8 := ⟨[85#u8,78#u8,80#u8,82#u8,79#u8,86#u8,69#u8,68#u8,58#u8,82#u8,49#u8,58#u8,99#u8,104#u8,101#u8,99#u8,107#u8,112#u8,111#u8,105#u8,110#u8,116#u8],by scalar_tac⟩
  let checksum ← XRn_Join_digest d hash [label,payload]
  let out := bs ++ checksum.val
  let size := if p.variant matches .S1 then 4840 else 1768
  if out.length = size then XRn_Join_asSlice out else fail .panic

/- Library models use explicit ordered messages; source/P6 and allocation OPEN. -/
def aspis_core.r0.heap.filled {T : Type} (_ : core.marker.Copy T) (n : Usize) (v : T) :
    Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec T) aspis_core.r0.Error) :=
  dite (n.val ≤ Usize.max) (fun h => ok (.Ok ⟨List.replicate n.val v,by simpa only [List.length_replicate] using h⟩)) (fun _ => ok (.Err .Allocation))
def aspis_core.r0.merkle.parent_with_digest {H : Type} (d : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (h : H) (children : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize) : Result (Array U8 32#usize) :=
  XRn_Join_digest d h (⟨[24#u8],by scalar_tac⟩ :: children.val.map Array.to_slice)
def aspis_core.state_only_private_merkle.private_leaf_hash_with_digest {H : Type}
    (d : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (h : H) (tag : U8) (v : Slice U8) (salt : Array U8 32#usize) :
    Result (Array U8 32#usize) :=
  XRn_Join_digest d h [⟨[16#u8,tag],by scalar_tac⟩,v,salt.to_slice]

import XRn_Join_CheckpointModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
open XRn_Join_Release
/- r0_transcript.rs QueryScan: the stop test is before each word, never after
   the eighth. Retains duplicate rejection and the selected advance block.
   P6/source/log association OPEN. -/
def XRn_Join_scanWord (s : List U32 × Nat × Bool) (word : U32) : List U32 × Nat × Bool :=
  let (accepted,draws,stopped) := s
  if stopped then s
  else if accepted.length = 22 ∨ draws = 64 then (accepted,draws,true)
  else (if word ∈ accepted then accepted else accepted ++ [word], draws+1,false)
def aspis_core.r0_transcript.queries_from_pairs
    (blocks advances : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Array U32 22#usize × Array U8 32#usize) aspis_core.transcript.QuerySampleError) := do
  let (accepted,draws,_,state) ← (List.range 8).foldlM
    (fun (s : List U32 × Nat × Bool × Array U8 32#usize) i => do
      let (accepted,draws,stopped,state) := s
      if stopped then ok s else do
        let block ← Array.index_usize blocks (XRn_Join_usize i)
        let advance ← Array.index_usize advances (XRn_Join_usize i)
        let words := (List.range 8).map fun j =>
          UScalar.ofNat ((XRn_Join_word ((block.val.drop (4*j)).take 4)).val % 262144)
            (by change _ ≤ 4294967295; omega)
        let (accepted,draws,stop) := words.foldl XRn_Join_scanWord (accepted,draws,false)
        ok (accepted,draws,stop,advance))
    ([],0,false,advances.val[7]?.getD (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8))
  dite (accepted.length = 22)
    (fun h => ok (.Ok (⟨accepted,h⟩,state)))
    (fun _ => ok (.Err (.DrawLimitExhausted (XRn_Join_usize accepted.length) 64#usize)))

import XRn_Join_QueryModel
import QueryScanConcreteWordsDecoder
import ExtractedRecordByteValue
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRt_QueryWord

theorem four (a b c d : U8) :
 XRn_Join_word [a,b,c,d] = core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) := by
 apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
 have hv := AspisR1.ExtractedRecordByteValue.from_le4_value a b c d
 change XRn_Join_Bytes.le32 [a,b,c,d] % 4294967296 = _
 simp only [XRn_Join_Bytes.le32,List.take_succ_cons,List.take_zero,List.foldr_cons,List.foldr_nil]
 have ha : a.val < 256 := by scalar_tac
 have hb : b.val < 256 := by scalar_tac
 have hc : c.val < 256 := by scalar_tac
 have hd : d.val < 256 := by scalar_tac
 omega

theorem slice_four (xs : List U8) (n : Nat) (h : n+4 ≤ xs.length) :
 (xs.drop n).take 4 = [xs[n],xs[n+1],xs[n+2],xs[n+3]] := by
 apply List.ext_getElem
 · simp only [List.length_take,List.length_drop,List.length_cons,List.length_nil]
   omega
 · intro i hi hj
   have hi4 : i < 4 := by simpa using hj
   interval_cases i <;> simp <;> rfl

theorem block_word (b : Array U8 32#usize) (j : Nat) (hj : j < 8) :
 XRn_Join_word ((b.val.drop (4*j)).take 4) =
 AspisR1QueryScanUnrolled.r0_transcript.blockRankWord b j := by
 have hlen : b.val.length = 32 := b.property
 rw [slice_four b.val (4*j) (by omega)]
 unfold AspisR1QueryScanUnrolled.r0_transcript.blockRankWord
 rw [dif_pos hj]
 exact four _ _ _ _

theorem mask (w : U32) :
 UScalar.ofNat (w.val % 262144) (by change _ ≤ 4294967295; omega) =
 AspisR1QueryScanUnrolled.r0_transcript.queryMaskWord w := by
 apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
 change w.val % 262144 = w.val &&& 262143
 exact (Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod w.val 18).symm

#print axioms four
#print axioms slice_four
#print axioms block_word
#print axioms mask
end XRt_QueryWord

 AspisR1QueryScanUnrolled.r0_transcript.query_words b = ok (decoded b) := by
