def r1_wire.row_shape
  (row : Std.U8) : Result (Option (Std.U8 × Std.Usize)) := do
  match row with
  | 0#uscalar => ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))
  | 1#uscalar => ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))
  | 2#uscalar => ok (some (1#u8, 32#usize))
  | 14#uscalar => ok (some (3#u8, 32#usize))
  | 25#uscalar =>
    let i ← r1_wire.CLAIMS
    let i1 ← i + r1_wire.LANES
    let i2 ← i1 * 32#usize
    ok (some (4#u8, i2))
  | 26#uscalar => let i ← r1_wire.LANES * 32#usize
                  ok (some (5#u8, i))
  | _ =>
    if 3#u8 <= row
    then
      if row <= 13#u8
      then ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))
      else
        if 15#u8 <= row
        then
          if row <= 24#u8
          then let i ← 28#usize * 32#usize
               ok (some (2#u8, i))
          else ok none
        else ok none
    else
      if 15#u8 <= row
      then
        if row <= 24#u8
        then let i ← 28#usize * 32#usize
             ok (some (2#u8, i))
        else ok none
      else ok none

def arr {A B : Type} {N : Usize} (f : A → B) (a : Array A N) : Array B N :=

def eq := XRn_Join_FieldExternal.newQ
def cv : E.V → C.V | .S1 => .S1 | .S2 => .S2 | .D => .D
def ev : C.V → E.V | .S1 => .S1 | .S2 => .S2 | .D => .D
def cp (p : E.Point) : C.Point := ⟨cq p.x,cq p.y⟩
def ep (p : C.Point) : E.Point := ⟨eq p.x,eq p.y⟩
def cc (s : E.Challenges) : C.Challenges :=
  ⟨cq s.lambda,cq s.chi,cq s.theta,arr cq s.zc,cq s.mu,cq s.eta⟩
def ec (s : C.Challenges) : E.Challenges :=
  ⟨eq s.lambda,eq s.chi,eq s.theta,arr eq s.zc,eq s.mu,eq s.eta⟩
def cst {H : Type} (s : E.ST H) : C.ST H := ⟨s.state,s.hash,s.next_row⟩
def est {H : Type} (s : C.ST H) : E.ST H := ⟨s.state,s.hash,s.next_row⟩
def ct {H : Type} (s : E.T H) : C.T H := ⟨s.state,s.hash⟩
def et {H : Type} (s : C.T H) : E.T H := ⟨s.state,s.hash⟩

  ⟨s.roots,cc s.challenges,arr cq s.alpha,arr (arr cq) s.claims,
    arr cq s.extra,arr cq s.before_z1,s.state_before_z0,arr cp s.z,cst s.transcript⟩

  ⟨s.roots,ec s.challenges,arr eq s.alpha,arr (arr eq) s.claims,
    arr eq s.extra,arr eq s.before_z1,s.state_before_z0,arr ep s.z,est s.transcript⟩
def cview (v : E.View) : C.View :=
  ⟨cv v.variant,v.semantic,v.y1,v.inactive,v.round0,v.folded_root,v.round1,v.final_message,v.query_bytes⟩

    arr cq p.semantic_alpha,arr cp p.z,p.claim,p.state⟩

  ⟨ev p.variant,p.roots,p.gamma,p.kappa,p.alpha,eq p.rho,p.queries,
    arr eq p.semantic_alpha,arr ep p.z,p.claim,p.state⟩

 | .Parse => .Parse | .Semantic => .Semantic | .Transcript => .Transcript
 | .Relation => .Relation | .Merkle => .Merkle | .Query => .Query
 | .Checkpoint => .Checkpoint | .Allocation => .Allocation

 (h : ∀ x,g (f x)=x) (a : Array A N) : arr g (arr f a)=a := by
 apply Subtype.ext

 have fg : g ∘ f = id := funext h
 rw [fg,List.map_id]

@[simp] theorem et_ct {H : Type} (s : E.T H) : et (ct s)=s := by cases s; rfl
@[simp] theorem cs_es {H : Type} (s : C.Sem H) : cs (es s)=s := by cases s; simp [cs,es]
@[simp] theorem es_cs {H : Type} (s : E.Sem H) : es (cs s)=s := by cases s; simp [cs,es]
@[simp] theorem cview_eview (v : C.View) : cview (eview v)=v := by cases v; simp [cview,eview]

@[simp] theorem eprepared_cprepared (p : E.Prepared) : eprepared (cprepared p)=p := by cases p; simp [cprepared,eprepared]

@[simp] theorem ed_cd {H : Type} (d : E.D H) : ed (cd d)=d := by cases d; rfl

@[simp] theorem ee_ce (e : E.Err) : ee (ce e)=e := by cases e <;> rfl

theorem mapR_bind {A B F : Type} (f : B → F) (r : Result A) (k : A → Result B) :
 mapR f (r >>= k) = r >>= (fun a=>mapR f (k a)) := by cases r <;> rfl

theorem nested_roundtrip (r : Result (core.result.Result E.Prepared E.Err)) :
 mapR (inner eprepared ee) (mapR (inner cprepared ce) r)=r := by
 cases r with

 | fail e => rfl

theorem map_ok {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (a : A) : mapR f (ok a)=ok (f a) := rfl
theorem map_fail {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (e : Aeneas.Std.Error) : mapR f (.fail e)=.fail e := rfl

 (k : B → Result F) (h : A → Result F) :

 match p with | .Continue b=>mapR f (k b) | .Break a=>mapR f (h a) := by cases p <;> rfl

 (k : A → Result F) (h : B → Result F) :
 mapR f (match p with | .Ok a=>k a | .Err b=>h b)=
 match p with | .Ok a=>mapR f (k a) | .Err b=>mapR f (h b) := by cases p <;> rfl

theorem map_comp {A B F : Type} (f : A → B) (g : B → F) (r : Result A) :

 (r s : Result A) (h : mapR f r=mapR f s) : r=s := by
 cases r <;> cases s <;> simp only [mapR,bind_tc_ok,bind_tc_fail,bind_tc_div] at h ⊢

import XRo_Join_OrdinaryDecode
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRo_Join_Carriers XRo_Join_ResultTransport
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace XRq_SamplerInterface
/-- The excluded native leaf has its original complete Result carrier. -/
abbrev Low := Array U8 32#usize → Result (Array U32 8#usize × U32)
/-- Exact emitted ordinary continuation, with only the excluded leaf abstracted. -/
def ordinary (low : Low) (block : Array U8 32#usize) : Result C.E := do
  let (digits,_) ← low block
  XRn_Join_Release.sampler.decode8 digits
/-- Exact emitted gamma continuation; add and decode are still emitted bodies. -/
def gamma (low : Low) (block : Array U8 32#usize) : Result C.E := do
  let (digits,quotient) ← low block
  let i ← quotient + 1#u32
  let (wrapped,digits1) ← XRn_Join_Release.sampler.add_small_base_p digits i
  let digits2 ← if wrapped then do
    let (_,digits3) ← XRn_Join_Release.sampler.add_small_base_p digits1 1#u32
    ok digits3
    else ok digits1
  XRn_Join_Release.sampler.decode8 digits2

theorem raw_ordinary (block : Array U8 32#usize) :
 ordinary XRn_Join_Release.sampler.low_base_p_digits block =
 XRn_Join_Release.sampler.ordinary_sample block := rfl

theorem raw_gamma (block : Array U8 32#usize) :
 gamma XRn_Join_Release.sampler.low_base_p_digits block =
 XRn_Join_Release.sampler.gamma_sample block := rfl

/-- Complete Result equality for every block; this uses the cohort leaf,
not the defective emitted low sampler. Native P6 remains LPk_'s obligation. -/
theorem ordinary_cohort (block : Array U8 32#usize) :
 ordinary AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.low_base_p_digits block =
 XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling.ordinary block := by
 rw [XRo_Join_OrdinaryDecode.ordinary_slot]
 unfold ordinary AspisR1Post25SamplerOrdinaryCallbackV2.candidateOrdinaryPublic
   AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.ordinary_sample
 change _ = mapR AspisR1Post25SamplerPreparedCarrier.candidateToPE _
 simp only [mapR_bind]
 apply congrArg (fun k => AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.low_base_p_digits block >>= k)
 funext p
 exact (XRo_Join_OrdinaryDecode.decode p.1).symm

/-- Transport a proved native leaf equality; the premise is solely the leaf,
not the desired ordinary output. No native implementation is invented here. -/
theorem ordinary_native (native : Low)
 (leaf : ∀ block, native block = AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.low_base_p_digits block)
 (block : Array U8 32#usize) :
 ordinary native block = XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling.ordinary block := by
 unfold ordinary
 rw [leaf block]
 exact ordinary_cohort block

#print axioms raw_ordinary
#print axioms raw_gamma
#print axioms ordinary_cohort
#print axioms ordinary_native
end XRq_SamplerInterface

 (t : E.T H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) (nonzero : Bool) : Result (C.E × E.T H) := do

       AspisR1PublicPreparation.trace.value 4#u16 i out

import XRo_Join_Installed
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRp_CheckedWrapping

theorem add (a b : U32) (h : a.val + b.val < 4294967296) :
    a + b = ok (U32.wrapping_add a b) := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (UScalar.add_spec (x:=a) (y:=b) (by scalar_tac))
  have hw := UScalar.wrapping_add_val_eq a b
  simp only [UScalar.size_def, UScalarTy.numBits] at hw
  change (U32.wrapping_add a b).val = (a.val+b.val) % 4294967296 at hw
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h] at hw
  exact hz.trans (congrArg ok (UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (hv.trans hw.symm)))

theorem sub (a b : U32) (h : b.val ≤ a.val) :
    a - b = ok (U32.wrapping_sub a b) := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.sub_spec (x:=a) (y:=b) h)
  have hw := UScalar.wrapping_sub_val_eq a b
  simp only [UScalar.size_def, UScalarTy.numBits] at hw
  change (U32.wrapping_sub a b).val = (a.val+(4294967296-b.val)) % 4294967296 at hw
  have hb : b.val ≤ 4294967295 := by scalar_tac
  have ha : a.val ≤ 4294967295 := by scalar_tac
  have he : a.val + (4294967296-b.val) = 4294967296 + (a.val-b.val) := by omega
  have hl : a.val-b.val < 4294967296 := by omega
  rw [he,Nat.add_mod,Nat.mod_self,zero_add,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hl] at hw
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hl] at hw
  exact hz.trans (congrArg ok (UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (hv.trans hw.symm)))

#print axioms add
#print axioms sub
end XRp_CheckedWrapping

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRp_PowersScalar

theorem add (a b : U32) (ha : a.val < 2147483647) (hb : b.val < 2147483647) :
    XRn_Join_Field.field.M31.add a b = AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.add a b := by
  have had := XRp_CheckedWrapping.add a b (by omega)
  unfold XRn_Join_Field.field.M31.add AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.add
  unfold XRn_Join_Field.field.P AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.P
  rw [had]
  change (if U32.wrapping_add a b ≥ 2147483647#u32 then
    ok (U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add a b) 2147483647#u32) else ok (U32.wrapping_add a b)) =
    (if U32.wrapping_add a b ≥ 2147483647#u32 then do
      let z ← U32.wrapping_add a b - 2147483647#u32
      ok z
    else ok (U32.wrapping_add a b))
  by_cases hs : U32.wrapping_add a b ≥ 2147483647#u32
  · simp only [if_pos hs]
    rw [XRp_CheckedWrapping.sub _ _ (by scalar_tac)]
    rfl
  · simp only [if_neg hs]

import XRp_PowersScalar
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRp_PowersScalarSub

def wrappingNormalize (x : U32) : Result U32 :=
  if x ≥ 2147483647#u32 then ok (U32.wrapping_sub x 2147483647#u32) else ok x
def checkedNormalize (x : U32) : Result U32 :=
  if x ≥ 2147483647#u32 then do let r ← x-2147483647#u32; ok r else ok x

theorem normalize (x : U32) : wrappingNormalize x = checkedNormalize x := by
  unfold wrappingNormalize checkedNormalize
  by_cases h : x ≥ 2147483647#u32
  · simp only [if_pos h]
    rw [XRp_CheckedWrapping.sub _ _ (by scalar_tac)]
    rfl
  · simp only [if_neg h]

def wrappingSub (x y : U32) := wrappingNormalize (U32.wrapping_sub x y)
def checkedSub (x y : U32) : Result U32 := do let s ← x-y; checkedNormalize s

theorem subtract (x y : U32) (hy : y.val ≤ x.val) : wrappingSub x y = checkedSub x y := by
  unfold checkedSub
  rw [XRp_CheckedWrapping.sub _ _ hy]
  change wrappingNormalize (U32.wrapping_sub x y) = checkedNormalize (U32.wrapping_sub x y)
  exact normalize _

theorem source (a b : U32) : XRn_Join_Field.field.M31.sub a b =
    wrappingSub (U32.wrapping_add a 2147483647#u32) b := by
  simp only [XRn_Join_Field.field.M31.sub,XRn_Join_Field.field.P,
    lift,bind_tc_ok,wrappingSub,wrappingNormalize]

theorem target (a b : U32) : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub a b =
    (do let x ← a+2147483647#u32; checkedSub x b) := by
  unfold AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.P
  rfl

#print axioms normalize
#print axioms subtract
#print axioms source
#print axioms target
end XRp_PowersScalarSub

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRp_ReversePass
open XRp_ReverseStep XRp_ReverseBodies
abbrev State := Iter × Back × U64
def step (s : State) := body s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2
def limbs (n : Nat) : List U32 := [2147483647#u32] ++ List.replicate n 0#u32
theorem bound (n : Nat) (h : n ≤ 7) : (limbs n).length ≤ Usize.max := by
  have hm : 8 ≤ Usize.max := by scalar_tac
  simp only [limbs, List.length_append, List.length_singleton, List.length_replicate]
  omega
def state (n : Nat) (h : n ≤ 7) := mk (limbs n) (bound n h)
def finish : (n : Nat) → n ≤ 7 → Back → Back
  | 0,h,b => fun r => b (restore (state 0 h) 2147483647#u32 r)
  | n+1,h,b => finish n (by omega) (fun r => b (restore (state (n+1) h) 0#u32 r))

theorem loop_pass (n : Nat) (h : n ≤ 7) (back : Back) :
    loop step (state n h, back, 0#u64) = ok (0#u64,finish n h back) := by
  induction n generalizing back with
  | zero =>
    rw [loop.eq_def]
    have hp := prime [] (bound 0 h) (by simp) back
    change body (state 0 h) back 0#u64 = _ at hp
    change (match body (state 0 h) back 0#u64 with
      | ok (.cont s) => loop step s
      | ok (.done v) => ok v
      | fail e => fail e
      | div => div) = _
    rw [hp]
    change loop step (mk [] (by simp),finish 0 h back,0#u64) = _
    rw [loop.eq_def]
    change (match body (mk [] (by simp)) (finish 0 h back) 0#u64 with
      | ok (.cont s) => loop step s
      | ok (.done v) => ok v
      | fail e => fail e
      | div => div) = _
    rw [empty]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn : n ≤ 7 := by omega
    have hl : limbs (n+1) = limbs n ++ [0#u32] := by
      simp [limbs,List.replicate_succ',List.append_assoc]
    have hz := zero (limbs n) (by rw [← hl]; exact bound (n+1) h) (bound n hn) back
    have hs : mk (limbs n ++ [0#u32]) (by rw [← hl]; exact bound (n+1) h) = state (n+1) h := by
      apply congrArg (fun xs : Slice U32 => (⟨⟨xs,0⟩⟩ : Iter))
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hl.symm
    rw [hs] at hz
    rw [loop.eq_def]
    change (match body (state (n+1) h) back 0#u64 with
      | ok (.cont s) => loop step s
      | ok (.done v) => ok v
      | fail e => fail e
      | div => div) = _
    rw [hz]
    exact ih hn _

#print axioms bound
#print axioms loop_pass
end XRp_ReversePass

def appendIter (r : Iter) (xs : List U32)
    (h : (r.iter.slice.val ++ xs).length ≤ Usize.max) : Iter :=
  ⟨{r.iter with slice := ⟨r.iter.slice.val ++ xs,h⟩}⟩

theorem finish_append (n : Nat) (hn : n ≤ 7) (back : Back) (r : Iter)
    (hcap : (r.iter.slice.val ++ limbs n).length ≤ Usize.max) :
    finish n hn back r = back (appendIter r (limbs n) hcap) := by
  induction n generalizing back with
  | zero =>
    change back (restore (state 0 hn) 2147483647#u32 r) = _
    unfold restore appendIter
    have hc : (r.iter.slice.val ++ [2147483647#u32]).length ≤ Usize.max := hcap
    rw [dif_pos hc]
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn' : n ≤ 7 := by omega
    have hlist : limbs (n+1) = limbs n ++ [0#u32] := by
      simp [limbs,List.replicate_succ']
    have hsmall : (r.iter.slice.val ++ limbs n).length ≤ Usize.max := by
      rw [hlist,List.length_append,List.length_append,List.length_singleton] at hcap
      simp only [List.length_append]
      omega
    rw [finish,ih hn' _ hsmall]
    simp only [restore,appendIter]
    have hnext : ((r.iter.slice.val ++ limbs n) ++ [0#u32]).length ≤ Usize.max := by
      simpa only [hlist,List.append_assoc] using hcap
    rw [dif_pos hnext]
    simp only [hlist,List.append_assoc]

end XRp_RestoreChain

XRp_FromFnState.source:
import XRn_Join_ABI
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRp_FromFnState

/-- A bounded indexed traversal. The final iteration does not increment the
index, matching the actual library fromFnList's overflow/error behavior. -/
def indexed {T F : Type} (fn : core.ops.function.FnMut F Usize T) :
    Nat → Usize → F → List T → Result (List T × F)
  | 0, _, c, out => ok (out,c)
  | fuel + 1, i, c, out => do
    let (v,c') ← fn.call_mut c i
    match fuel with
    | 0 => ok (out ++ [v],c')
    | rest + 1 => do
      let next ← i + 1#usize
      indexed fn (rest + 1) next c' (out ++ [v])

theorem indexed_eq {T F : Type} (fn : core.ops.function.FnMut F Usize T)
    (fuel : Nat) (i : Usize) (c : F) (out : List T) :
    indexed fn fuel i c out = (do
      let (xs,c') ← core.array.fromFnList fn fuel i c
      ok (out ++ xs,c')) := by
  induction fuel generalizing i c out with
  | zero => simp [indexed, core.array.fromFnList]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [indexed, core.array.fromFnList]
    cases hc : fn.call_mut c i with
    | fail e => simp [hc]
    | div => simp [hc]
    | ok vc =>
      rcases vc with ⟨v,c'⟩
      simp only [hc, bind_tc_ok]
      cases fuel with
      | zero => simp
      | succ rest =>
        cases hn : i + 1#usize with
        | fail e => simp [hn]
        | div => simp [hn]
        | ok next =>
          simp only [hn, bind_tc_ok]
          change indexed fn (rest + 1) next c' (out ++ [v]) = _
          rw [ih]
          cases hs : core.array.fromFnList fn (rest + 1) next c' with
          | fail e => simp [hs]
          | div => simp [hs]
          | ok xs => rcases xs with ⟨xs,c''⟩; simp [hs, List.append_assoc]

theorem from_fn_state_eq {T F : Type} (fn : core.ops.function.FnMut F Usize T)
    (N : Usize) (c : F) :
    XRn_Join_fromFnState N fn c = (do
      let (xs,c') ← indexed fn N.val 0#usize c []
      dite (xs.length = N.val) (fun h => ok (⟨xs,h⟩,c')) (fun _ => fail .panic)) := by
  rw [indexed_eq]
  unfold XRn_Join_fromFnState
  cases h : core.array.fromFnList fn N.val 0#usize c with
  | fail e => simp [h]
  | div => simp [h]
  | ok xs => rcases xs with ⟨xs,c'⟩; simp [h]

#print axioms indexed_eq
#print axioms from_fn_state_eq
end XRp_FromFnState

import XRp_FromFnState
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRp_FromFnConstant

theorem constant {T F : Type} (fn : core.ops.function.FnMut F Usize T)
    (c : F) (v : T) (same : ∀ i,fn.call_mut c i = ok (v,c))
    (fuel : Nat) (i : Usize) (bound : i.val + fuel ≤ Usize.max) :
    core.array.fromFnList fn fuel i c = ok (List.replicate fuel v,c) := by
  induction fuel generalizing i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [core.array.fromFnList,same]
    cases fuel with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n =>
      obtain ⟨j,hj,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
        (UScalar.add_spec (x:=i) (y:=1#usize) (by scalar_tac))
      have hbound : j.val + (n+1) ≤ Usize.max := by
        change j.val = i.val + 1 at hv
        omega
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      change (do
        let next ← i + 1#usize
        let (xs,c') ← core.array.fromFnList fn (n+1) next c
        ok (v::xs,c')) = _
      rw [hj,bind_tc_ok,ih j hbound]
      rfl

#print axioms constant
end XRp_FromFnConstant

import XRn_Join_Funs
import AspisR1Post25SamplerIndexedAddSmallCandidate.Funs
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRs_AddStep
abbrev Iter := core.slice.iter.IterMut U32
abbrev Back := Iter → Iter
/-- Common arithmetic, preserving fail and divergence. -/
def step (digit addend : U32) : Result (U32 × U32) := do
 let a ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from digit)
 let b ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from addend)
 let sum ← a+b
 let p ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from 2147483647#u32)
 let rem ← sum % p
 let d ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 rem)
 let q ← sum / p
 let c ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 q)
 ok (d,c)

def write (r : Iter) (i : Nat) (d : U32) : Iter :=
 {r with slice := r.slice.setAtNat i d}

theorem emitted (it : Iter) (back : Back) (c : U32)
 (h : it.i < it.slice.val.length) :
 XRn_Join_Release.sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body it back c =
 (do let (d,c') ← step it.slice.val[it.i] c
     ok (.cont ({it with i := it.i+1},fun r => back (write r it.i d),c'))) := by
 unfold XRn_Join_Release.sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body
 unfold core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next
 change it.i < it.slice.len.val at h
 rw [dif_pos h]
 simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift, aspis_core.field.P]
 unfold step
 simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, bind_assoc_eq]
 rfl

theorem exhausted (it : Iter) (back : Back) (c : U32)
 (h : ¬it.i < it.slice.val.length) :
 XRn_Join_Release.sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body it back c =
 ok (.done (c,back)) := by
 unfold XRn_Join_Release.sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body
 unfold core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next
 change ¬it.i < it.slice.len.val at h
 rw [dif_neg h]
 rfl

#print axioms emitted
#print axioms exhausted
end XRs_AddStep

XRs_AddIndexed.source:
import XRs_AddStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRs_AddIndexed
open XRs_AddStep

theorem write_commute (r : Iter) (i j : Nat) (a b : U32) (h : i ≠ j) :
 write (write r i a) j b = write (write r j b) i a := by
 cases r with | mk s k =>
  unfold write Slice.setAtNat
  congr 2
  exact List.set_comm a b h

def set (a : Array U32 8#usize) (i : Nat) (d : U32) : Array U32 8#usize :=
 ⟨a.val.set i d, by simpa only [List.length_set] using a.property⟩

def idx (i : Nat) (h : i ≤ 8) : Usize := UScalar.ofNat i (by scalar_tac)

theorem body (a : Array U32 8#usize) (c : U32) (i : Nat) (h : i < 8) :
 AspisR1Post25SamplerIndexedAddSmallCandidate.sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body
 a c (idx i (by omega)) =
 (do let (d,c') ← step (a.val[i]'(by have e := a.property; change a.val.length = 8 at e; omega)) c
     ok (.cont (set a i d,c',idx (i+1) (by omega)))) := by
 unfold AspisR1Post25SamplerIndexedAddSmallCandidate.sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body
 have hi : idx i (by omega) < 8#usize := by change i < 8; exact h
 rw [if_pos hi]
 have ha : i < a.val.length := by have := a.property; change a.val.length = 8 at this; omega
 have hv : (idx i (by omega)).val = i := rfl
 have hg : a[idx i (by omega)]? = some a.val[i] := by
  change a.val[i]? = _
  exact List.getElem?_eq_getElem ha
 simp only [Array.index_usize,hg, bind_tc_ok, lift]
 unfold step
 simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok,bind_assoc_eq]
 unfold AspisR1Post25SamplerIndexedAddSmallCandidate.field.P
 apply congrArg (fun k => (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from a.val[i] + core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from c) >>= k)
 funext sum
 apply congrArg (fun k => (sum % core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from 2147483647#u32) >>= k)
 funext rem
 simp only [Array.update, hg,bind_tc_ok]
 apply congrArg (fun k => (sum / core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from 2147483647#u32) >>= k)
 funext q
 have hn : idx i (by omega) + 1#usize = ok (idx (i+1) (by omega)) := by
  obtain ⟨v,hv1,hv2⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (UScalar.add_spec (x:=idx i (by omega)) (y:=1#usize) (by unfold idx; scalar_tac))
  exact hv1.trans (congrArg ok (UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hv2))
 rw [hn]
 rfl
#print axioms write_commute
#print axioms body
end XRs_AddIndexed

XRs_AddInvariant.source:
import XRs_AddIndexed
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRs_AddInvariant
open XRs_AddStep XRs_AddIndexed
/-- Pending restorations contain only indices strictly before i. -/
structure Good (base : Iter) (back : Back) (a : Array U32 8#usize) (i : Nat) : Prop where
 restored : (back base).slice.val = a.val
 suffix : ∀ j, i ≤ j → a.val[j]? = base.slice.val[j]?
 commute : ∀ r j d, i ≤ j → back (write r j d) = write (back r) j d

theorem initial (a : Array U32 8#usize) :
 Good (⟨a.to_slice,0⟩ : Iter) id a 0 := by
 constructor
 · rfl
 · intro j h; rfl
 · intro r j d h; rfl

theorem advance (base : Iter) (back : Back) (a : Array U32 8#usize)
 (i : Nat) (digit : U32) (g : Good base back a i) :
 Good base (fun r => back (write r i digit)) (set a i digit) (i+1) := by
 constructor
 · rw [g.commute base i digit (by omega)]
   change (back base).slice.val.set i digit = a.val.set i digit
   rw [g.restored]
 · intro j h
   change (a.val.set i digit)[j]? = _
   rw [List.getElem?_set_ne (by omega),g.suffix j (by omega)]
 · intro r j d h
   rw [write_commute r j i d digit (by omega)]
   exact g.commute (write r i digit) j d (by omega)

#print axioms initial
#print axioms advance
end XRs_AddInvariant

import XRn_Join_ABI
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
set_option autoImplicit false

/-- No arithmetic is reduced while commuting the loop continuation. -/
theorem step {S T X Y : Type} (body : S → Result (ControlFlow S T))
 (s : S) (r : Result X) (next : X → S) (k : T → Result Y)
 (h : body s = (r >>= fun x => ok (.cont (next x)))) :
 (loop body s >>= k) = (r >>= fun x => loop body (next x) >>= k) := by
 rw [loop.eq_def,h]
 cases r <;> rfl

theorem done {S T Y : Type} (body : S → Result (ControlFlow S T))
 (s : S) (v : T) (k : T → Result Y) (h : body s = ok (.done v)) :
 (loop body s >>= k) = k v := by rw [loop.eq_def,h]; rfl
#print axioms step

end XRs_LoopBind

XRs_AddLoop.source:
import XRs_AddInvariant
import XRs_LoopBind
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRs_AddLoop
open XRs_AddStep XRs_AddIndexed XRs_AddInvariant
abbrev ebody (s : Iter × Back × U32) :=
 XRn_Join_Release.sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2
abbrev ibody (s : Array U32 8#usize × U32 × Usize) :=
 AspisR1Post25SamplerIndexedAddSmallCandidate.sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2

def output (seed : Array U32 8#usize) (base : Iter) (p : U32 × Back) :
 Result (Array U32 8#usize × U32) := ok (Array.from_slice seed (p.2 base).slice,p.1)

theorem restored (seed a : Array U32 8#usize) (base : Iter) (back : Back)
 (i : Nat) (g : Good base back a i) (c : U32) : output seed base (c,back) = ok (a,c) := by
 unfold output Array.from_slice
 have hlen : (back base).slice.val.length = (8#usize).val := g.restored ▸ a.property
 rw [dif_pos hlen]
 congr 2
 exact Subtype.ext g.restored

theorem right {T : Type} (r : Result T) : (r >>= fun x => ok x) = r := by cases r <;> rfl

theorem join (seed : Array U32 8#usize) (base : Iter)
 (hlen : base.slice.val.length = 8) (n i : Nat) (bound : i+n=8)
 (a : Array U32 8#usize) (back : Back) (c : U32) (g : Good base back a i) :
 (loop ebody ({base with i:=i},back,c) >>= output seed base) =
 loop ibody (a,c,idx i (by omega)) := by
 induction n generalizing i a back c with
 | zero =>
   have hi : i=8 := by omega
   subst i
   have he : ebody ({base with i:=8},back,c) = ok (.done (c,back)) :=
    exhausted _ _ _ (by simpa only [hlen] using (Nat.lt_irrefl 8))
   rw [XRs_LoopBind.done ebody _ _ _ he,restored seed a base back 8 g c]
   rw [loop.eq_def]
   rfl
 | succ n ih =>
   have hi : i<8 := by omega
   have hb : i<base.slice.val.length := by omega
   have ha : i<a.val.length := by have h := a.property; change a.val.length=8 at h; omega
   have hv : base.slice.val[i] = a.val[i] := by
    have h := g.suffix i (by omega)
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem ha,List.getElem?_eq_getElem hb] at h
    exact (Option.some.inj h).symm
   have he : ebody ({base with i:=i},back,c) =
    (step a.val[i] c >>= fun p => ok (.cont ({base with i:=i+1},fun r => back (write r i p.1),p.2))) := by
    unfold ebody
    rw [emitted ({base with i:=i}) back c hb]
    simp only [hv]
    apply congrArg (fun k => step a.val[i] c >>= k)
    funext p
    cases p
    rfl
   rw [XRs_LoopBind.step ebody _ _ _ _ he]
   have hiStep := body a c i hi
   have hI : (loop ibody (a,c,idx i (by omega))) =
    (step a.val[i] c >>= fun p => loop ibody (set a i p.1,p.2,idx (i+1) (by omega))) := by
    have h := XRs_LoopBind.step ibody (a,c,idx i (by omega))
      (step a.val[i] c) (fun p => (set a i p.1,p.2,idx (i+1) (by omega))) (fun x => ok x) hiStep
    simpa only [right] using h
   rw [hI]
   apply congrArg (fun k => step a.val[i] c >>= k)
   funext p
   exact ih (i+1) (by omega) (set a i p.1) (fun r => back (write r i p.1)) p.2
    (advance base back a i p.1 g)
#print axioms restored
#print axioms right
#print axioms join
end XRs_AddLoop

theorem pair_bind {A B C : Type} (r : Result (A × B)) (k : A → B → Result C) :
 (do let (a,b) ← r; k a b) = (r >>= fun p => k p.1 p.2) := by
 cases r with
 | ok p => cases p; rfl
 | fail e => rfl
 | div => rfl

theorem add (digits : Array U32 8#usize) (n : U32) :

  (by exact digits.property) 8 0 rfl digits id n (XRs_AddInvariant.initial digits)
 have hc := congrArg (fun r : Result (Array U32 8#usize × U32) =>
  r >>= fun p => ok (p.2 != 0#u32,p.1)) h
 have hz : XRs_AddIndexed.idx 0 (by omega) = 0#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq rfl
 rw [hz] at hc

  XRn_Join_Release.sampler.add_small_base_p_loop
  AspisR1Post25SamplerIndexedAddSmallCandidate.sampler.add_small_base_p
  AspisR1Post25SamplerIndexedAddSmallCandidate.sampler.add_small_base_p_loop
 dsimp only
 simp only [pair_bind,bind_tc_ok]
 simp only [bind_assoc_eq,XRs_AddLoop.output,bind_tc_ok] at hc
 convert hc using 1 <;> rfl

open AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan

def observe (s : List U32 × Nat × Bool) : ScanState × Bool :=
 (⟨s.1.map UScalar.val,s.2.1⟩,s.2.2)

theorem mem_val (xs : List U32) (x : U32) : x.val ∈ xs.map UScalar.val ↔ x ∈ xs := by
 constructor
 · intro h
   obtain ⟨y,hy,he⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
   exact UScalar.eq_of_val_eq he ▸ hy
 · intro h
   exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x,h,rfl⟩

theorem stopped (xs words : List U32) (d : Nat) :
 words.foldl XRn_Join_scanWord (xs,d,true) = (xs,d,true) := by
 induction words with
 | nil => rfl
 | cons x words ih => simpa [List.foldl_cons,XRn_Join_scanWord] using ih

theorem scan (xs words : List U32) (d : Nat) :
 observe (words.foldl XRn_Join_scanWord (xs,d,false)) =
 AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.scan ⟨xs.map UScalar.val,d⟩ (words.map UScalar.val) := by
 induction words generalizing xs d with
 | nil => rfl
 | cons x words ih =>
   by_cases h : xs.length=22 ∨ d=64
   · simp [List.foldl_cons,XRn_Join_scanWord,h,stopped,
       observe,AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.scan]
   · by_cases hm : x ∈ xs
     · simpa [List.foldl_cons,XRn_Join_scanWord,h,hm,
         AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.scan,keep,mem_val] using ih xs (d+1)
     · simpa [List.foldl_cons,XRn_Join_scanWord,h,hm,
         AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.scan,keep,mem_val] using ih (xs++[x]) (d+1)
#print axioms mem_val
#print axioms stopped
#print axioms scan
end XRs_QueryScan

XRv_QueryScanTotal.source:
import XRv_DecodedWords
import XRt_QueryScan
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRv_QueryScanTotal
open Query31ExplicitListLoop Query31ExplicitScanBody

theorem values_injective (xs ys : List U32) (h : xs.map UScalar.val = ys.map UScalar.val) : xs = ys := by
 induction xs generalizing ys with
 | nil => cases ys <;> simp_all
 | cons x xs ih =>
   cases ys with
   | nil => simp at h
   | cons y ys =>
     have hp := List.cons.inj h
     have he : x=y := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hp.1
     exact congrArg₂ List.cons he (ih ys hp.2)

theorem observe_injective (x y : List U32 × Nat × Bool)
 (h : XRs_QueryScan.observe x = XRs_QueryScan.observe y) : x = y := by
 rcases x with ⟨xs,xd,xb⟩
 rcases y with ⟨ys,yd,yb⟩
 have hp := congrArg (fun p => p.1.accepted) h
 have hd := congrArg (fun p => p.1.draws) h
 have hb := congrArg Prod.snd h
 have he := values_injective xs ys hp
 exact congrArg₂ Prod.mk he (congrArg₂ Prod.mk hd hb)

theorem same_block (b : Array U8 32#usize) (s : Query31ExplicitScanBody.CurrentScan) (valid : validState s) :
 ∃ sf pending,
 Query31ModelScanCall.modelScanFn Query31ConcreteWordsDriverChain.actualQueryWords s b =
   ok (optionStop pending,sf) ∧
 (XRt_QueryWords.words b).foldl XRn_Join_scanWord
   (s.accepted.val.take s.accepted_len.val,s.draws.val,false) =
   (sf.accepted.val.take sf.accepted_len.val,sf.draws.val,optionStop pending) ∧
 validState sf := by
 obtain ⟨sf,pending,hr,ho,hv⟩ := XRt_QueryScan.same_scan (XRt_QueryWords.words b) s valid
 refine ⟨sf,pending,?_,?_,hv⟩
 · unfold Query31ModelScanCall.modelScanFn Query31ConcreteWordsDriverChain.actualQueryWords
   rw [XRv_DecodedWords.exact_result,bind_tc_ok]
   change (do let (sf,p) ← scanListLoop (XRt_QueryWords.words b) s; ok (optionStop p,sf)) = _
   rw [hr,bind_tc_ok]
 · apply observe_injective
   exact ho

#print axioms values_injective
#print axioms observe_injective
#print axioms same_block
end XRv_QueryScanTotal

XRv_QueryDriver.source:
import XRv_DecodedWords
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRn_Join_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRv_QueryDriver
abbrev Block := Array U8 32#usize
abbrev Blocks := Array Block 8#usize
abbrev State := List U32 × Nat × Bool × Array U8 32#usize

def step (blocks advances : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize)
 (s : State) (i : Nat) : Result State := do
 let (accepted,draws,stopped,_) := s
 if stopped then ok s else do
  let block ← Array.index_usize blocks (XRn_Join_usize i)
  let advance ← Array.index_usize advances (XRn_Join_usize i)
  let (accepted,draws,stop) := (XRt_QueryWords.words block).foldl XRn_Join_scanWord (accepted,draws,false)
  ok (accepted,draws,stop,advance)

theorem stopped (blocks advances : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize)
 (indices : List Nat) (accepted : List U32) (draws : Nat) (selected : Array U8 32#usize) :
 indices.foldlM (step blocks advances) (accepted,draws,true,selected) =
 ok (accepted,draws,true,selected) := by
 induction indices with
 | nil => rfl
 | cons i rest ih =>
   simp only [List.foldlM_cons,step,↓reduceIte,bind_tc_ok]
   exact ih

def drive (blocks advances : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize) : List Nat → State → Result State
 | [],s => ok s
 | i::rest,s => if s.2.2.1 then ok s else do
   let next ← step blocks advances s i
   drive blocks advances rest next

theorem short_circuit (blocks advances : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize)
 (indices : List Nat) (s : State) :
 drive blocks advances indices s = indices.foldlM (step blocks advances) s := by
 induction indices generalizing s with
 | nil => rfl
 | cons i rest ih =>
   rcases s with ⟨a,d,stop,state⟩
   cases stop with
   | false => simp only [drive,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,List.foldlM_cons]; congr 1; funext next; exact ih next
   | true =>
     rw [stopped]
     rfl

def finish (s : State) :
 Result (core.result.Result (Array U32 22#usize × Array U8 32#usize)
   aspis_core.transcript.QuerySampleError) :=
 if h : s.1.length = 22 then ok (.Ok (⟨s.1,h⟩,s.2.2.2))
 else ok (.Err (.DrawLimitExhausted (XRn_Join_usize s.1.length) 64#usize))

theorem driver (blocks advances : Blocks) :
 aspis_core.r0_transcript.queries_from_pairs blocks advances =
 (drive blocks advances (List.range 8)
   ([],0,false,advances.val[7]?.getD (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)) >>= finish) := by
 exact (congrArg (fun m : Result State => m >>= finish)
   (short_circuit blocks advances (List.range 8)
    ([],0,false,advances.val[7]?.getD (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)))).symm

#print axioms stopped
#print axioms short_circuit
#print axioms driver
end XRv_QueryDriver

import XRv_QueryDriver
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRn_Join_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRv_QueryDriverTotal
open XRv_QueryDriver

theorem index {T : Type} (a : Array T 8#usize) (i : Nat) (hi : i<8) :
 Array.index_usize a (XRn_Join_usize i) = ok (a.val[i]'(by have h : a.val.length=8 := a.property; omega)) := by
 have hb : i < UScalar.cMax .Usize+1 := by
   have h : 8 ≤ UScalar.cMax .Usize := by scalar_tac
   omega
 have hv : (XRn_Join_usize i).val = i := by change i % (UScalar.cMax .Usize+1) = i; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb
 have hidx : i < a.val.length := by have h : a.val.length=8 := a.property; omega
 unfold Array.index_usize
 change (match a.val[(XRn_Join_usize i).val]? with
   | none => fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
   | some x => ok x) = _
 rw [hv,List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

theorem step_total (blocks advances : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize)
 (s : State) (i : Nat) (hi : i<8) : ∃ out, step blocks advances s i = ok out := by
 rcases s with ⟨a,d,stop,state⟩
 cases stop with
 | true => exact ⟨_,rfl⟩
 | false =>
   unfold step
   simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,index blocks i hi,index advances i hi,bind_tc_ok]
   exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem fold_total (blocks advances : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize)
 (indices : List Nat) (bounded : ∀ i ∈ indices, i<8) (s : State) :
 ∃ out, indices.foldlM (step blocks advances) s = ok out := by
 induction indices generalizing s with
 | nil => exact ⟨s,rfl⟩
 | cons i rest ih =>
   obtain ⟨next,hn⟩ := step_total blocks advances s i (bounded i (by simp))
   obtain ⟨out,ho⟩ := ih (fun j hj => bounded j (List.mem_cons_of_mem i hj)) next
   refine ⟨out,?_⟩
   rw [List.foldlM_cons,hn,bind_tc_ok]
   exact ho

theorem total (blocks advances : Blocks) :
 ∃ out, aspis_core.r0_transcript.queries_from_pairs blocks advances = ok out := by
 obtain ⟨out,ho⟩ := fold_total blocks advances (List.range 8) (fun i hi => List.mem_range.mp hi)
   ([],0,false,advances.val[7]?.getD (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8))
 rw [driver,short_circuit,ho,bind_tc_ok]
 unfold finish
 split <;> exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

#print axioms index
#print axioms step_total
#print axioms fold_total
#print axioms total
end XRv_QueryDriverTotal

XRv_SelectedAdvance.source:
import XRv_QueryDriverTotal
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRn_Join_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRv_SelectedAdvance
open XRv_QueryDriver XRv_QueryDriverTotal

theorem step_selected (blocks advances : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize)
 (s out : State) (i : Nat) (hi : i<8) (run : step blocks advances s i = ok out) :
 out.2.2.2 = s.2.2.2 ∨ Array.index_usize advances (XRn_Join_usize i) = ok out.2.2.2 := by
 rcases s with ⟨a,d,stop,state⟩
 cases stop with
 | true =>
   have he : (a,d,true,state)=out := Result.ok.inj run
   subst out
   exact Or.inl rfl
 | false =>
   have hb := index blocks i hi
   have ha := index advances i hi
   unfold step at run
   simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,hb,ha,bind_tc_ok] at run
   generalize hw : (XRt_QueryWords.words (blocks.val[i]'(by have h : blocks.val.length=8 := blocks.property; omega))).foldl
     XRn_Join_scanWord (a,d,false) = triple at run
   rcases triple with ⟨as',ds',stop'⟩
   have he := Result.ok.inj run
   subst out
   exact Or.inr ha

theorem fold_selected (blocks advances : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize)
 (indices : List Nat) (bounded : ∀ i ∈ indices, i<8) (s out : State)
 (run : indices.foldlM (step blocks advances) s = ok out) :
 out.2.2.2 = s.2.2.2 ∨
 ∃ i ∈ indices, Array.index_usize advances (XRn_Join_usize i) = ok out.2.2.2 := by
 induction indices generalizing s with
 | nil =>
   have he : s=out := Result.ok.inj run
   exact Or.inl (congrArg (fun q : State => q.2.2.2) he.symm)
 | cons i rest ih =>
   obtain ⟨next,hn⟩ := step_total blocks advances s i (bounded i (by simp))
   have hr : rest.foldlM (step blocks advances) next = ok out := by
     simpa only [List.foldlM_cons,hn,bind_tc_ok] using run
   rcases ih (fun j hj => bounded j (List.mem_cons_of_mem i hj)) next hr with hsame | ⟨j,hj,hsel⟩
   · rcases step_selected blocks advances s next i (bounded i (by simp)) hn with hprev | hsel
     · exact Or.inl (hsame.trans hprev)
     · exact Or.inr ⟨i,by simp,hsame ▸ hsel⟩
   · exact Or.inr ⟨j,List.mem_cons_of_mem i hj,hsel⟩

#print axioms step_selected
#print axioms fold_selected
end XRv_SelectedAdvance

XRv_DriverSelected.source:
import XRv_SelectedAdvance
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRn_Join_Release
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRv_DriverSelected
open XRv_QueryDriver XRv_QueryDriverTotal

theorem selected (blocks advances : Blocks) (out : State)
 (run : (List.range 8).foldlM (step blocks advances)
   ([],0,false,advances.val[7]?.getD (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)) = ok out) :
 ∃ i, i<8 ∧ Array.index_usize advances (XRn_Join_usize i) = ok out.2.2.2 := by
 rcases XRv_SelectedAdvance.fold_selected blocks advances (List.range 8)
   (fun i hi => List.mem_range.mp hi) _ out run with hs | ⟨i,hi,hr⟩
 · refine ⟨7,by omega,?_⟩
   have hlen : advances.val.length = 8 := advances.property
   have hidx : 7 < advances.val.length := by omega
   rw [index advances 7 (by omega),hs,List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]
   rfl
 · exact ⟨i,List.mem_range.mp hi,hr⟩

#print axioms selected
end XRv_DriverSelected

import JFv_RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20
import ExtractedMaskBasisComponents

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPh
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20

abbrev P := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P
abbrev CanonC (x : GenC) := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM (genCToProbe x)
abbrev CanonQ (x : GenQ) := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM (genQToProbe x)

def probeQToGen (x : ProbeQ) : GenQ := ⟨probeCToGen x.c0, probeCToGen x.c1⟩

theorem q_roundtrip (x : GenQ) : probeQToGen (genQToProbe x) = x := by
  cases x with | mk a b => cases a; cases b; rfl

theorem reflect_ok {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (g : B → A)
    (roundtrip : ∀ x, g (f x) = x) (r : Result A) (z : B)
    (h : resultMap f r = ok z) : r = ok (g z) := by
  cases r with
  | ok x =>
    have e : f x = z := Result.ok.inj h
    rw [← e, roundtrip]
  | fail e => cases h
  | div => cases h

theorem m31_mul_value (x y : U32) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.aspis_core.field.M31.mul x y = ok z ∧
      z.val = (x.val * y.val) % P ∧ z.val < P := by
  rw [generated_m31_mul_eq_probe]
  exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.current_mul_mod x y

theorem cm31_mul_value (x y : GenC) (hx : CanonC x) (hy : CanonC y) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul x y = ok z ∧
      CanonC z ∧
      z.a.val = AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCM31Mul.realWord x.a.val x.b.val y.a.val y.b.val ∧
      z.b.val = AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCM31Mul.imagWord x.a.val x.b.val y.a.val y.b.val := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hc, ha, hb⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCM31Mul.current_mul_words (genCToProbe x) (genCToProbe y) hx hy
  have h := reflect_ok genCToProbe probeCToGen probeCToGen_genCToProbe
    _ z ((generated_cm_mul_eq_probe x y).trans hz)
  exact ⟨probeCToGen z, h, hc, ha, hb⟩

theorem qm31_mul_value (x y : GenQ) (hx : CanonQ x) (hy : CanonQ y) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.aspis_core.field.QM31.mul x y = ok z ∧
      CanonQ z ∧ AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.wordsQM (genQToProbe z) =
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.qmMulWords
          (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.wordsQM (genQToProbe x))
          (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.wordsQM (genQToProbe y)) := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hc, hv⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.current_qm_mul_words (genQToProbe x) (genQToProbe y) hx hy
  have h := reflect_ok genQToProbe probeQToGen q_roundtrip
    _ z ((generated_qm_mul_eq_probe x y).trans hz)
  exact ⟨probeQToGen z, h, hc, hv⟩

theorem mul_by_r_value (x : GenC) (hx : CanonC x) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.aspis_core.field.mul_by_r x = ok z ∧
      CanonC z ∧ AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.wordsCM (genCToProbe z) =
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.rWords
          (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.wordsCM (genCToProbe x)) := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hc, hv⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskBasisComponents.current_cm31_mul_r_words (genCToProbe x) hx
  rw [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskBasisComponents.cm31_mul_r_eq_mul_by_r] at hz
  have h := reflect_ok genCToProbe probeCToGen probeCToGen_genCToProbe
    _ z ((generated_mul_by_r_eq_probe x).trans hz)
  exact ⟨probeCToGen z, h, hc, hv⟩

#print axioms q_roundtrip
#print axioms reflect_ok
#print axioms m31_mul_value
#print axioms cm31_mul_value
#print axioms qm31_mul_value
#print axioms mul_by_r_value
end AspisR1.LPh

 XRn_Join_Field.field.reduce_u64 x = FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.reduce_u64 x := by

 z.val = (x.val*y.val)%2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
 rw [same_multiply]

 XRn_Join_Field.field.M31.mul x y =
 AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.aspis_core.field.M31.mul x y := by
 obtain ⟨z,hz,hv,hc⟩ := value x y

 have he : z=w := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (hv.trans hv'.symm)

import XRw_GenericDriver
import XRw_PairedStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRy_WholeDriver
open XRv_QueryDriver XRv_QueryDriverTotal
open Query31ExplicitListLoop Query31ExplicitScanBody
open XRo_Join_Carriers
abbrev CE := AspisR1Query31Transcript.aspis_core.transcript.QuerySampleError
abbrev RE := XRn_Join_Release.aspis_core.transcript.QuerySampleError
abbrev Out := core.result.Result (Array U32 22#usize × Block) CE

def error : RE → CE
 | .BoundNotPowerOfTwo b => .BoundNotPowerOfTwo b
 | .CountExceedsBound n b => .CountExceedsBound n b
 | .DrawLimitExhausted n m => .DrawLimitExhausted n m

def finish (s : Query31ExplicitScanBody.CurrentScan) (advance : Block) : Result Out := do
 let r ← AspisR1Query31Transcript.aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan.finish s
 let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
 match cf with
 | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val => ok (.Ok (val,advance))
 | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
   core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
     (Array U32 22#usize × Block) (core.convert.FromSame CE) residual

theorem finish_same (s : Query31ExplicitScanBody.CurrentScan) (valid : validState s)
 (stop : Bool) (advance : Block) :
 mapR (inner id error)
   (XRv_QueryDriver.finish (s.accepted.val.take s.accepted_len.val,s.draws.val,stop,advance)) =
 finish s advance := by
 have h22 : (22#usize).val = 22 := by scalar_tac
 have hlen : (s.accepted.val.take s.accepted_len.val).length = s.accepted_len.val := by
   simpa only [acceptedPrefix,List.length_map] using valid.2.2
 have hround : XRn_Join_usize s.accepted_len.val = s.accepted_len := by
   apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
   change s.accepted_len.val % (UScalar.cMax .Usize+1) = s.accepted_len.val
   apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
   scalar_tac
 by_cases hs : s.accepted_len = 22#usize
 · have hv : s.accepted_len.val = 22 := congrArg UScalar.val hs
   have ht : s.accepted.val.take s.accepted_len.val = s.accepted.val := by
     apply List.take_of_length_le
     have ha : s.accepted.val.length = 22 := s.accepted.property
     omega
   have hl22 : (List.take 22 s.accepted.val).length = 22 := by
     simpa only [hv] using hlen
   simp only [XRv_QueryDriver.finish,hlen,hl22,hv,↓reduceDIte,mapR,bind_tc_ok,XRo_Join_Carriers.inner,id,
     finish,AspisR1Query31Transcript.aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan.finish,
     AspisR1Query31Transcript.aspis_core.r0_transcript.QUERY_COUNT,
     AspisR1Query31Transcript.aspis_core.r0_transcript.QUERY_MAX_DRAWS,hs,↓reduceIte,
     core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok,h22]
   apply congrArg (fun a : Array U32 22#usize =>
     (Result.ok (core.result.Result.Ok (a,advance)) : Result Out))
   apply Subtype.ext
   simpa only [hv,h22] using ht
 · have hv : s.accepted_len.val ≠ 22 := by
     intro h
     apply hs
     apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
     exact h
   simp only [XRv_QueryDriver.finish,hlen,hv,↓reduceDIte,mapR,bind_tc_ok,XRo_Join_Carriers.inner,error,
     finish,AspisR1Query31Transcript.aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan.finish,
     AspisR1Query31Transcript.aspis_core.r0_transcript.QUERY_COUNT,
     AspisR1Query31Transcript.aspis_core.r0_transcript.QUERY_MAX_DRAWS,hs,↓reduceIte,
     core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok,
     core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
     core.convert.FromSame,core.convert.FromSame.from,hround]

def run (blocks advances : Blocks) : List Nat → Query31ExplicitScanBody.CurrentScan → Block → Result Out
 | [],s,old => finish s old
 | i::rest,s,_ => do
   let block ← Array.index_usize blocks (XRn_Join_usize i)
   let (stop,sf) ← Query31ModelScanCall.modelScanFn Query31ConcreteWordsDriverChain.actualQueryWords s block
   let advance ← Array.index_usize advances (XRn_Join_usize i)
   if stop then finish sf advance else run blocks advances rest sf advance

theorem fold_same (blocks advances : Blocks) (indices : List Nat)
 (bounded : ∀ i ∈ indices, i<8) (s : Query31ExplicitScanBody.CurrentScan) (valid : validState s) (old : Block) :
 mapR (inner id error)
   ((indices.foldlM (step blocks advances)
     (s.accepted.val.take s.accepted_len.val,s.draws.val,false,old)) >>= XRv_QueryDriver.finish) =
 run blocks advances indices s old := by
 induction indices generalizing s old with
 | nil => exact finish_same s valid false old
 | cons i rest ih =>
   have hi : i<8 := bounded i (by simp)
   obtain ⟨sf,pending,advance,ha,hr,he,hv⟩ := XRw_PairedStep.same_step blocks advances i hi s valid old
   rw [List.foldlM_cons,he,bind_tc_ok]
   unfold run
   rw [index blocks i hi,bind_tc_ok,hr,bind_tc_ok]
   simp only [ha,bind_tc_ok]
   cases hs : optionStop pending with
   | false =>
     exact ih (fun j hj => bounded j (List.mem_cons_of_mem i hj)) sf hv advance
   | true =>
     rw [XRv_QueryDriver.stopped,bind_tc_ok]
     exact finish_same sf hv true advance

theorem guarded_step (blocks advances : Blocks) :
 XRw_GenericDriver.guarded (step blocks advances) (fun s : State => s.2.2.1) =
 step blocks advances := by
 funext s i
 rcases s with ⟨a,d,stop,old⟩
 cases stop <;> rfl

theorem raw_unrolled (blocks advances : Blocks) :
 aspis_core.r0_transcript.queries_from_pairs blocks advances =
 (XRw_GenericDriver.unrolled (step blocks advances) (fun s : State => s.2.2.1)
   (List.range 8) ([],0,false,advances.val[7]?.getD (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)) >>=
   XRv_QueryDriver.finish) := by
 have h := XRw_GenericDriver.first_stop_fold
   (M:=Result) (fun (_ : State) (_ : State → Result State) => rfl)
   (step blocks advances) (fun s : State => s.2.2.1) XRv_QueryDriver.finish
   (List.range 8) ([],0,false,advances.val[7]?.getD (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8))
 rw [guarded_step] at h
 exact h.symm

-- The bounded array reads have no effects and succeed on the SAME arrays.
theorem run_unrolled (blocks advances : Blocks) (s : Query31ExplicitScanBody.CurrentScan) (old : Block) :
 run blocks advances (List.range 8) s old =
 AspisR1Query31Transcript.queries_from_pairs_with_scan
   (Query31ModelScanCall.modelScanFn Query31ConcreteWordsDriverChain.actualQueryWords)
   s blocks advances := by
 change run blocks advances [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7] s old = _
 unfold AspisR1Query31Transcript.queries_from_pairs_with_scan
 have hb0 := index blocks 0 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize blocks 0#usize = _ at hb0
 have hb1 := index blocks 1 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize blocks 1#usize = _ at hb1
 have hb2 := index blocks 2 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize blocks 2#usize = _ at hb2
 have hb3 := index blocks 3 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize blocks 3#usize = _ at hb3
 have hb4 := index blocks 4 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize blocks 4#usize = _ at hb4
 have hb5 := index blocks 5 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize blocks 5#usize = _ at hb5
 have hb6 := index blocks 6 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize blocks 6#usize = _ at hb6
 have hb7 := index blocks 7 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize blocks 7#usize = _ at hb7
 have ha0 := index advances 0 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize advances 0#usize = _ at ha0
 have ha1 := index advances 1 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize advances 1#usize = _ at ha1
 have ha2 := index advances 2 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize advances 2#usize = _ at ha2
 have ha3 := index advances 3 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize advances 3#usize = _ at ha3
 have ha4 := index advances 4 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize advances 4#usize = _ at ha4
 have ha5 := index advances 5 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize advances 5#usize = _ at ha5
 have ha6 := index advances 6 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize advances 6#usize = _ at ha6
 have ha7 := index advances 7 (by omega)
 change Array.index_usize advances 7#usize = _ at ha7
 simp only [run,finish,
   index blocks 0 (by omega),index blocks 1 (by omega),index blocks 2 (by omega),
   index blocks 3 (by omega),index blocks 4 (by omega),index blocks 5 (by omega),
   index blocks 6 (by omega),index blocks 7 (by omega),
   index advances 0 (by omega),index advances 1 (by omega),index advances 2 (by omega),
   index advances 3 (by omega),index advances 4 (by omega),index advances 5 (by omega),
   index advances 6 (by omega),index advances 7 (by omega),
   hb0,hb1,hb2,hb3,hb4,hb5,hb6,hb7,ha0,ha1,ha2,ha3,ha4,ha5,ha6,ha7,bind_tc_ok,ite_self]
 try rfl

/-- Full eight-stage SAME-array equation, with complete first-stop finish/error
and selected advance state. No successful-driver hypothesis. -/
theorem whole (blocks advances : Blocks) :
 mapR (inner id error)
   (aspis_core.r0_transcript.queries_from_pairs blocks advances) =
 AspisR1Query31Transcript.queries_from_pairs_with_scan
   (Query31ModelScanCall.modelScanFn Query31ConcreteWordsDriverChain.actualQueryWords)
   Query31ConcreteDriverTraceFacts.sourceDefaultState blocks advances := by
 rw [raw_unrolled]
 rw [XRw_GenericDriver.first_stop_fold
   (fun (_ : State) (_ : State → Result State) => rfl)]
 rw [guarded_step]
 have h := fold_same blocks advances (List.range 8) (fun i hi => List.mem_range.mp hi)
   Query31ConcreteDriverTraceFacts.sourceDefaultState
   Query31ConcreteDriverTraceFacts.sourceDefaultState_valid
   (advances.val[7]?.getD (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8))
 change mapR (inner id error)
   ((List.range 8).foldlM (step blocks advances)
     ([],0,false,advances.val[7]?.getD (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)) >>= XRv_QueryDriver.finish) = _
 exact h.trans (run_unrolled blocks advances _ _)

#print axioms finish_same
#print axioms fold_same
#print axioms guarded_step
#print axioms raw_unrolled
#print axioms run_unrolled
#print axioms whole
end XRy_WholeDriver

theorem bind_cont {A B C : Type} (f : B → C) (r : Result A)
 (k : A → Result B) (l : A → Result C)
 (h : ∀ a, mapR f (k a) = l a) :
 mapR f (r >>= k) = r >>= l := by
 rw [mapR_bind]
 exact congrArg (fun g => r >>= g) (funext h)

theorem raw {H : Type} (D : C.D H) (t : C.T H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) :
 mapR (fun p => (inner id ce p.1,ct p.2))
   (XRn_Join_Release.transcript.Transcript.queries (ed D) (et t) row payload) =
 AspisR1PublicPreparation.QueriesModel.queries XRy_QueryLaws.rawBoundaries D t row payload := by
 unfold XRn_Join_Release.transcript.Transcript.queries AspisR1PublicPreparation.QueriesModel.queries
 rw [←XRo_Join_TranscriptBlock.absorb]
 rw [mapR_bind,bind_map]
 congr 1
 funext absorbed
 repeat' (apply bind_cont; intro)
 simp only [XRy_QueryLaws.rawBoundaries,bind_map]
 rw [mapR_bind]
 congr 1
 funext r
 cases r with
 | Ok p =>
   rcases p with ⟨q,state⟩
   simp only [XRn_Join_Release.core.result.Result.map_err,
     AspisR1PublicPreparation.core.result.Result.map_err,
     XRo_Join_Carriers.inner,id,bind_tc_ok,
     core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
   repeat' (apply bind_cont; intro)
   rfl
 | Err e =>
   rfl

theorem canonical (x : U32) : ∃ z,
 x % 2147483647#u32 = ok z ∧ z.val < 2147483647 ∧
 z % 2147483647#u32 = ok z := by
 obtain ⟨z,hz,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (UScalar.rem_spec x (y:=2147483647#u32) (by scalar_tac))
 have hv' : z.val = x.val % 2147483647 := hv
 have hp : z.val < 2147483647 := by rw [hv']; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
 obtain ⟨w,hw,hwv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (UScalar.rem_spec z (y:=2147483647#u32) (by scalar_tac))
 have hwv' : w.val = z.val % 2147483647 := hwv
 have he : w=z := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (hwv'.trans (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp))
 exact ⟨z,hz,hp,he ▸ hw⟩

namespace XRy_Cross64

abbrev widen (x : U32) := core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from x

theorem sum_value (a b : U32) :
 (U64.wrapping_add (widen a) (widen b)).val = a.val+b.val := by
 unfold U64.wrapping_add
 rw [UScalar.wrapping_add_val_eq]
 simp only [UScalar.size_def,UScalarTy.numBits]
 rw [AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.widen_value,
   AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.widen_value]
 apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
 have ha : a.val ≤ 4294967295 := by scalar_tac
 have hb : b.val ≤ 4294967295 := by scalar_tac
 omega

theorem fragment (a b : EC) (ha : Canonical a) (hb : Canonical b) :
 AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.generatedCrossFragment (toC a) (toC b) =
 ok (U64.wrapping_mul (U64.wrapping_add (widen a.a) (widen a.b))
   (U64.wrapping_add (widen b.a) (widen b.b))) := by
 have ha1 := ha.1
 have ha2 := ha.2
 have hb1 := hb.1
 have hb2 := hb.2
 have hleft : (widen a.a).val+(widen a.b).val < 18446744073709551616 := by
   rw [AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.widen_value,
     AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.widen_value]
   omega

namespace XRy_ComplexMultiply

theorem graph (a b : EC) :
 XRn_Join_Field.field.CM31.mul a b = (do
   let m0 ← XRn_Join_Field.field.M31.mul a.a b.a
   let m1 ← XRn_Join_Field.field.M31.mul a.b b.b
   let m2 ← XRn_Join_Field.field.M31.reduce_u64
     (U64.wrapping_mul (U64.wrapping_add (widen a.a) (widen a.b))
       (U64.wrapping_add (widen b.a) (widen b.b)))
   let low ← XRn_Join_Field.field.M31.sub m0 m1
   let high0 ← XRn_Join_Field.field.M31.sub m2 m0
   let high ← XRn_Join_Field.field.M31.sub high0 m1
   ok (⟨low,high⟩ : EC)) := by
 simp only [XRn_Join_Field.field.CM31.mul,lift,bind_tc_ok]

theorem multiply (a b : EC) (ha : Canonical a) (hb : Canonical b) :
 mapR toC (XRn_Join_Field.field.CM31.mul a b) =
 AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31.mul (toC a) (toC b) := by
 obtain ⟨m0,e0,c0,v0,h0⟩ := XRt_CohortMultiply.canonical_output a.a b.a
 obtain ⟨m1,e1,c1,v1,h1⟩ := XRt_CohortMultiply.canonical_output a.b b.b
 let product := U64.wrapping_mul (U64.wrapping_add (widen a.a) (widen a.b))
   (U64.wrapping_add (widen b.a) (widen b.b))
 obtain ⟨m2,c2,v2,h2⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_wrapper_mod product
 have e2 := (XRy_Reducer64.reducer product).trans c2
 obtain ⟨low,cl,vl,hl⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_sub_mod m0 m1 h0 h1
 obtain ⟨high0,ch0,vh0,hh0⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_sub_mod m2 m0 h2 h0
 obtain ⟨high,ch,vh,hh⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_sub_mod high0 m1 hh0 h1
 have el := (XRq_ScalarSub.sub m0 m1 h0 h1).trans cl
 have eh0 := (XRq_ScalarSub.sub m2 m0 h2 h0).trans ch0
 have eh := (XRq_ScalarSub.sub high0 m1 hh0 h1).trans ch
 dsimp only [product] at e2 c2
 rw [graph,AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.generated_mul_graph,fragment a b ha hb]
 simp only [toC,e0,e1,e2,c0,c1,c2,el,eh0,eh,cl,ch0,ch,bind_tc_ok,mapR]

#print axioms graph
#print axioms multiply

theorem of_map_ok {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (r : Result A) (b : B)
 (h : mapR f r = ok b) : ∃ a, r=ok a ∧ f a=b := by
 cases r with
 | ok a => exact ⟨a,rfl,Result.ok.inj h⟩
 | fail e => cases h

theorem mul (a b : EC) (ha : Canonical a) (hb : Canonical b) :

   (toC a) (toC b) ha hb
 obtain ⟨z,hz,he⟩ := of_map_ok toC _ w ((XRy_ComplexMultiply.multiply a b ha hb).trans hw)
 refine ⟨z,hz,?_,?_⟩

 AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.mul_by_r (toC a) = ok (toC z) := by

 have rb2 := (XRp_PowersScalar.add a.b a.b ha.2 ha.2).trans eb2

import XRy_ArrayMap
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open XRo_Join_Carriers XRy_LoopWide
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRy_PowersStep

theorem mutable {A : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array A N) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val<N.val) :
 ∃ old, Array.index_mut_usize a i = ok (old,fun x => a.set i x) := by
 obtain ⟨out,hmut,hspec⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (Array.index_mut_usize_spec a i (by simpa [a.property] using hi))
 rcases out with ⟨old,back⟩
 rcases hspec with ⟨_,hback⟩
 subst back
 exact ⟨old,hmut⟩

theorem step {N : Usize} (x p : C.E) (a : Array C.E N) (i : Usize)
 (hi : i.val<N.val) (hx : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical x) (hp : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical p) :
 ∃ i', i'.val=i.val+1 ∧
 ((i'=N ∧
   XRn_Join_Release.weights.powers_loop.body x a p i = ok (.done (a.set i p,some (a.set i p))) ∧
   AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop.body (toLoop x) (arr toLoop a) (toLoop p) i =
     ok (.done (arr toLoop (a.set i p)))) ∨
  (i'≠N ∧ ∃ p', XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical p' ∧
   XRn_Join_Release.weights.powers_loop.body x a p i = ok (.cont (a.set i p,p',i')) ∧
   AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop.body (toLoop x) (arr toLoop a) (toLoop p) i =
     ok (.cont (arr toLoop (a.set i p),toLoop p',i')))) := by
 obtain ⟨old,hm⟩ := mutable a i hi
 obtain ⟨old',hm'⟩ := mutable (arr toLoop a) i hi
 have hN : N.val ≤ Usize.max := by scalar_tac
 have hAdd : (i+1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃ j => j.val=i.val+1 ⦄ := by
   apply UScalar.add_spec
   have hone : (1#usize).val=1 := by scalar_tac
   simpa only [hone,UScalar.max_USize_eq] using (show i.val+1 ≤ Usize.max by omega)
 obtain ⟨i',ei,vi⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hAdd
 have hlt : i<N := by scalar_tac
 refine ⟨i',vi,?_⟩
 by_cases he : i'=N
 · left
   refine ⟨he,?_,?_⟩
   · simp only [XRn_Join_Release.weights.powers_loop.body,if_pos hlt,hm,ei,bind_tc_ok,he,↓reduceIte]
     rfl
   · simp only [AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop.body,if_pos hlt,hm',ei,
       bind_tc_ok,he,↓reduceIte,XRy_ArrayMap.set]
     rfl
 · right
   obtain ⟨p',ep,hp',tp⟩ := XRy_LoopWide.multiply p x hp hx
   refine ⟨he,p',hp',?_,?_⟩
   · simp only [XRn_Join_Release.weights.powers_loop.body,if_pos hlt,hm,ei,bind_tc_ok,if_neg he,ep]
     rfl
   · simp only [AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop.body,if_pos hlt,hm',ei,
       bind_tc_ok,if_neg he,tp,XRy_ArrayMap.set]
     rfl

#print axioms mutable
#print axioms step
end XRy_PowersStep

theorem done {S O : Type} (body : S → Result (ControlFlow S O)) (s : S) (out : O)
 (h : body s=ok (.done out)) : loop body s=ok out := by rw [loop.eq_def,h]

theorem cont {S O : Type} (body : S → Result (ControlFlow S O)) (s next : S)
 (h : body s=ok (.cont next)) : loop body s=loop body next := by rw [loop.eq_def,h]

theorem paired (fuel : Nat) {N : Usize} (x : C.E) (hx : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical x)
 (a : Array C.E N) (p : C.E) (hp : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical p)
 (i : Usize) (hi : i.val≤N.val) (remaining : N.val-i.val≤fuel) :
 ∃ out pending,
 XRn_Join_Release.weights.powers_loop x a p i = ok (out,pending) ∧
 (pending=none ∨ pending=some out) ∧
 AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop (toLoop x) (arr toLoop a) (toLoop p) i =
   ok (arr toLoop out) := by
 induction fuel generalizing a p i with
 | zero =>
   have hn : ¬i<N := by scalar_tac
   refine ⟨a,none,?_,Or.inl rfl,?_⟩
   · apply done
     simp only [XRn_Join_Release.weights.powers_loop.body,if_neg hn]
   · apply done
     simp only [AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop.body,if_neg hn]
 | succ n ih =>
   by_cases hlt : i.val<N.val
   · obtain ⟨i',vi,cases⟩ := XRy_PowersStep.step x p a i hlt hx hp
     rcases cases with ⟨he,er,et⟩ | ⟨he,p',hp',er,et⟩
     · refine ⟨a.set i p,some (a.set i p),?_,Or.inr rfl,?_⟩
       · exact done _ _ _ er
       · exact done _ _ _ et
     · obtain ⟨out,pending,hr,hpending,ht⟩ := ih (a.set i p) p' hp' i' (by omega) (by omega)
       refine ⟨out,pending,?_,hpending,?_⟩
       · exact (cont _ _ _ er).trans hr
       · exact (cont _ _ _ et).trans ht
   · have hn : ¬i<N := by scalar_tac
     refine ⟨a,none,?_,Or.inl rfl,?_⟩
     · apply done
       simp only [XRn_Join_Release.weights.powers_loop.body,if_neg hn]
     · apply done
       simp only [AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop.body,if_neg hn]

#print axioms done
#print axioms cont
#print axioms paired
end XRy_PowersLoop

import XRy_PowersLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRo_Join_Carriers XRn_Join_FieldExternal XRy_LoopWide
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRy_Powers

def zero : C.E := ⟨oldQ qzero,oldQ qzero⟩
def one : C.E := ⟨oldQ qone,oldQ qzero⟩

theorem one_canonical : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical one := by
 constructor <;> constructor <;> constructor <;> (change _ < 2147483647; decide)

theorem zero_loop : toLoop zero = AspisR1LoopPowers.field.WideExact.ZERO := by
 unfold AspisR1LoopPowers.field.WideExact.ZERO AspisR1LoopPowers.field.QM31.ZERO
 rfl

theorem one_loop : toLoop one = AspisR1LoopPowers.field.WideExact.ONE := by
 unfold AspisR1LoopPowers.field.WideExact.ONE AspisR1LoopPowers.field.QM31.ONE
   AspisR1LoopPowers.field.QM31.ZERO
 rfl

theorem paired (N : Usize) (x : C.E) (hx : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical x) :
 ∃ out, XRn_Join_Release.weights.powers N x = ok out ∧
 AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers N (toLoop x) = ok (arr toLoop out) := by
 obtain ⟨out,pending,hr,hp,ht⟩ := XRy_PowersLoop.paired N.val x hx
   (Array.repeat N zero) one one_canonical 0#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac)
 refine ⟨out,?_,?_⟩
 · unfold XRn_Join_Release.weights.powers
   simp only [aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO,
     aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ONE,bind_tc_ok]
   change (do let (out,pending) ← XRn_Join_Release.weights.powers_loop x (Array.repeat N zero) one 0#usize
              match pending with | none => ok out | some out2 => ok out2) = ok out
   rw [hr,bind_tc_ok]
   rcases hp with hp | hp <;> rw [hp] <;> rfl
 · simpa only [AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers,XRy_ArrayMap.repeated,zero_loop,one_loop] using ht

#print axioms one_canonical
#print axioms zero_loop
#print axioms one_loop
#print axioms paired
end XRy_Powers

import XRy_Powers
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

set_option autoImplicit false

open AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge

theorem roundtrip {N : Usize} (a : Array C.E N) :
 mapArray fromClaimE (AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.ClaimPowers.mapArray (arr toLoop a)) = a := by
 apply Subtype.ext
 change ((a.val.map toLoop).map _).map fromClaimE = a.val
 rw [List.map_map,List.map_map]
 have hi : ((fromClaimE ∘ AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.ClaimPowers.fromPowers) ∘ toLoop : C.E → C.E) = id := by funext x; rfl
 rw [hi,List.map_id]

theorem powers (N : Usize) (x : C.E) (hx : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical x) :
 XRn_Join_Release.weights.powers N x = AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.powersPublic N x := by
 obtain ⟨out,hr,ht⟩ := XRy_Powers.paired N x hx
 rw [hr]
 unfold powersPublic AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.ClaimPowers.powers
 have hin : AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.ClaimPowers.toPowers (toClaimE x) = toLoop x := rfl
 simp only [hin,ht,bind_tc_ok,roundtrip]

import XRy_PowersPublic
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRn_Join_Release XRo_Join_Carriers
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace XRy_NarrowPrepare

/- The emitted prepare body, with only excluded low_base_p_digits abstracted
through the already checked scalar callback. Powers and cached claim stay raw. -/
def prepare (low : XRq_SamplerInterface.Low)
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (hash : H)
  (g : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize) :
  Result ((core.result.Result verifier.Prepared verifier.Error) × (Array
    aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize))
  := do
  let a ←
    r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.impl.state aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst
      sem.transcript
  let t ←
    transcript.Transcript.new aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst hash a v.variant
  let (gamma, t1) ←
    XRq_OrdinaryScalar.scalar low aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t 27#u8 v.y1 true
  let a1 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes v.inactive
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice a1)
  let (kappa, t2) ←
    XRq_OrdinaryScalar.scalar low aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t1 28#u8 s false
  let (alpha0, t3) ←
    XRq_OrdinaryScalar.scalar low aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t2 29#u8 
      v.round0 false
  let i ← transport.Variant.folds v.variant
  if i = 2#usize
  then
    let i1 ← 32#usize + 224#usize
    let bytes := alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity Std.U8 i1
    let a2 ← core.option.Option.unwrap v.folded_root
    let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice a2)
    let bytes1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 bytes s1
    let bytes2 ←
      alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 bytes1 v.round1
    let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes2
    let (we, t4) ←
      XRq_OrdinaryScalar.scalar low aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t3 30#u8 s2
        false
    let (r, t5) ←
      transcript.Transcript.queries aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t4 31#u8
        v.final_message
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let i2 ← 31#u8 + 1#u8
      let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Std.Array.empty Std.U8))
      let (rho, t6) ←
        transcript.Transcript.scalar_k aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t5 i2 s3
      let g1 ← weights.powers 29#usize gamma
      let r1 ←
        verifier.prepared_claim aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst sem v.y1
          v.inactive g1 kappa
      let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
      match cf1 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val1 =>
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok
          {
            variant := v.variant,
            roots := sem.roots,
            gamma,
            kappa,
            alpha := (Array.make 2#usize [ alpha0, we ]),
            rho,
            queries := val,
            semantic_alpha := sem.alpha,
            z := sem.z,
            claim := val1,
            state := t6.state
          }, g1)
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        let r2 ←
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
            verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
        ok (r2, g1)
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      let r1 ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
      ok (r1, g)
  else
    let we ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO
    let (r, t4) ←
      transcript.Transcript.queries aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t3 30#u8
        v.final_message
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let i1 ← 30#u8 + 1#u8
      let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Std.Array.empty Std.U8))
      let (rho, t5) ←
        transcript.Transcript.scalar_k aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t4 i1 s1
      let g1 ← weights.powers 29#usize gamma
      let r1 ←
        verifier.prepared_claim aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst sem v.y1
          v.inactive g1 kappa
      let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
      match cf1 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val1 =>
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok
          {
            variant := v.variant,
            roots := sem.roots,
            gamma,
            kappa,
            alpha := (Array.make 2#usize [ alpha0, we ]),
            rho,
            queries := val,
            semantic_alpha := sem.alpha,
            z := sem.z,
            claim := val1,
            state := t5.state
          }, g1)
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        let r2 ←
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
            verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
        ok (r2, g1)
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      let r1 ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
      ok (r1, g)


theorem emitted {H : Type} (D : E.D H) (sem : E.Sem H) (v : E.View) (hash : H)
 (g : Array C.E 29#usize) :
 prepare sampler.low_base_p_digits D sem v hash g = verifier.Prepared.new D sem v hash g := rfl

theorem gamma_canonical (low : XRq_SamplerInterface.Low)
 (leaf : ∀ block, low block = AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.low_base_p_digits block)
 {H : Type} (D : C.D H) (before : C.T H) (after : E.T H)
 (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) (out : C.E)
 (run : XRq_OrdinaryScalar.scalar low (ed D) (et before) row payload true = ok (out,after)) :
 XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical out := by
 have h := (XRs_ClosedCallbacks.scalar low leaf D before row payload true).symm.trans
   (congrArg (mapR (fun p => (p.1,ct p.2))) run)
 exact AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.scalar_candidate_gamma_canonical
   XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling D before (ct after) row payload out h

#print axioms emitted
#print axioms gamma_canonical
end XRy_NarrowPrepare
end

theorem scalar (low : XRq_SamplerInterface.Low)
 (leaf : ∀ b, low b=AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.low_base_p_digits b)
 {H : Type} (D : C.D H) (t : E.T H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) (nonzero : Bool) :
 mapR (fun p => (p.1,ct p.2))
   (XRq_OrdinaryScalar.scalar low (ed D) t row payload nonzero) =
 AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.scalar XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling
   D (ct t) row payload nonzero := by
 simpa only [et_ct] using XRs_ClosedCallbacks.scalar low leaf D (ct t) row payload nonzero

theorem queries {H : Type} (D : C.D H) (t : E.T H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) :
 mapR (fun p => (inner id ce p.1,ct p.2))
   (XRn_Join_Release.transcript.Transcript.queries (ed D) t row payload) =
 XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling.queries D (ct t) row payload := by
 simpa only [et_ct] using XRy_Queries.queries D (ct t) row payload

theorem scalar_k {H : Type} (D : C.D H) (t : E.T H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) :
 mapR (fun p => (cq p.1,ct p.2))
   (XRn_Join_Release.transcript.Transcript.scalar_k (ed D) t row payload) =
 AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.scalar_k XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling
   D (ct t) row payload := by
 simpa only [et_ct] using XRq_ScalarK.source D (ct t) row payload

theorem state {H : Type} (D : C.D H) (sem : C.Sem H) :
 XRn_Join_Release.r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.impl.state (ed D) (es sem).transcript =
 AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.impl.state D sem.transcript := rfl

#print axioms scalar

#print axioms state
end XRy_PrepareCallbacks
end

import XRy_PrepareCallbacks
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRo_Join_Carriers XRo_Join_ResultTransport XRo_Join_ResultPair
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace XRy_PrepareRawScratch

def boundaries : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.Boundaries :=
 { sampling := XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling
   powers := XRn_Join_Release.weights.powers
   claim := XRo_Join_PreparedBoundaries.cachedClaim }

theorem prepare (low : XRq_SamplerInterface.Low)
 (leaf : ∀ b, low b=AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.low_base_p_digits b)
 {H : Type} (D : C.D H) (sem : C.Sem H) (v : C.View) (hash : H)
 (g : Array C.E 29#usize) :
 mapR (fun p => (inner cprepared ce p.1,p.2))
   (XRy_NarrowPrepare.prepare low (ed D) (es sem) (eview v) hash g) =
 AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare boundaries D sem v hash g := by
 unfold XRy_NarrowPrepare.prepare AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare
 simp only [boundaries,eview]
 rw [XRy_PrepareCallbacks.state]
 simp only [←XRo_Join_Installed.start,←XRy_PrepareCallbacks.scalar low leaf,
   ←XRy_PrepareCallbacks.queries,←XRy_PrepareCallbacks.scalar_k,
   ←XRs_ClosedCallbacks.serializer,←XRo_Join_Transcript.folds,
   mapR_bind,bind_map,map_let_pair,map_if,map_flow,map_ok]
 congr 1
 funext initial
 congr 1
 funext t
 congr 1
 funext pair
 rcases pair with ⟨gamma,t1⟩
 apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
 intro bytes
 apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
 intro payload
 rw [←XRy_PrepareCallbacks.scalar low leaf D t1 28#u8 payload false]
 rw [bind_map]
 apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
 rintro ⟨kappa,t2⟩
 change mapR _ (XRq_OrdinaryScalar.scalar low (ed D) t2 29#u8 v.round0 false >>= _) =
   (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.scalar XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling D (ct t2) 29#u8 v.round0 false >>= _)
 rw [←XRy_PrepareCallbacks.scalar low leaf D t2 29#u8 v.round0 false]
 rw [bind_map]
 apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
 rintro ⟨alpha0,t3⟩
 apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
 intro folds
 rw [map_if]
 by_cases hf : folds=2#usize
 · simp only [if_pos hf]
   repeat' (apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont; intro)
   rw [←XRy_PrepareCallbacks.scalar low leaf,bind_map]
   apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
   rintro ⟨alpha1,t4⟩
   change mapR _ (XRn_Join_Release.transcript.Transcript.queries (ed D) t4 31#u8 v.final_message >>= _) =
     (XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling.queries D (ct t4) 31#u8 v.final_message >>= _)
   rw [←XRy_PrepareCallbacks.queries,bind_map]
   apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
   rintro ⟨r,t5⟩
   change mapR _ (core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r >>= _) =
     (core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch (inner id ce r) >>= _)
   cases r with
   | Err e => rfl
   | Ok q =>
     simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,XRo_Join_Carriers.inner,id,bind_tc_ok]
     repeat' (apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont; intro)
     rw [←XRy_PrepareCallbacks.scalar_k,bind_map]
     apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
     rintro ⟨rho,t6⟩
     apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
     intro g1
     unfold XRo_Join_PreparedBoundaries.cachedClaim
     rw [bind_map]
     apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
     intro claim
     change mapR _ (core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch claim >>= _) =
       (core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch (inner id ce claim) >>= _)
     cases claim with
     | Err e => rfl
     | Ok value =>
       simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok,mapR,
         XRo_Join_Carriers.inner,id,cprepared,es,cv_ev,
         arr_inverse eq cq cq_eq,arr_inverse ep cp cp_ep]
       rfl
 · simp only [if_neg hf]
   have hz : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO =
     ok AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.WideExact.ZERO := by
     unfold aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO
       AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.WideExact.ZERO
       AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO
     rfl
   rw [hz,bind_tc_ok]
   change mapR _ (XRn_Join_Release.transcript.Transcript.queries (ed D) t3 30#u8 v.final_message >>= _) =
     (XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling.queries D (ct t3) 30#u8 v.final_message >>= _)
   rw [←XRy_PrepareCallbacks.queries,bind_map]
   apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
   rintro ⟨r,t5⟩
   change mapR _ (core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r >>= _) =
     (core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch (inner id ce r) >>= _)
   cases r with
   | Err e => rfl
   | Ok q =>
     simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,XRo_Join_Carriers.inner,id,bind_tc_ok]
     repeat' (apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont; intro)
     rw [←XRy_PrepareCallbacks.scalar_k,bind_map]
     apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
     rintro ⟨rho,t6⟩
     apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
     intro g1
     unfold XRo_Join_PreparedBoundaries.cachedClaim
     rw [bind_map]
     apply XRy_QueryTransport.bind_cont
     intro claim
     change mapR _ (core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch claim >>= _) =
       (core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch (inner id ce claim) >>= _)
     cases claim with
     | Err e => rfl
     | Ok value =>
       simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok,mapR,
         XRo_Join_Carriers.inner,id,cprepared,es,cv_ev,
         arr_inverse eq cq cq_eq,arr_inverse ep cp cp_ep]
       rfl

#print axioms prepare

XRy_PreparePowers.source:
import XRy_PrepareRawScratch
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRo_Join_Carriers
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace XRy_PreparePowers

def exceptClaim : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.Boundaries where
 sampling := XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling
 powers := AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.powersPublic
 claim := XRo_Join_PreparedBoundaries.cachedClaim

theorem gamma_canonical {H : Type} (D : C.D H) (before after : C.T H)
 (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) (out : C.E)
 (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.scalar XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling
   D before row payload true=ok (out,after)) : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical out :=
 AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.scalar_candidate_gamma_canonical
   XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling D before after row payload out h

theorem change_powers {H : Type} (D : C.D H) (sem : C.Sem H) (v : C.View) (hash : H)
 (g : Array C.E 29#usize) :
 AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare XRy_PrepareRawScratch.boundaries D sem v hash g =
 AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare exceptClaim D sem v hash g := by
 unfold AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare
 simp only [XRy_PrepareRawScratch.boundaries,exceptClaim]
 apply (bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
 intro state hs
 apply (bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
 intro t ht
 apply (bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
 rintro ⟨gamma,t1⟩ hg
 have hc := gamma_canonical D t t1 27#u8 v.y1 gamma hg
 change (XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling.toBytes v.inactive >>= _) =
   (XRo_Join_Installed.actual.sampling.toBytes v.inactive >>= _)
 simp only [XRy_PowersPublic.powers 29#usize gamma hc]

theorem prepare (low : XRq_SamplerInterface.Low)
 (leaf : ∀ b, low b=AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.low_base_p_digits b)
 {H : Type} (D : C.D H) (sem : C.Sem H) (v : C.View) (hash : H)
 (g : Array C.E 29#usize) :
 mapR (fun p => (inner cprepared ce p.1,p.2))
   (XRy_NarrowPrepare.prepare low (ed D) (es sem) (eview v) hash g) =
 AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare exceptClaim D sem v hash g :=
 (XRy_PrepareRawScratch.prepare low leaf D sem v hash g).trans (change_powers D sem v hash g)

#print axioms gamma_canonical
#print axioms change_powers
#print axioms prepare
