import XRy_PreparePowers
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRo_Join_Carriers XRo_Join_ResultTransport
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRy_ClaimArithmetic
open AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge
abbrev CE := AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete.E
abbrev W := XRy_WideMultiply.W

def toMinimal (x : CE) : W :=
 AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.toMinimalWide (AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete.toFull x)
def fromMinimal (x : W) : CE :=
 ⟨⟨⟨x.c0.c0.a,x.c0.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c0.c1.a,x.c0.c1.b⟩⟩,
  ⟨⟨x.c1.c0.a,x.c1.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c1.c1.a,x.c1.c1.b⟩⟩⟩

theorem roundtrip (x : CE) : fromMinimal (toMinimal x)=x := rfl

theorem injective : Function.Injective toMinimal := by
 intro a b h
 exact (roundtrip a).symm.trans ((congrArg fromMinimal h).trans (roundtrip b))

theorem mul_graph (a b : C.E) :
 mapR toMinimal (AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.mul (toClaimE a) (toClaimE b)) =
 AspisR1CurrentWideMul.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul (XRy_WideMultiply.toWide a) (XRy_WideMultiply.toWide b) := by
 unfold AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.mul
 simp only [mapR,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]
 exact AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.wide_mul_same_minimal _ _

theorem multiply (a b : C.E) (ha : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical a) (hb : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical b) :
 ∃ z, aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul a b = ok z ∧ XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical z ∧
 AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.mul (toClaimE a) (toClaimE b) = ok (toClaimE z) := by
 obtain ⟨z,hz,hc,ht⟩ := XRy_WideMultiply.total a b ha hb
 refine ⟨z,hz,hc,?_⟩
 apply map_injective toMinimal injective
 exact (mul_graph a b).trans ht

#print axioms roundtrip
#print axioms injective
#print axioms mul_graph
#print axioms multiply
end XRy_ClaimArithmetic

import XRy_ClaimArithmetic
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRo_Join_Carriers XRo_Join_ResultTransport XRn_Join_FieldExternal XRp_PowersQAdd
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRy_ClaimAdd
open AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge XRy_ClaimArithmetic

def minimalAdd (a b : W) : Result W := do
 let lo ← AspisR1CurrentWideMul.field.QM31.add a.c0 b.c0
 let hi ← AspisR1CurrentWideMul.field.QM31.add a.c1 b.c1
 ok ⟨lo,hi⟩

theorem full_graph (a b : AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.E) :
 mapR AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.toMinimalWide
   (AspisR1CurrentWide.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add a b) =
 minimalAdd (AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.toMinimalWide a)
   (AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.toMinimalWide b) := by
 simp only [AspisR1CurrentWide.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add,minimalAdd,
   AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.toMinimalWide,AspisR1CurrentWideMul.field.QM31.add,
   ←AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.qm_add_same,mapR,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]

theorem graph (a b : C.E) :
 mapR toMinimal (AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.add (toClaimE a) (toClaimE b)) =
 minimalAdd (XRy_WideMultiply.toWide a) (XRy_WideMultiply.toWide b) := by
 unfold AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.add
 simp only [mapR,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]
 exact full_graph _ _

theorem add (a b : C.E) (ha : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical a) (hb : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical b) :
 ∃ z, aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add a b = ok z ∧ XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical z ∧
 AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.add (toClaimE a) (toClaimE b) = ok (toClaimE z) := by
 obtain ⟨lo,el,hl,tl⟩ := XRy_QmLinear.add (newQ a.c0) (newQ b.c0) ha.1 hb.1
 obtain ⟨hi,eh,hh,th⟩ := XRy_QmLinear.add (newQ a.c1) (newQ b.c1) ha.2 hb.2
 let z : C.E := ⟨oldQ lo,oldQ hi⟩
 have ht : minimalAdd (XRy_WideMultiply.toWide a) (XRy_WideMultiply.toWide b) = ok (toMinimal (toClaimE z)) := by
   simp only [minimalAdd,XRy_WideMultiply.toWide,tl,th,bind_tc_ok]
   rfl
 refine ⟨z,?_,⟨hl,hh⟩,?_⟩
 · simp only [aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add,el,eh,bind_tc_ok,z]
 · apply map_injective toMinimal injective
   exact (graph a b).trans ht

#print axioms full_graph
#print axioms graph
#print axioms add
end XRy_ClaimAdd

XRy_ClaimFold.source:
import XRy_ClaimAdd
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRo_Join_Carriers
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRy_ClaimFold
open AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge

def canonicalList (xs : List C.E) : Prop := ∀ x ∈ xs, XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical x

theorem fold (pairs : List (C.E × C.E))
 (hc : ∀ pair ∈ pairs, XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical pair.1 ∧ XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical pair.2)
 (sum : C.E) (hs : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical sum) :
 ∃ out, XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical out ∧
 pairs.foldlM (fun sum pair => do
   let term ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul pair.1 pair.2
   aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add sum term) sum = ok out ∧
 pairs.foldlM (fun sum pair => do
   let term ← AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.mul
     (toClaimE pair.1) (toClaimE pair.2)
   AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.add sum term) (toClaimE sum) =
   ok (toClaimE out) := by
 induction pairs generalizing sum with
 | nil => exact ⟨sum,hs,rfl,rfl⟩
 | cons pair rest ih =>
   have hp := hc pair (by simp)
   obtain ⟨term,et,ht,tt⟩ := XRy_ClaimArithmetic.multiply pair.1 pair.2 hp.1 hp.2
   obtain ⟨next,en,hn,tn⟩ := XRy_ClaimAdd.add sum term hs ht
   obtain ⟨out,ho,er,tr⟩ := ih (fun p h => hc p (List.mem_cons_of_mem pair h)) next hn
   refine ⟨out,ho,?_,?_⟩
   · simp only [List.foldlM_cons,et,en,bind_tc_ok]
     exact er
   · simp only [List.foldlM_cons,tt,tn,bind_tc_ok]
     exact tr

#print axioms fold
end XRy_ClaimFold

XRy_ListPowers.source:
import XRy_ClaimFold
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRo_Join_Carriers
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRy_ListPowers

theorem total (n : Nat) (x p : C.E)
 (hx : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical x) (hp : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical p) :
 ∃ xs, XRn_Join_powers x n p = ok xs ∧ xs.length=n ∧ XRy_ClaimFold.canonicalList xs := by
 induction n generalizing p with
 | zero => exact ⟨[],rfl,rfl,by intro a h; cases h⟩
 | succ n ih =>
   cases n with
   | zero => exact ⟨[p],rfl,rfl,by intro a h; simp only [List.mem_singleton] at h; exact h ▸ hp⟩
   | succ m =>
     obtain ⟨next,en,hn,_⟩ := XRy_ClaimArithmetic.multiply p x hp hx
     obtain ⟨xs,ex,hl,hc⟩ := ih next hn
     refine ⟨p::xs,?_,by simp only [List.length_cons,hl],?_⟩
     · simp only [XRn_Join_powers,en,ex,bind_tc_ok]
     · intro a h
       rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h | h
       · exact h ▸ hp
       · exact hc a h

#print axioms total
end XRy_ListPowers

theorem read {A : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array A N) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val<N.val) :
 Array.index_usize a i = ok (a.val[i.val]'(by rw [a.property]; exact hi)) := by
 obtain ⟨x,hx,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (Array.index_usize_spec a i (by simpa [a.property] using hi))
 exact hx.trans (congrArg ok hv)

theorem mapped {A B : Type} {N : Usize} (f : A → B) (a : Array A N) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val<N.val) :
 Array.index_usize (arr f a) i = ok (f (a.val[i.val]'(by rw [a.property]; exact hi))) := by
 rw [read (arr f a) i hi]
 simp only [arr,List.getElem_map]

theorem usize_small (i : Usize) (hi : i.val<7) : XRn_Join_usize i.val=i := by
 apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
 change i.val%(UScalar.cMax .Usize+1)=i.val
 apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
 have hmin : 7 ≤ UScalar.cMax .Usize := by scalar_tac
 omega

#print axioms usize_small
end XRy_ArrayRead

LPq_PointConstruct.source:
import LPm_PointLength
import XRy_ArrayRead
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_PointConstruct
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPm_RawPort AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim

/-- Local read ports, not a supplied loop trace or output equation. The concrete
semantic and selected-byte decoder domain must establish these ports. -/
def ReadDomain {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8)
    (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (point : Usize) : Prop :=
  (∀ l : Usize, l.val<29 → ∃ q : NQ, canonQ q ∧
    ClaimScalar.read LPm_PointLoop.ops sem y1 point l=ok (qPort q)) ∧
  (∀ l : Usize, l.val<29 → ∃ v : NE, canonE v ∧
    Array.index_usize g l=ok (ePort v))

/-- Construct the linked native observations by induction on remaining source
iterations. Nothing assumes a complete public-fold trace or whole-loop Result. -/
theorem loop {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8)
    (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (point : Usize)
    (domain : ReadDomain sem y1 g point) (fuel : Nat)
    (iter : LPm_PointLoop.Range) (s : Native)
    (last : iter.end.val=29) (bound : iter.start.val≤29)
    (remaining : 29-iter.start.val≤fuel)
    (bounded : LPm_PublicFold.Bounded s iter.start.val) :
    ∃ xs out, LPm_PointLoop.Trace sem y1 g point iter s xs out := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter s with
  | zero =>
    have stopped : ¬ (iter.start.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
    obtain ⟨⟨o,iter'⟩,call,shape⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (Aeneas.Std.core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_spec
        (cloneInst := core.clone.CloneUsize) (partialOrdInst := core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize)
        (by intros; rfl) (by intros; rfl) iter)
    simp only [stopped,↓reduceIte] at shape
    obtain ⟨out,finish,_⟩ := LPm_FinishPort.source s
    exact ⟨[],out,.done iter iter' s out (by rw [shape.1.1] at call; exact call) finish⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨⟨o,iter'⟩,call,shape⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (Aeneas.Std.core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_spec
        (cloneInst := core.clone.CloneUsize) (partialOrdInst := core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize)
        (by intros; rfl) (by intros; rfl) iter)
    by_cases active : iter.start.val < iter.end.val
    · simp only [active,↓reduceIte] at shape
      have hl : iter.start.val<29 := by omega
      obtain ⟨q,cq,read⟩ := domain.1 iter.start hl
      obtain ⟨v,cv,weight⟩ := domain.2 iter.start hl
      obtain ⟨next,push,bnext,_⟩ := LPm_PublicFold.step s v q iter.start.val hl bounded cv cq
      have last' : iter'.end.val=29 := by rw [shape.2]; exact last
      have advance : iter'.start.val=iter.start.val+1 := shape.1.2
      have bound' : iter'.start.val≤29 := by omega
      have remain' : 29-iter'.start.val≤n := by omega
      have bn : LPm_PublicFold.Bounded next iter'.start.val := by rw [shape.1.2]; exact bnext
      obtain ⟨xs,out,tail⟩ := ih iter' next last' bound' remain' bn
      exact ⟨(v,q)::xs,out,.step iter.start v q
        (by rw [shape.1.1] at call; exact call) read weight cv cq
        (by rw [bounded.1]; exact hl) push tail⟩
    · simp only [active,↓reduceIte] at shape
      obtain ⟨out,finish,_⟩ := LPm_FinishPort.source s
      exact ⟨[],out,.done iter iter' s out (by rw [shape.1.1] at call; exact call) finish⟩

theorem from_zero {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8)
    (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (point : Usize)
    (domain : ReadDomain sem y1 g point) :
    ∃ xs out, LPm_PointLoop.Trace sem y1 g point
      {start:=0#usize,«end»:=29#usize} LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero xs out := by
  exact loop sem y1 g point domain 29 _ _ rfl (by decide) (by decide)
    LPm_PublicTwentyNine.initial_bound

#print axioms loop
#print axioms from_zero
end AspisR1.LPq_PointConstruct

  obtain ⟨bd,hbd,cbd,ebd⟩ := LPq_FieldPorts.cm_mul x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,ea⟩ := LPq_FieldPorts.cm_add x.c0 x.c1 hx.1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨b,hb,cb,eb⟩ := LPq_FieldPorts.cm_add y.c0 y.c1 hy.1 hy.2
  obtain ⟨cross,hcross,ccross,ecross⟩ := LPq_FieldPorts.cm_mul a b ca cb
  obtain ⟨r,hr,cr,er⟩ := LPq_FieldPorts.by_r bd cbd
  obtain ⟨lo,hlo,clo,elo⟩ := LPq_FieldPorts.cm_add ac r cac cr
  obtain ⟨d,hd,cd,ed⟩ := LPq_FieldPorts.cm_sub cross ac ccross cac
  obtain ⟨hi,hhi,chi,ehi⟩ := LPq_FieldPorts.cm_sub d bd cd cbd
  exact ⟨⟨lo,hi⟩,by simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.mul,
    hac,hbd,ha,hb,hcross,hr,hlo,hd,hhi,bind_tc_ok],⟨clo,chi⟩,
    by simp only [XRn_Join_Field.field.QM31.mul,qm,eac,ebd,ea,eb,ecross,er,elo,ed,ehi,bind_tc_ok]⟩

theorem mul_u (x : NQ) (hx : canonQ x) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.mul_u x=ok z ∧ canonQ z ∧
      XRn_Join_Field.field.wide_exact.mul_u (qm x)=ok (qm z) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,ea⟩ := LPq_FieldPorts.by_r x.c1 hx.2
  exact ⟨⟨a,x.c0⟩,by simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.mul_u,ha,bind_tc_ok],
    ⟨ca,hx.1⟩,by simp only [XRn_Join_Field.field.wide_exact.mul_u,qm,ea,bind_tc_ok]⟩

#print axioms add
#print axioms sub
#print axioms mul
#print axioms mul_u

import LPq_TowerPorts
import XRy_LoopWide
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_WidePorts
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPq_FieldPorts XRo_Join_Carriers

theorem canonical (x : NE) (hx : canonE x) : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical (wide x) := hx

theorem mul (x y : NE) (hx : canonE x) (hy : canonE y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul x y=ok z ∧ canonE z ∧
      aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul (wide x) (wide y)=ok (wide z) := by
  obtain ⟨ac,hac,cac,eac⟩ := LPq_TowerPorts.mul x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨bd,hbd,cbd,ebd⟩ := LPq_TowerPorts.mul x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,ea⟩ := LPq_TowerPorts.add x.c0 x.c1 hx.1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨b,hb,cb,eb⟩ := LPq_TowerPorts.add y.c0 y.c1 hy.1 hy.2
  obtain ⟨cross,hcross,ccross,ecross⟩ := LPq_TowerPorts.mul a b ca cb
  obtain ⟨u,hu,cu,eu⟩ := LPq_TowerPorts.mul_u bd cbd
  obtain ⟨lo,hlo,clo,elo⟩ := LPq_TowerPorts.add ac u cac cu
  obtain ⟨d,hd,cd,ed⟩ := LPq_TowerPorts.sub cross ac ccross cac
  obtain ⟨hi,hhi,chi,ehi⟩ := LPq_TowerPorts.sub d bd cd cbd
  refine ⟨⟨lo,hi⟩,?_,⟨clo,chi⟩,?_⟩
  · simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul,
      hac,hbd,ha,hb,hcross,hu,hlo,hd,hhi,bind_tc_ok]
  · change (do
      let ac ← XRn_Join_Field.field.QM31.mul (qm x.c0) (qm y.c0)
      let bd ← XRn_Join_Field.field.QM31.mul (qm x.c1) (qm y.c1)
      let a ← XRn_Join_Field.field.QM31.add (qm x.c0) (qm x.c1)
      let b ← XRn_Join_Field.field.QM31.add (qm y.c0) (qm y.c1)
      let cross ← XRn_Join_Field.field.QM31.mul a b
      let u ← XRn_Join_Field.field.wide_exact.mul_u bd
      let lo ← XRn_Join_Field.field.QM31.add ac u
      let d ← XRn_Join_Field.field.QM31.sub cross ac
      let hi ← XRn_Join_Field.field.QM31.sub d bd
      ok (⟨XRn_Join_FieldExternal.oldQ lo,XRn_Join_FieldExternal.oldQ hi⟩ : C.E)) = _
    simp only [eac,ebd,ea,eb,ecross,eu,elo,ed,ehi,bind_tc_ok]
    rfl

theorem loop_mul (x y : NE) (hx : canonE x) (hy : canonE y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul x y=ok z ∧ canonE z ∧
      AspisR1LoopPowers.field.WideExact.mul (XRy_LoopWide.toLoop (wide x))
        (XRy_LoopWide.toLoop (wide y))=ok (XRy_LoopWide.toLoop (wide z)) := by
  obtain ⟨z,native,cz,release⟩ := mul x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨other,actual,_,model⟩ := XRy_LoopWide.multiply (wide x) (wide y)
    (canonical x hx) (canonical y hy)
  have same : other=wide z := Result.ok.inj (actual.symm.trans release)
  rw [same] at model
  exact ⟨z,native,cz,model⟩

#print axioms canonical
#print axioms mul
#print axioms loop_mul
end AspisR1.LPq_WidePorts

LPq_PowersStep.source:
import LPq_WidePorts
import XRy_PowersStep
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_PowersStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow LPi_FieldValues LPq_FieldPorts XRo_Join_Carriers
abbrev port (x : NE) := XRy_LoopWide.toLoop (wide x)

theorem step {N : Usize} (x p : NE) (a : Array NE N) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val<N.val) (hx : canonE x) (hp : canonE p) :
    ∃ i', i'.val=i.val+1 ∧
      ((i'=N ∧ FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body x a p i=ok (.done (a.set i p)) ∧
        AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop.body (port x) (arr port a) (port p) i=
          ok (.done (arr port (a.set i p)))) ∨
       (i'≠N ∧ ∃ p', canonE p' ∧
        FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body x a p i=ok (.cont (a.set i p,p',i')) ∧
        AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop.body (port x) (arr port a) (port p) i=
          ok (.cont (arr port (a.set i p),port p',i')))) := by
  obtain ⟨old,hm⟩ := XRy_PowersStep.mutable a i hi
  obtain ⟨old',hm'⟩ := XRy_PowersStep.mutable (arr port a) i hi
  have hN : N.val ≤ Usize.max := by scalar_tac
  have hAdd : (i+1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃ j => j.val=i.val+1 ⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    have hone : (1#usize).val=1 := by scalar_tac
    simpa only [hone,UScalar.max_USize_eq] using (show i.val+1 ≤ Usize.max by omega)
  obtain ⟨i',ei,vi⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hAdd
  have wi : Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize=i' := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
    have hn : N.val < UScalar.size .Usize := by
      simpa only [UScalar.size,UScalar.val,UScalarTy.numBits] using N.bv.isLt
    change (i.val+1)%UScalar.size .Usize=i'.val
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    exact vi.symm
  have hlt : i<N := by scalar_tac
  refine ⟨i',vi,?_⟩
  by_cases he : i'=N
  · left
    refine ⟨he,?_,?_⟩
    · simp only [FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body,if_pos hlt,hm,lift,bind_tc_ok,wi,he,↓reduceIte]
      rfl
    · simp only [AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop.body,if_pos hlt,hm',ei,
        bind_tc_ok,he,↓reduceIte,XRy_ArrayMap.set]
      rfl
  · right
    obtain ⟨p',ep,hp',tp⟩ := LPq_WidePorts.loop_mul p x hp hx
    refine ⟨he,p',hp',?_,?_⟩
    · simp only [FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body,if_pos hlt,hm,lift,bind_tc_ok,wi,if_neg he,ep]
      rfl
    · simp only [AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop.body,if_pos hlt,hm',ei,
        bind_tc_ok,if_neg he,tp,XRy_ArrayMap.set]
      rfl

#print axioms step
end AspisR1.LPq_PowersStep

LPq_Powers.source:
import LPq_PowersStep
import XRy_PowersLoop
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_Powers
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow LPi_FieldValues LPq_FieldPorts LPq_PowersStep XRo_Join_Carriers

theorem loop (fuel : Nat) {N : Usize} (x : NE) (hx : canonE x)
    (a : Array NE N) (p : NE) (hp : canonE p) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val≤N.val) (remaining : N.val-i.val≤fuel) :
    ∃ out, FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop x a p i=ok out ∧
      AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop (port x) (arr port a) (port p) i=
        ok (arr port out) := by
  induction fuel generalizing a p i with
  | zero =>
    have hn : ¬i<N := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨a,?_,?_⟩
    · apply XRy_PowersLoop.done
      simp only [FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body,if_neg hn]
    · apply XRy_PowersLoop.done
      simp only [AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop.body,if_neg hn]
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hlt : i.val<N.val
    · obtain ⟨i',vi,cases⟩ := LPq_PowersStep.step x p a i hlt hx hp
      rcases cases with ⟨he,en,et⟩ | ⟨he,p',hp',en,et⟩
      · exact ⟨a.set i p,XRy_PowersLoop.done _ _ _ en,XRy_PowersLoop.done _ _ _ et⟩
      · obtain ⟨out,hr,ht⟩ := ih (a.set i p) p' hp' i' (by omega) (by omega)
        exact ⟨out,(XRy_PowersLoop.cont _ _ _ en).trans hr,
          (XRy_PowersLoop.cont _ _ _ et).trans ht⟩
    · have hn : ¬i<N := by scalar_tac
      refine ⟨a,?_,?_⟩
      · apply XRy_PowersLoop.done
        simp only [FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body,if_neg hn]
      · apply XRy_PowersLoop.done
        simp only [AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers_loop.body,if_neg hn]

def claim (x : NE) : AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete.E :=
  AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.toClaimE (wide x)

theorem one_canonical : canonE FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ONE := by
  norm_num [canonE,canonQ,canonC,LPi_CMProduct.Canon,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ONE,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.ONE,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO]

theorem zero_port : port FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO=
    AspisR1LoopPowers.field.WideExact.ZERO := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO
    AspisR1LoopPowers.field.WideExact.ZERO AspisR1LoopPowers.field.QM31.ZERO
  rfl

theorem one_port : port FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ONE=
    AspisR1LoopPowers.field.WideExact.ONE := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ONE FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.ONE
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO AspisR1LoopPowers.field.WideExact.ONE
    AspisR1LoopPowers.field.QM31.ONE AspisR1LoopPowers.field.QM31.ZERO
  rfl

theorem map_ports {N : Usize} (a : Array NE N) :
    AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.ClaimPowers.mapArray (arr port a)=arr claim a := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (a.val.map port).map AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.ClaimPowers.fromPowers=a.val.map claim
  rw [List.map_map]
  rfl

/-- Total native emitted powers and the concrete cohort powers, SAME returned
array with all eight words ported. Native seven-write evidence can identify this
unique carrier; no powers Result equality is an input hypothesis. -/
theorem source (N : Usize) (x : NE) (hx : canonE x) :
    ∃ out, FIo_Native.weights.powers N x=ok out ∧
      AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.ClaimPowers.powers N (claim x)=ok (arr claim out) := by
  obtain ⟨out,hn,ht⟩ := loop N.val x hx
    (Array.repeat N FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO)
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ONE one_canonical 0#usize
    (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac)
  refine ⟨out,hn,?_⟩
  have model : AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers N (port x)=ok (arr port out) := by
    simpa only [AspisR1LoopPowers.weights.early_powers,XRy_ArrayMap.repeated,zero_port,one_port] using ht
  unfold AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.ClaimPowers.powers
  have input : AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.ClaimPowers.toPowers (claim x)=port x := rfl
  rw [input,model,bind_tc_ok,map_ports]

#print axioms loop
#print axioms one_canonical
#print axioms zero_port
#print axioms one_port
#print axioms map_ports
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPq_Powers

import LPq_Powers
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_IndexPorts
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem add (x y : Usize) (h : x.val+y.val<UScalar.size .Usize) :
    x+y=ok (Usize.wrapping_add x y) := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.add_spec (x:=x) (y:=y) (by
    have hm : x.val+y.val ≤ Usize.max := by
      simp only [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,Usize.max,Usize.numBits] at h ⊢
      scalar_tac
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using hm))
  have hw := Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq x y
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h] at hw
  exact hz.trans (congrArg ok (UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (hv.trans hw.symm)))

theorem mul (x y : Usize) (h : x.val*y.val<UScalar.size .Usize) :
    x*y=ok (Usize.wrapping_mul x y) := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.mul_spec (x:=x) (y:=y) (by
    have hm : x.val*y.val ≤ Usize.max := by
      simp only [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,Usize.max,Usize.numBits] at h ⊢
      scalar_tac
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using hm))
  have hw := Usize.wrapping_mul_val_eq x y
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h] at hw
  exact hz.trans (congrArg ok (UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (hv.trans hw.symm)))

#print axioms add
#print axioms mul
end AspisR1.LPq_IndexPorts

import LPq_IndexPorts
import XRo_Join_ResultTransport
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_Decoder
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues XRo_Join_Carriers XRo_Join_ResultTransport

def record (x : NE) : AspisR1RecordParser.field.wide_exact.WideExact :=
  ⟨⟨⟨x.c0.c0.a,x.c0.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c0.c1.a,x.c0.c1.b⟩⟩,
   ⟨⟨x.c1.c0.a,x.c1.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c1.c1.a,x.c1.c1.b⟩⟩⟩

theorem limbs (a : Array U32 8#usize) :
    mapR (Option.map record) (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs a)=
      AspisR1RecordParser.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs a := by
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs,
    AspisR1RecordParser.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P,AspisR1RecordParser.field.P,
    mapR_bind,map_if,map_ok,Option.map_some,Option.map_none,record]

theorem bytes (b : Slice U8) :
    mapR (Option.map record) (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes b)=
      AspisR1RecordParser.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes b := by
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes,
    AspisR1RecordParser.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.BYTE_LEN,
    AspisR1RecordParser.field.wide_exact.WideExact.BYTE_LEN,
    map_if,map_ok,Option.map_none,mapR_bind,limbs]

theorem unwrap (o : Option NE) :
    mapR record (core.option.Option.unwrap o)=core.option.Option.unwrap (Option.map record o) := by
  cases o <;> rfl

theorem field (b : Slice U8) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val<29) :
    mapR record (FIo_Native.weights.field b i)=
      AspisR1WeightsFieldCurrent.weights.field
        AspisR1RecordParser.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes b i := by
  have hm : 928<UScalar.size .Usize := by
    have hmax : 928 ≤ Usize.max := by scalar_tac
    simp only [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,Usize.max,Usize.numBits] at hmax ⊢
    scalar_tac
  have h32 : (32#usize).val=32 := by scalar_tac
  have h1 : (1#usize).val=1 := by scalar_tac
  have fitsAdd : i.val+(1#usize).val<UScalar.size .Usize := by rw [h1]; omega
  have nextVal : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val=i.val+1 := by
    rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt fitsAdd,h1]
  have rm := LPq_IndexPorts.mul i 32#usize (by rw [h32]; omega)
  have ra := LPq_IndexPorts.add i 1#usize fitsAdd
  have re := LPq_IndexPorts.mul (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) 32#usize
    (by rw [nextVal,h32]; omega)
  unfold FIo_Native.weights.field AspisR1WeightsFieldCurrent.weights.field
  simp only [mapR_bind,←bytes,bind_map,unwrap,rm,ra,re,lift,bind_tc_ok]

/-- SAME selected-byte parser, full Result including noncanonical and range
failures, after the concrete eight-word cohort owner port. -/
theorem claim_field (b : Slice U8) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val<29) :
    mapR LPq_Powers.claim (FIo_Native.weights.field b i)=
      AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.ClaimParser.field b i := by
  unfold AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.ClaimParser.field AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.finishField
  rw [←field b i hi]
  simp only [mapR,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl

#print axioms limbs
#print axioms bytes
#print axioms unwrap
#print axioms field
#print axioms claim_field
end AspisR1.LPq_Decoder

import LPq_PointConstruct
import LPq_Decoder
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_ReadPorts
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPm_RawPort AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim

def backQ (q : aspis_core.field.QM31) : NQ := ⟨⟨q.c0.a,q.c0.b⟩,⟨q.c1.a,q.c1.b⟩⟩
def backE (e : Concrete.E) : NE := ⟨backQ e.c0,backQ e.c1⟩
theorem q_roundtrip (q : aspis_core.field.QM31) : qPort (backQ q)=q := rfl
theorem e_roundtrip (e : Concrete.E) : ePort (backE e)=e := rfl

def SemCanonical {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) : Prop :=
  (∀ row ∈ sem.claims.val, ∀ q ∈ row.val, canonQ (backQ q)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ sem.extra.val, canonQ (backQ q)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ sem.before_z1.val, canonQ (backQ q))

def WeightsCanonical (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ g.val, canonE (backE v)

theorem weights (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (hg : WeightsCanonical g)
    (l : Usize) (hl : l.val<29) :
    ∃ v : NE, canonE v ∧ Array.index_usize g l=ok (ePort v) := by
  have h : l.val<g.val.length := by rw [g.property]; exact hl
  exact ⟨backE g.val[l.val],hg _ (List.getElem_mem h),by
    rw [e_roundtrip]; exact XRy_ArrayRead.read g l hl⟩

/-- Selection ports derived from the SAME semantic arrays, not supplied reads. -/
theorem semantic {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (hc : SemCanonical sem)
    (y1 : Slice U8) (point l : Usize) (hp : point.val<5) (hl : l.val<29) :
    ∃ q : NQ, canonQ q ∧ ClaimScalar.read LPm_PointLoop.ops sem y1 point l=ok (qPort q) := by
  by_cases h3 : point.val<3
  · have pr : point.val<sem.claims.val.length := by rw [sem.claims.property]; exact h3
    let row := sem.claims.val[point.val]
    have lr : l.val<row.val.length := by rw [row.property]; exact hl
    refine ⟨backQ row.val[l.val],hc.1 _ (List.getElem_mem pr) _ (List.getElem_mem lr),?_⟩
    rw [q_roundtrip,LPm_SemanticSelections.claims _ _ _ _ _ h3,
      XRy_ArrayRead.read sem.claims point h3,bind_tc_ok]
    exact XRy_ArrayRead.read row l hl
  · by_cases h4 : point.val=3
    · have lr : l.val<sem.extra.val.length := by rw [sem.extra.property]; exact hl
      refine ⟨backQ sem.extra.val[l.val],hc.2.1 _ (List.getElem_mem lr),?_⟩
      rw [q_roundtrip,LPm_SemanticSelections.extra _ _ _ _ _ h4]
      exact XRy_ArrayRead.read sem.extra l hl
    · have h5 : point.val=4 := by omega
      have lr : l.val<sem.before_z1.val.length := by rw [sem.before_z1.property]; exact hl
      refine ⟨backQ sem.before_z1.val[l.val],hc.2.2 _ (List.getElem_mem lr),?_⟩
      rw [q_roundtrip,LPm_SemanticSelections.before_z1 _ _ _ _ _ h5]
      exact XRy_ArrayRead.read sem.before_z1 l hl

theorem five_domains {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (hc : SemCanonical sem)
    (y1 : Slice U8) (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (hg : WeightsCanonical g)
    (point : Usize) (hp : point.val<5) : LPq_PointConstruct.ReadDomain sem y1 g point :=
  ⟨fun l hl => semantic sem hc y1 point l hp hl, fun l hl => weights g hg l hl⟩

import LPq_ReadPorts
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_ExpandedWords
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def byte (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) : Nat := (bs[i]?.getD 0#u8).val
def word (bs : List U8) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  byte bs i + 256*byte bs (i+1) + 65536*byte bs (i+2) + 16777216*byte bs (i+3)

/-- Exactly the low16-copy/high16-zero postcondition of the CLOSED LPn
expand_values leaf on the same compact and expanded carriers. -/
def Expanded (compact y1 : List U8) : Prop := ∀ row, row<29 → ∀ lane, lane<32 →
  byte y1 (32*row+lane)=if lane<16 then byte compact (16*row+lane) else 0

def CompactCanonical (compact : List U8) : Prop := ∀ row, row<29 → ∀ limb,
  limb<4 → word compact (16*row+4*limb)<2147483647

theorem low (compact y1 : List U8) (h : Expanded compact y1) (row limb : Nat)
    (hr : row<29) (hl : limb<4) :
    word y1 (32*row+4*limb)=word compact (16*row+4*limb) := by
  have b0 := h row hr (4*limb) (by omega)
  have b1 := h row hr (4*limb+1) (by omega)
  have b2 := h row hr (4*limb+2) (by omega)
  have b3 := h row hr (4*limb+3) (by omega)
  simp only [if_pos (show 4*limb<16 by omega)] at b0
  simp only [if_pos (show 4*limb+1<16 by omega)] at b1
  simp only [if_pos (show 4*limb+2<16 by omega)] at b2
  simp only [if_pos (show 4*limb+3<16 by omega)] at b3
  simp only [word,Nat.add_assoc,b0,b1,b2,b3]

theorem high (compact y1 : List U8) (h : Expanded compact y1) (row limb : Nat)
    (hr : row<29) (hl : 4≤limb) (hu : limb<8) : word y1 (32*row+4*limb)=0 := by
  have b0 := h row hr (4*limb) (by omega)
  have b1 := h row hr (4*limb+1) (by omega)
  have b2 := h row hr (4*limb+2) (by omega)
  have b3 := h row hr (4*limb+3) (by omega)
  simp only [if_neg (show ¬ (4*limb<16) by omega)] at b0
  simp only [if_neg (show ¬ (4*limb+1<16) by omega)] at b1
  simp only [if_neg (show ¬ (4*limb+2<16) by omega)] at b2
  simp only [if_neg (show ¬ (4*limb+3<16) by omega)] at b3
  simp only [word,Nat.add_assoc,b0,b1,b2,b3,Nat.mul_zero,Nat.add_zero]

theorem canonical (compact y1 : List U8) (h : Expanded compact y1)
    (hc : CompactCanonical compact) (row limb : Nat) (hr : row<29) (hl : limb<8) :
    word y1 (32*row+4*limb)<2147483647 := by
  by_cases small : limb<4
  · rw [low compact y1 h row limb hr small];exact hc row hr limb small
  · rw [high compact y1 h row limb hr (by omega) hl];decide

#print axioms low
#print axioms high
#print axioms canonical
end AspisR1.LPq_ExpandedWords

import LPq_ReadPorts
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_SixPoints
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPm_RawPort AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim

/-- Explicit remaining decoder-success domain. This is a local byte-read
observation, not a supplied public sum or whole-loop Result. Its establishment
from canonical_scan/expand_values is a separate caller obligation. -/
def SelectedFields (y1 : Slice U8) : Prop := ∀ l : Usize, l.val<29 →
  ∃ v : NE, canonE v ∧ FIo_Native.weights.field y1 l=ok v

theorem selected {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8)
    (hy : SelectedFields y1) (point l : Usize) (hp : point.val=5) (hl : l.val<29) :
    ∃ q : NQ, canonQ q ∧ ClaimScalar.read LPm_PointLoop.ops sem y1 point l=ok (qPort q) := by
  obtain ⟨v,cv,read⟩ := hy l hl
  have port := LPq_Decoder.claim_field y1 l hl
  rw [read] at port
  have hlarge : ¬ point≤2#usize := by scalar_tac
  refine ⟨v.c0,cv.1,?_⟩
  simp only [ClaimScalar.read,if_neg hlarge,hp]
  change (do let e ← ClaimParser.field y1 l; ClaimParser.c0 e)=ok (qPort v.c0)
  rw [←port]
  rfl

theorem domain {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (hs : LPq_ReadPorts.SemCanonical sem) (y1 : Slice U8) (hy : SelectedFields y1)
    (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (hg : LPq_ReadPorts.WeightsCanonical g)
    (point : Usize) (hp : point.val<6) : LPq_PointConstruct.ReadDomain sem y1 g point := by
  by_cases h5 : point.val<5
  · exact LPq_ReadPorts.five_domains sem hs y1 g hg point h5
  · exact ⟨fun l hl => selected sem y1 hy point l (by omega) hl,
      fun l hl => LPq_ReadPorts.weights g hg l hl⟩

/-- All six linked native traces exist on ONE sem/y1/g carrier. Their 29-step
lengths and cohort loop Results follow from the retained LPm association. -/
theorem construct {H : Type} (inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H) (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (hs : LPq_ReadPorts.SemCanonical sem) (y1 : Slice U8) (hy : SelectedFields y1)
    (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (hg : LPq_ReadPorts.WeightsCanonical g)
    (point : Fin 6 → Usize) (number : ∀ i, (point i).val=i.val) :
    ∃ xs : Fin 6 → List (NE×NQ), ∃ out : Fin 6 → NE,
      (∀ i, LPm_PointLoop.Trace sem y1 g (point i)
        {start:=0#usize,«end»:=29#usize} LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero (xs i) (out i)) ∧
      (∀ i, (xs i).length=29 ∧
        verifier.prepared_claim_dot_loop LPm_PointLoop.ops inst
          {start:=0#usize,«end»:=29#usize} sem y1 g (point i)
          (statePort LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero)=ok (.Ok (ePort (out i)))) := by
  have ex : ∀ i : Fin 6, ∃ xs out, LPm_PointLoop.Trace sem y1 g (point i)
      {start:=0#usize,«end»:=29#usize} LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero xs out := by
    intro i
    exact LPq_PointConstruct.from_zero sem y1 g (point i)
      (domain sem hs y1 hy g hg (point i) (by rw [number]; exact i.isLt))
  choose xs out tr using ex
  refine ⟨xs,out,tr,?_⟩
  intro i
  have h := LPm_PointLength.all_six inst sem y1 g point number xs out tr i
  exact ⟨h.1,h.2.2.1⟩

#print axioms selected
#print axioms domain
#print axioms construct
end AspisR1.LPq_SixPoints

import XRy_ArrayRead
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open XRo_Join_Carriers
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRy_ClaimSumStep
open AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize
abbrev Seven := Array C.E 7#usize

def cell (a : Seven) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val<7) : C.E :=
 a.val[i.val]'(by have hn : a.val.length=7 := a.property; omega)
def canonical (a : Seven) : Prop := ∀ i hi, XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical (cell a i hi)
def step (k parts : Seven) (sum : C.E) (i : Usize) : Result C.E := do
 let part ← Array.index_usize parts i
 let power ← Array.index_usize k i
 let term ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul power part
 aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add sum term

theorem paired (k parts : Seven) (iter : Range) (sum : C.E)
 (hend : iter.end.val=7) (hlt : iter.start.val<7)
 (hk : canonical k) (hp : canonical parts) (hs : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical sum) :
 ∃ iter' out, step k parts sum iter.start=ok out ∧ XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical out ∧
 iter'.start.val=iter.start.val+1 ∧ iter'.end=iter.end ∧
 AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.verifier.prepared_claim_sum_loop.body
   (arr toClaimE k) (arr toClaimE parts) iter (toClaimE sum)=ok (.cont (iter',toClaimE out)) := by
 obtain ⟨pair,hn,hnv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_some_spec
     (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize) (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize)
     (by intros; rfl) (by intros; rfl) iter (by omega))
 rcases pair with ⟨opt,iter'⟩
 rcases hnv with ⟨ho,hi,he⟩
 subst opt
 have h7 : (7#usize).val=7 := by scalar_tac
 have hkread := XRy_ArrayRead.read k iter.start (by simpa only [h7] using hlt)
 have hpread := XRy_ArrayRead.read parts iter.start (by simpa only [h7] using hlt)
 have tkread := XRy_ArrayRead.mapped toClaimE k iter.start (by simpa only [h7] using hlt)
 have tpread := XRy_ArrayRead.mapped toClaimE parts iter.start (by simpa only [h7] using hlt)
 obtain ⟨term,et,ht,tt⟩ := XRy_ClaimArithmetic.multiply
   (cell k iter.start hlt) (cell parts iter.start hlt) (hk _ hlt) (hp _ hlt)
 obtain ⟨out,eo,hout,tout⟩ := XRy_ClaimAdd.add sum term hs ht
 refine ⟨iter',out,?_,hout,hi,he,?_⟩
 · simp only [step,hpread,hkread,bind_tc_ok]
   change (do
     let t ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul (cell k iter.start hlt) (cell parts iter.start hlt)
     aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add sum t) = _
   rw [et,bind_tc_ok,eo]
 · rw [AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.verifier.prepared_claim_sum_loop.body,hn,bind_tc_ok]
   simp only [tpread,tkread,AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.trace.value,bind_tc_ok]
   change (do
     let pv ← Array.index_usize (arr toClaimE parts) iter.start
     let kv ← Array.index_usize (arr toClaimE k) iter.start
     let t ← AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.mul kv pv
     let o ← AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.add (toClaimE sum) t
     ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter',o) : ControlFlow (Range × AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete.E) AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete.E)) = _
   simp only [tpread,tkread,bind_tc_ok]
   change (do
     let t ← AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.mul
       (toClaimE (cell k iter.start hlt)) (toClaimE (cell parts iter.start hlt))
     let o ← AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.add (toClaimE sum) t
     ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter',o) : ControlFlow (Range × AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete.E) AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete.E)) = _
   rw [tt,bind_tc_ok,tout,bind_tc_ok]

#print axioms paired
end XRy_ClaimSumStep

XRy_ClaimSumLoop.source:
import XRy_ClaimSumStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRo_Join_Carriers XRy_ClaimSumStep
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRy_ClaimSumLoop
open AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge

def run (k parts : Seven) : Nat → Usize → C.E → Result C.E
 | 0,_,sum => ok sum
 | n+1,i,sum => do
   let sum' ← step k parts sum i
   let j ← i+1#usize
   run k parts n j sum'

theorem paired (n : Nat) (k parts : Seven) (hk : canonical k) (hp : canonical parts)
 (iter : Range) (sum : C.E) (hs : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical sum)
 (hend : iter.end.val=7) (remaining : iter.start.val+n=7) :
 ∃ out, XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical out ∧ run k parts n iter.start sum=ok out ∧
 AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.verifier.prepared_claim_sum_loop
   iter (arr toClaimE k) (arr toClaimE parts) (toClaimE sum)=ok (toClaimE out) := by
 induction n generalizing iter sum with
 | zero =>
   refine ⟨sum,hs,rfl,?_⟩
   apply XRy_PowersLoop.done
   exact AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.sum_body_done _ _ iter (toClaimE sum) (by omega)
 | succ n ih =>
   obtain ⟨iter',next,er,hn,hstart,hend',et⟩ := XRy_ClaimSumStep.paired
     k parts iter sum hend (by omega) hk hp hs
   have hAdd : (iter.start+1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃ j => j.val=iter.start.val+1 ⦄ := by
     apply UScalar.add_spec
     scalar_tac
   obtain ⟨j,ej,hj⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hAdd
   have he : j=iter'.start := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (hj.trans hstart.symm)
   obtain ⟨out,ho,hr,ht⟩ := ih iter' next hn (by rw [hend']; exact hend) (by omega)
   refine ⟨out,ho,?_,?_⟩
   · rw [run,er,bind_tc_ok,ej,bind_tc_ok,he]
     exact hr
   · exact (XRy_PowersLoop.cont _ _ _ et).trans ht

#print axioms paired
end XRy_ClaimSumLoop

import XRy_ClaimSumLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open XRo_Join_Carriers XRy_ClaimSumStep
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace XRy_ClaimSum
open AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge

theorem zero_canonical : XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical XRy_Powers.zero := by
 constructor <;> constructor <;> constructor <;> decide

theorem zero_claim : toClaimE XRy_Powers.zero =
 AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.ZERO := by
 unfold AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact.ZERO
   AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO
 rfl

 ∃ out, XRy_WideMultiply.Canonical out ∧
 XRy_ClaimSumLoop.run k parts 7 0#usize XRy_Powers.zero=ok out ∧
 AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.verifier.prepared_claim_sum (arr toClaimE k) (arr toClaimE parts) =
   ok (toClaimE out) := by
 obtain ⟨out,ho,hr,ht⟩ := XRy_ClaimSumLoop.paired 7 k parts hk hp
   ⟨0#usize,7#usize⟩ XRy_Powers.zero zero_canonical (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac)
 refine ⟨out,ho,hr,?_⟩
 unfold AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.verifier.prepared_claim_sum
 rw [←zero_claim,ht,bind_tc_ok]
 simp only [AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.trace.value,bind_tc_ok]

#print axioms sum
end XRy_ClaimSum

import LPq_SixPoints
import XRy_ClaimSum
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_WeightedStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPq_FieldPorts XRo_Join_Carriers

theorem add (x y : NE) (hx : canonE x) (hy : canonE y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add x y=ok z ∧ canonE z ∧
      aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add (wide x) (wide y)=ok (wide z) := by
  obtain ⟨lo,el,cl,tl⟩ := LPq_TowerPorts.add x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨hi,eh,ch,th⟩ := LPq_TowerPorts.add x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  refine ⟨⟨lo,hi⟩,?_,⟨cl,ch⟩,?_⟩
  · simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add,el,eh,bind_tc_ok]
  · change (do
      let a ← XRn_Join_Field.field.QM31.add (qm x.c0) (qm y.c0)
      let b ← XRn_Join_Field.field.QM31.add (qm x.c1) (qm y.c1)
      ok (⟨XRn_Join_FieldExternal.oldQ a,XRn_Join_FieldExternal.oldQ b⟩ : C.E)) = _
    rw [tl,bind_tc_ok,th,bind_tc_ok]
    rfl

abbrev Seven := Array NE 7#usize
def canonical (a : Seven) : Prop := ∀ x ∈ a.val, canonE x

theorem canonical_port (a : Seven) (ha : canonical a) :
    XRy_ClaimSumStep.canonical (arr wide a) := by
  intro i hi
  simp only [XRy_ClaimSumStep.cell,arr,List.getElem_map]
  apply LPq_WidePorts.canonical
  exact ha _ (List.getElem_mem _)

def step (k parts : Seven) (sum : NE) (i : Usize) : Result NE := do
  let part ← Array.index_usize parts i
  let power ← Array.index_usize k i
  let term ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul power part
  FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add sum term

/-- ONE native arithmetic step after the operand-selection cut. The same
selected carriers feed multiplication and addition; no arithmetic is stubbed
or proved in Kani here. -/
theorem paired (k parts : Seven) (sum : NE) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val<7)
    (hk : canonical k) (hp : canonical parts) (hs : canonE sum) :
    ∃ out, step k parts sum i=ok out ∧ canonE out ∧
      XRy_ClaimSumStep.step (arr wide k) (arr wide parts) (wide sum) i=ok (wide out) := by
  have ik : i.val<k.val.length := by rw [k.property]; exact hi
  have ip : i.val<parts.val.length := by rw [parts.property]; exact hi
  obtain ⟨term,et,ct,rt⟩ := LPq_WidePorts.mul k.val[i.val] parts.val[i.val]
    (hk _ (List.getElem_mem ik)) (hp _ (List.getElem_mem ip))
  obtain ⟨out,eo,co,ro⟩ := add sum term hs ct
  refine ⟨out,?_,co,?_⟩
  · simp only [step,XRy_ArrayRead.read parts i hi,XRy_ArrayRead.read k i hi,bind_tc_ok,et,eo]
  · simp only [XRy_ClaimSumStep.step,XRy_ArrayRead.mapped wide parts i hi,
      XRy_ArrayRead.mapped wide k i hi,bind_tc_ok,rt,ro]

#print axioms add
#print axioms canonical_port
#print axioms paired
end AspisR1.LPq_WeightedStep

LPq_Weighted.source:
import LPq_WeightedStep
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_Weighted
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPq_FieldPorts LPq_WeightedStep XRo_Join_Carriers

def run (k parts : Seven) : Nat → Usize → NE → Result NE
  | 0,_,sum => ok sum
  | n+1,i,sum => do
    let next ← step k parts sum i
    let j ← i+1#usize
    run k parts n j next

/-- Native seven-part weighting is linked one step at a time to XRy's already
installed indexed cohort fold. No independent weighted-sum equation is assumed. -/
theorem paired (n : Nat) (k parts : Seven) (hk : canonical k) (hp : canonical parts)
    (i : Usize) (sum : NE) (hs : canonE sum) (bound : i.val+n≤7) :
    ∃ out, run k parts n i sum=ok out ∧ canonE out ∧
      XRy_ClaimSumLoop.run (arr wide k) (arr wide parts) n i (wide sum)=ok (wide out) := by
  induction n generalizing i sum with
  | zero => exact ⟨sum,rfl,hs,rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    have hi : i.val<7 := by omega
    obtain ⟨next,en,cn,rn⟩ := LPq_WeightedStep.paired k parts sum i hi hk hp hs
    obtain ⟨j,ej,hj⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.add_spec (x:=i) (y:=1#usize) (by scalar_tac))
    have advance : j.val=i.val+1 := by simpa only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hj
    obtain ⟨out,eo,co,ro⟩ := ih j next cn (by omega)
    exact ⟨out,by rw [run,en,bind_tc_ok,ej,bind_tc_ok,eo],co,by
      rw [XRy_ClaimSumLoop.run,rn,bind_tc_ok,ej,bind_tc_ok,ro]⟩

theorem zero_canonical : canonE FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO := by
  norm_num [canonE,canonQ,canonC,LPi_CMProduct.Canon,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO]

theorem zero_wide : wide FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO=XRy_Powers.zero := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO
  rfl

/-- SAME seven power and part arrays, complete native eight-word result and
concrete cohort sum. Uses the installed XRy sum theorem by Result uniqueness. -/
theorem source (k parts : Seven) (hk : canonical k) (hp : canonical parts) :
    ∃ out, run k parts 7 0#usize FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO=ok out ∧
      canonE out ∧
      AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.verifier.prepared_claim_sum
        (arr LPq_Powers.claim k) (arr LPq_Powers.claim parts)=ok (LPq_Powers.claim out) := by
  obtain ⟨out,en,co,rn⟩ := paired 7 k parts hk hp 0#usize _ zero_canonical (by decide)
  rw [zero_wide] at rn
  obtain ⟨actual,_,ra,rc⟩ := XRy_ClaimSum.sum (arr wide k) (arr wide parts)
    (canonical_port k hk) (canonical_port parts hp)
  have same : actual=wide out := Result.ok.inj (ra.symm.trans rn)
  rw [same] at rc
  refine ⟨out,en,co,?_⟩
  have maps (a : Seven) : arr AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.toClaimE (arr wide a)=arr LPq_Powers.claim a := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (a.val.map wide).map AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.toClaimE=a.val.map LPq_Powers.claim
    rw [List.map_map]
    rfl
  rw [maps,maps] at rc
  exact rc

#print axioms paired
#print axioms zero_canonical
#print axioms zero_wide
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPq_Weighted

LPi_PowersStep.source:
import LPi_TowerValues
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPi_PowersStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow LPi_FieldValues

theorem step {N : Usize} (x p : NE) (a : Array NE N) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val<N.val) (hx : canonE x) (hp : canonE p) :
    ∃ i', i'.val=i.val+1 ∧
      ((i'=N ∧ FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body x a p i=ok (.done (a.set i p))) ∨
       (i'≠N ∧ ∃ p', FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body x a p i=
         ok (.cont (a.set i p,p',i')) ∧ canonE p' ∧ ew p'=mulE (ew p) (ew x))) := by
  obtain ⟨out,hmut,hspec⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.index_mut_usize_spec a i (by simpa [a.property] using hi))
  rcases out with ⟨old,back⟩
  rcases hspec with ⟨_,hback⟩
  subst back
  let i' := Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize
  have inc : i'.val=i.val+1 := by
    rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
    apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
    have hN : N.val < UScalar.size .Usize := by
      simpa only [UScalar.size,UScalar.val,UScalarTy.numBits] using N.bv.isLt
    change i.val+1 < UScalar.size .Usize
    omega
  have hlt : i<N := by scalar_tac
  refine ⟨i',inc,?_⟩
  by_cases he : i'=N
  · refine Or.inl ⟨he,?_⟩
    simp only [FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body,hlt,ite_true,
      hmut,lift,bind_tc_ok,show Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize=i' from rfl,he]
    rfl
  · obtain ⟨p',hm,hc,hv⟩ := LPi_TowerValues.wide_mul p x hp hx
    refine Or.inr ⟨he,p',?_,hc,hv⟩
    simp only [FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body,hlt,ite_true,hmut,lift,bind_tc_ok,
      show Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize=i' from rfl,he,ite_false,hm]
    rfl

theorem done {N : Usize} (x p : NE) (a : Array NE N) (i : Usize)
    (hi : N.val ≤ i.val) : FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body x a p i=ok (.done a) := by
  have hn : ¬i<N := by scalar_tac
  simp only [FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body,hn,ite_false]

#print axioms step
#print axioms done
end AspisR1.LPi_PowersStep

LPi_PowersPrefix.source:
import LPi_PowersStep
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPi_PowersPrefix
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues

def power (x : EW) : Nat → EW
  | 0 => ew FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ONE
  | n+1 => mulE (power x n) x

def Holds {N : Usize} (a : Array NE N) (x : EW) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, j < n → ∃ z, a.val[j]?=some z ∧ canonE z ∧ ew z=power x j

theorem advance {N : Usize} (a : Array NE N) (x : EW) (i : Usize) (p : NE)
    (hi : i.val < N.val) (hold : Holds a x i.val) (hp : canonE p)
    (value : ew p=power x i.val) : Holds (a.set i p) x (i.val+1) := by
  intro j hj
  have hlen : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa only [a.property] using hi
  by_cases hji : j=i.val
  · subst j
    refine ⟨p,?_,hp,value⟩
    simp [Array.set,List.getElem?_set,hlen,hi]
  · have hj0 : j < i.val := by omega
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hc,hv⟩ := hold j hj0
    refine ⟨z,?_,hc,hv⟩
    simpa [Array.set,List.getElem?_set,hji,Ne.symm hji] using hz

#print axioms advance
end AspisR1.LPi_PowersPrefix

LPi_PowersValue.source:
import LPi_PowersPrefix
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPi_PowersValue
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow LPi_FieldValues LPi_PowersPrefix

theorem loop {N : Usize} (x p : NE) (a : Array NE N) (i : Usize)
    (hx : canonE x) (hp : canonE p) (hi : i.val ≤ N.val)
    (vp : ew p=power (ew x) i.val) (pref : Holds a (ew x) i.val) :
    ∃ out, FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop x a p i=ok out ∧ Holds out (ew x) N.val := by
  let inv : (Array NE N × NE × Usize) → Prop := fun s =>
    s.2.2.val ≤ N.val ∧ canonE s.2.1 ∧ ew s.2.1=power (ew x) s.2.2.val ∧
      Holds s.1 (ew x) s.2.2.val
  have spec : WP.spec (FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop x a p i)
      (fun out => Holds out (ew x) N.val) := by
    unfold FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop
    apply loop.spec_decr_nat (fun s : Array NE N × NE × Usize => N.val-s.2.2.val)
      inv (fun out => Holds out (ew x) N.val)
      (fun s => FIo_Native.weights.powers_loop.body x s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2) (a,p,i)
    · rintro ⟨arr,pow,index⟩ h
      rcases h with ⟨bound,canonical,value,pref⟩
      change index.val ≤ N.val at bound
      change canonE pow at canonical
      change ew pow=power (ew x) index.val at value
      change Holds arr (ew x) index.val at pref
      by_cases more : index.val < N.val
      · obtain ⟨next,inc,last|cont⟩ := LPi_PowersStep.step x pow arr index more hx canonical
        · rcases last with ⟨he,call⟩
          rw [call,WP.spec_ok]
          have donePref := advance arr (ew x) index pow more pref canonical value
          have hn : index.val+1=N.val := by rw [←inc,he]
          simpa only [hn] using donePref
        · rcases cont with ⟨hne,newPow,call,newCanon,newValue⟩
          rw [call,WP.spec_ok]
          have nextBound : next.val ≤ N.val := by omega
          have nextValue : ew newPow=power (ew x) next.val := by
            rw [newValue,value,inc]
            rfl
          have nextPref : Holds (arr.set index pow) (ew x) next.val := by
            rw [inc]
            exact advance arr (ew x) index pow more pref canonical value
          change (next.val ≤ N.val ∧ canonE newPow ∧
            ew newPow=power (ew x) next.val ∧ Holds (arr.set index pow) (ew x) next.val) ∧
            N.val-next.val < N.val-index.val
          exact ⟨⟨nextBound,newCanon,nextValue,nextPref⟩,by omega⟩
      · rw [LPi_PowersStep.done x pow arr index (by omega),WP.spec_ok]
        have same : index.val=N.val := by omega
        simpa only [same] using pref
    · exact ⟨hi,hp,vp,pref⟩
  exact WP.spec_imp_exists spec

#print axioms loop
end AspisR1.LPi_PowersValue

theorem one_canonical : canonE FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ONE := by

import LPi_TowerValues
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPm_StubBounds

/-- The caller stub's reference formulas use wrapping word instructions only
to remove redundant verifier-side overflow obligations. These shape bounds
show they still denote the SAME natural-number formulas on canonical inputs. -/
theorem product (a b : Nat) (ha : a<4294967296) (hb : b<4294967296) :
    a*b<18446744073709551616 := by
  have h := Nat.mul_le_mul (show a≤4294967295 by omega) (show b≤4294967295 by omega)
  norm_num at h
  omega

theorem canonical_sum (a b : Nat) (ha : a<2147483647) (hb : b<2147483647) :
    a+b<4294967296 ∧ a+2147483647<4294967296 ∧ b≤a+2147483647 := by omega

theorem residue (n : Nat) : n%2147483647<2147483647 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)

LPm_PowersBridge.source:
import LPi_PowersSource
import LPm_StubBounds
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPm_PowersBridge
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPi_PowersPrefix

/-- The complete eight-word carrier is fixed by its natural value port. -/
theorem values_injective (x y : NE) (same : ew x=ew y) : x=y := by
  rcases x with ⟨⟨⟨a,b⟩,⟨c,d⟩⟩,⟨⟨e,f⟩,⟨g,h⟩⟩⟩
  rcases y with ⟨⟨⟨i,j⟩,⟨k,l⟩⟩,⟨⟨m,n⟩,⟨o,p⟩⟩⟩
  simp only [ew,qw,cw,Prod.mk.injEq] at same
  rcases same with ⟨⟨⟨ha,hb⟩,⟨hc,hd⟩⟩,⟨⟨he,hf⟩,⟨hg,hh⟩⟩⟩
  simp only [UScalar.eq_of_val_eq ha,UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hb,UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hc,
    UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hd,UScalar.eq_of_val_eq he,UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hf,
    UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hg,UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hh]

/-- N source writes, but only N-1 continuing calls: the actual last branch
returns immediately. The native write/frame, continuing return and field-value
gates supply the local transitions, not a whole powers equality. -/
inductive Trace (x : NE) : Nat → NE → List NE → Prop where
  | zero (p : NE) : Trace x 0 p []
  | last (p : NE) (canonical : canonE p) : Trace x 1 p [p]
  | next {n : Nat} {p p' : NE} {xs : List NE}
      (canonical : canonE p) (value : ew p'=mulE (ew p) (ew x))
      (tail : Trace x (n+1) p' xs) : Trace x (n+2) p (p::xs)

theorem trace_values {x p : NE} {n : Nat} {xs : List NE}
    (tr : Trace x n p xs) (i : Nat) (initial : ew p=power (ew x) i) :
    ∀ j, j<n → ∃ z, xs[j]?=some z ∧ canonE z ∧ ew z=power (ew x) (i+j) := by
  induction tr generalizing i with
  | zero p => intro j hj; omega
  | last p canonical =>
    intro j hj
    have hj0 : j=0 := by omega
    subst j
    exact ⟨p,rfl,canonical,by simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using initial⟩
  | @next n p p' xs canonical value tail ih =>
    have nextValue : ew p'=power (ew x) (i+1) := by
      rw [value,initial]
      rfl
    intro j hj
    cases j with
    | zero => exact ⟨p,rfl,canonical,by simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using initial⟩
    | succ j =>
      obtain ⟨z,hz,hc,hv⟩ := ih (i+1) nextValue j (by omega)
      exact ⟨z,hz,hc,by simpa only [Nat.add_assoc,Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_left_comm] using hv⟩

/-- Actual seven-element returned carrier, with every word identified with
the emitted helper's Result. No independently chosen whole-output equality. -/
theorem native_result (x : NE) (canonical : canonE x) (out : Array NE 7#usize)
    (tr : Trace x 7 FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ONE out.val) :
    FIo_Native.weights.powers 7#usize x=ok out := by
  obtain ⟨model,call,holds⟩ := LPi_PowersSource.seven x canonical
  have native := trace_values tr 0 rfl
  have same : model=out := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply List.ext_getElem
    · exact model.property.trans out.property.symm
    · intro i hi hj
      have bound : i<7 := by
        have hlen : model.val.length=7 := model.property
        omega
      obtain ⟨z,hz,_,vz⟩ := holds i bound
      obtain ⟨w,hw,_,vw⟩ := native i bound
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi] at hz
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj] at hw
      rw [Option.some.inj hz,Option.some.inj hw]
      exact values_injective z w (vz.trans (by simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using vw.symm))
  rw [same] at call
  exact call

#print axioms values_injective
#print axioms trace_values
#print axioms native_result
end AspisR1.LPm_PowersBridge

LPq_OutputDomains.source:
import LPq_Weighted
import LPm_PowersBridge
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_OutputDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPm_RawPort

theorem finish (s : Native) : ∃ out,
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.EbyKDot.finish s=ok out ∧ canonE out := by
  obtain ⟨out,run,h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7⟩ := LPf_PublicDotAllStates.source s
  refine ⟨out,run,?_⟩
  change ((out.c0.c0.a.val<2147483647 ∧ out.c0.c0.b.val<2147483647) ∧
    (out.c0.c1.a.val<2147483647 ∧ out.c0.c1.b.val<2147483647)) ∧
    ((out.c1.c0.a.val<2147483647 ∧ out.c1.c0.b.val<2147483647) ∧
    (out.c1.c1.a.val<2147483647 ∧ out.c1.c1.b.val<2147483647))
  rw [h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7]
  exact ⟨⟨⟨Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide),Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩,
    ⟨Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide),Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩⟩,
    ⟨⟨Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide),Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩,
    ⟨Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide),Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩⟩⟩

theorem point {H : Type} {sem : AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.r1_semantic.Verified H}
    {y1 : Slice U8} {g : Array AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete.E 29#usize}
    {p : Usize} {iter : LPm_PointLoop.Range} {s : Native} {xs : List (NE×NQ)} {out : NE}
    (tr : LPm_PointLoop.Trace sem y1 g p iter s xs out) : canonE out := by
  induction tr with
  | done iter iter' s out next run =>
    obtain ⟨actual,call,ca⟩ := finish s
    have same : actual=out := Result.ok.inj (call.symm.trans run)
    simpa only [same] using ca
  | step l v q next read weight cv cq count push tail ih => exact ih

theorem powers {N : Usize} (x : NE) (hx : canonE x) (a : Array NE N)
    (run : FIo_Native.weights.powers N x=ok a) : ∀ z ∈ a.val, canonE z := by
  obtain ⟨actual,call,holds⟩ := LPi_PowersSource.source N x hx
  have same : actual=a := Result.ok.inj (call.symm.trans run)
  subst actual
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨i,hi,rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hz
  have bound : i<N.val := by rw [←a.property]; exact hi
  obtain ⟨v,hv,cv,_⟩ := holds i bound
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi] at hv
  exact (Option.some.inj hv) ▸ cv

#print axioms finish
#print axioms point
#print axioms powers
end AspisR1.LPq_OutputDomains

import LPq_OutputDomains
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_ArrayPorts
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues XRo_Join_Carriers

theorem update {A : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array A N) (i : Usize) (v : A)
    (hi : i.val<N.val) : Array.update a i v=ok (a.set i v) := by
  obtain ⟨out,call,value⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec a i v (by simpa only [Array.length,a.property] using hi))
  exact call.trans (congrArg ok value)

theorem mapped {A B : Type} {N : Usize} (f : A → B) (a : Array A N)
    (i : Usize) (v : A) (hi : i.val<N.val) :
    Array.update (arr f a) i (f v)=ok (arr f (a.set i v)) := by
  rw [update _ _ _ hi,XRy_ArrayMap.set]

theorem canonical_set (a : LPq_WeightedStep.Seven) (i : Usize) (v : NE)
    (ha : LPq_WeightedStep.canonical a) (hv : canonE v) :
    LPq_WeightedStep.canonical (a.set i v) := by
  change ∀ z ∈ a.val.set i.val v, canonE z
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨j,hj,rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hz
  rw [List.getElem_set]
  split
  · exact hv
  · exact ha _ (List.getElem_mem _)

#print axioms update
#print axioms mapped
#print axioms canonical_set
end AspisR1.LPq_ArrayPorts

import LPq_ArrayPorts
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_OuterTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow LPi_FieldValues LPm_RawPort XRo_Join_Carriers
open AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim
abbrev Range := LPm_PointLoop.Range
abbrev Seven := LPq_WeightedStep.Seven

/-- Source-local outer observations. Each nested Dot trace uses the SAME
semantic carrier, selected bytes and coefficient array. The final component
is the previously paired seven-step native weighting, not a body equality. -/
inductive Trace {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8)
    (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (k : Seven) : Range → Seven → NE → Prop where
  | done (iter iter' : Range) (parts : Seven) (out : NE)
      (next : core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter=ok (none,iter'))
      (sum : LPq_Weighted.run k parts 7 0#usize FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO=ok out) :
      Trace sem y1 g k iter parts out
  | step {iter iter' : Range} {parts : Seven} {out : NE}
      (point i : Usize) (value : NE) (xs : List (NE×NQ))
      (next : core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter=ok (some point,iter'))
      (dot : LPm_PointLoop.Trace sem y1 g point
        {start:=0#usize,«end»:=29#usize} LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero xs value)
      (increment : (point+1#usize : Result Usize)=ok i) (within : i.val<7)
      (tail : Trace sem y1 g k iter' (parts.set i value) out) :
      Trace sem y1 g k iter parts out

theorem point_source {H : Type} (inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    {sem : r1_semantic.Verified H} {y1 : Slice U8} {g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize}
    {point : Usize} {xs : List (NE×NQ)} {value : NE}
    (tr : LPm_PointLoop.Trace sem y1 g point
      {start:=0#usize,«end»:=29#usize} LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero xs value) :
    verifier.prepared_claim_dot LPm_PointLoop.ops inst sem y1 g point=ok (.Ok (LPq_Powers.claim value)) := by
  change verifier.prepared_claim_dot_loop LPm_PointLoop.ops inst
    {start:=0#usize,«end»:=29#usize} sem y1 g point
    (statePort LPm_PublicTwentyNine.zero)=_
  exact LPm_PointLoop.source inst tr

/-- Whole outer Result follows from linked local calls. There is no supplied
whole prepared_claim Result, independent part inventory or public sum. -/
theorem source {H : Type} (inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    {sem : r1_semantic.Verified H} {y1 : Slice U8} {g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize}
    {k parts : Seven} {iter : Range} {out : NE}
    (hk : LPq_WeightedStep.canonical k) (hp : LPq_WeightedStep.canonical parts)
    (tr : Trace sem y1 g k iter parts out) :
    verifier.prepared_claim_loop LPm_PointLoop.ops inst iter sem y1 g
      (arr LPq_Powers.claim k) (arr LPq_Powers.claim parts)=ok (.Ok (LPq_Powers.claim out)) := by
  induction tr with
  | done iter iter' parts out next sum =>
    obtain ⟨actual,en,_,model⟩ := LPq_Weighted.source k parts hk hp
    have same : actual=out := Result.ok.inj (en.symm.trans sum)
    rw [same] at model
    have body : verifier.prepared_claim_loop.body LPm_PointLoop.ops inst sem y1 g
        (arr LPq_Powers.claim k) iter (arr LPq_Powers.claim parts)=
        ok (ControlFlow.done (.Ok (LPq_Powers.claim out))) := by
      rw [verifier.prepared_claim_loop.body,next,bind_tc_ok]
      rw [model,bind_tc_ok]
      rfl
    change Aeneas.Std.loop _ _=_
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    dsimp only
    rw [body]
  | @step iter iter' parts out point i value xs next dot increment within tail ih =>
    have model := point_source inst dot
    have write := LPq_ArrayPorts.mapped LPq_Powers.claim parts i value within
    have hp' := LPq_ArrayPorts.canonical_set parts i value hp (LPq_OutputDomains.point dot)
    have body : verifier.prepared_claim_loop.body LPm_PointLoop.ops inst sem y1 g
        (arr LPq_Powers.claim k) iter (arr LPq_Powers.claim parts)=
        ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter',arr LPq_Powers.claim (parts.set i value))) := by
      rw [verifier.prepared_claim_loop.body,next,bind_tc_ok]
      change (do
        let r ← verifier.prepared_claim_dot LPm_PointLoop.ops inst sem y1 g point
        let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
        match cf with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val => do
          let j ← point+1#usize
          let a ← Array.update (arr LPq_Powers.claim parts) j val
          ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter',a))
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual => do
          let r1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
            aspis_core.field.WideExact (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
          ok (ControlFlow.done r1))=_
      rw [model,bind_tc_ok]
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok,increment,write]

    change Aeneas.Std.loop _ _=_
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    dsimp only
    rw [body]
    exact ih hp'

#print axioms point_source
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPq_OuterTrace

import LPq_OuterTrace
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_OuterConstruct
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPm_RawPort AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim

theorem loop {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8)
    (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (k : LPq_WeightedStep.Seven)
    (hk : LPq_WeightedStep.canonical k)
    (domain : ∀ p : Usize, p.val<6 → LPq_PointConstruct.ReadDomain sem y1 g p)
    (fuel : Nat) (iter : LPq_OuterTrace.Range) (parts : LPq_WeightedStep.Seven)
    (hp : LPq_WeightedStep.canonical parts) (last : iter.end.val=6)
    (bound : iter.start.val≤6) (remaining : 6-iter.start.val≤fuel) :
    ∃ out, LPq_OuterTrace.Trace sem y1 g k iter parts out ∧ canonE out := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter parts with
  | zero =>
    have stopped : ¬ (iter.start.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
    obtain ⟨⟨o,iter'⟩,call,shape⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_spec
        (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize) (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize)
        (by intros;rfl) (by intros;rfl) iter)
    simp only [stopped,↓reduceIte] at shape
    obtain ⟨out,sum,co,_⟩ := LPq_Weighted.source k parts hk hp
    exact ⟨out,.done iter iter' parts out (by rw [shape.1.1] at call;exact call) sum,co⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨⟨o,iter'⟩,call,shape⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_spec
        (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize) (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize)
        (by intros;rfl) (by intros;rfl) iter)
    by_cases active : iter.start.val < iter.end.val
    · simp only [active,↓reduceIte] at shape
      have hi : iter.start.val<6 := by omega
      obtain ⟨xs,value,dot⟩ := LPq_PointConstruct.from_zero sem y1 g iter.start (domain _ hi)
      obtain ⟨i,inc,vi⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
        (UScalar.add_spec (x:=iter.start) (y:=1#usize) (by scalar_tac))
      have advance : i.val=iter.start.val+1 := by simpa only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using vi
      have within : i.val<7 := by omega
      have ci := LPq_ArrayPorts.canonical_set parts i value hp (LPq_OutputDomains.point dot)
      have next : iter'.start.val=iter.start.val+1 := shape.1.2
      have last' : iter'.end.val=6 := by rw [shape.2];exact last
      obtain ⟨out,tail,co⟩ := ih iter' (parts.set i value) ci last' (by omega) (by omega)
      exact ⟨out,.step iter.start i value xs (by rw [shape.1.1] at call;exact call)
        dot inc within tail,co⟩
    · simp only [active,↓reduceIte] at shape
      obtain ⟨out,sum,co,_⟩ := LPq_Weighted.source k parts hk hp
      exact ⟨out,.done iter iter' parts out (by rw [shape.1.1] at call;exact call) sum,co⟩

#print axioms loop
end AspisR1.LPq_OuterConstruct

LPq_PreparedTrace.source:
import LPq_OuterConstruct
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_PreparedTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues LPm_RawPort XRo_Join_Carriers
open AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim
abbrev Seven := LPq_WeightedStep.Seven
abbrev zero := FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO

def initial (inactive : NE) : Seven := (Array.repeat 7#usize zero).set 0#usize inactive

theorem zero_claim : LPq_Powers.claim zero=aspis_core.field.WideExact.ZERO := by
  rw [LPq_Powers.claim,LPq_Weighted.zero_wide,XRy_ClaimSum.zero_claim]

theorem initial_canonical (inactive : NE) (hi : canonE inactive) :
    LPq_WeightedStep.canonical (initial inactive) := by
  apply LPq_ArrayPorts.canonical_set _ _ _ _ hi
  intro z hz
  have same : z=zero := (List.mem_replicate.mp hz).2
  rw [same]
  exact LPq_Weighted.zero_canonical

/-- Whole-body carrier trace: a local powers call, the source's actual initial
parts carrier and six linked point/store transitions ending in native weighting.
No whole-body equation or independently supplied final parts occurs here. -/
inductive Trace {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8)
    (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (inactive kappa out : NE) : Prop where
  | mk (k : Seven) (powers : FIo_Native.weights.powers 7#usize kappa=ok k)
      (outer : LPq_OuterTrace.Trace sem y1 g k
        {start:=0#usize,«end»:=6#usize} (initial inactive) out) :
      Trace sem y1 g inactive kappa out

theorem construct {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (hs : LPq_ReadPorts.SemCanonical sem) (y1 : Slice U8) (hy : LPq_SixPoints.SelectedFields y1)
    (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (hg : LPq_ReadPorts.WeightsCanonical g)
    (inactive kappa : NE) (hi : canonE inactive) (hk : canonE kappa) :
    ∃ out, Trace sem y1 g inactive kappa out ∧ canonE out := by
  obtain ⟨k,call,_⟩ := LPq_Powers.source 7#usize kappa hk
  have kc := LPq_OutputDomains.powers kappa hk k call
  obtain ⟨out,outer,co⟩ := LPq_OuterConstruct.loop sem y1 g k kc
    (fun p hp => LPq_SixPoints.domain sem hs y1 hy g hg p hp)
    6 {start:=0#usize,«end»:=6#usize} (initial inactive) (initial_canonical inactive hi)
    rfl (by decide) (by decide)
  exact ⟨out,⟨k,call,outer⟩,co⟩

/-- Full concrete cohort Result from ONE native local carrier trace. Local
powers uniqueness identifies the actual k, not a separately chosen array. -/
theorem source {H : Type} (inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    {sem : r1_semantic.Verified H} {y1 : Slice U8} {g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize}
    {inactive kappa out : NE} (hi : canonE inactive) (hk : canonE kappa)
    (tr : Trace sem y1 g inactive kappa out) :
    AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.verifier.prepared_claim LPm_PointLoop.ops inst sem y1 (LPq_Powers.claim inactive) g
      (LPq_Powers.claim kappa)=ok (.Ok (LPq_Powers.claim out)) := by
  rcases tr with ⟨k,powers,outerTrace⟩
  obtain ⟨actual,native,model⟩ := LPq_Powers.source 7#usize kappa hk
  have same : actual=k := Result.ok.inj (native.symm.trans powers)
  rw [same] at model
  have outer := LPq_OuterTrace.source inst (LPq_OutputDomains.powers kappa hk k powers)
    (initial_canonical inactive hi) outerTrace
  have init := LPq_ArrayPorts.mapped LPq_Powers.claim (Array.repeat 7#usize zero)
    0#usize inactive (by decide)
  rw [XRy_ArrayMap.repeated,zero_claim] at init
  unfold AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.verifier.prepared_claim
  change (do
    let k ← ClaimPowers.powers 7#usize (LPq_Powers.claim kappa)
    let parts ← Array.update (Array.repeat 7#usize aspis_core.field.WideExact.ZERO) 0#usize (LPq_Powers.claim inactive)
    verifier.prepared_claim_loop LPm_PointLoop.ops inst
      {start:=0#usize,«end»:=6#usize} sem y1 g k parts)=_
  rw [model,bind_tc_ok,init,bind_tc_ok]
  exact outer

#print axioms zero_claim
#print axioms initial_canonical
#print axioms construct
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPq_PreparedTrace

import LPq_PreparedTrace
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_PreparedClaim
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues
open AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim

/-- Frozen source has no digest invocation in this leaf. This function family
keeps the nominal digest instance arbitrary rather than specializing to one
reply or one native successful output. Native association remains the hybrid
local-gate/source-partition obligation documented in the leaf packet. -/
def program {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (y1 : Slice U8)
    (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (inactive kappa : NE) :=
  fun inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H => AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.verifier.prepared_claim LPm_PointLoop.ops inst
    sem y1 (LPq_Powers.claim inactive) g (LPq_Powers.claim kappa)

theorem program_eq {H : Type} {sem : r1_semantic.Verified H} {y1 : Slice U8}
    {g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize} {inactive kappa out : NE}
    (hi : canonE inactive) (hk : canonE kappa)
    (tr : LPq_PreparedTrace.Trace sem y1 g inactive kappa out) :
    program sem y1 g inactive kappa = fun _ => ok (.Ok (LPq_Powers.claim out)) := by
  funext inst
  exact LPq_PreparedTrace.source inst hi hk tr

/-- ONE constructed local trace supplies the SAME result for every digest
instance. No accepted whole-body run, whole-output equality or independent
final array is a premise. SelectedFields is still explicit in this interface. -/
theorem native_result {H : Type} (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (hs : LPq_ReadPorts.SemCanonical sem) (y1 : Slice U8) (hy : LPq_SixPoints.SelectedFields y1)
    (g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize) (hg : LPq_ReadPorts.WeightsCanonical g)
    (inactive kappa : NE) (hi : canonE inactive) (hk : canonE kappa) :
    ∃ out, LPq_PreparedTrace.Trace sem y1 g inactive kappa out ∧ canonE out ∧
      program sem y1 g inactive kappa = fun _ => ok (.Ok (LPq_Powers.claim out)) := by
  obtain ⟨out,tr,co⟩ := LPq_PreparedTrace.construct sem hs y1 hy g hg inactive kappa hi hk
  exact ⟨out,tr,co,program_eq hi hk tr⟩

theorem uniqueness {H : Type} (inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    {sem : r1_semantic.Verified H} {y1 : Slice U8} {g : Array Concrete.E 29#usize}
    {inactive kappa left right : NE} (hi : canonE inactive) (hk : canonE kappa)
    (lt : LPq_PreparedTrace.Trace sem y1 g inactive kappa left)
    (rt : LPq_PreparedTrace.Trace sem y1 g inactive kappa right) :
    LPq_Powers.claim left=LPq_Powers.claim right := by
  have l := LPq_PreparedTrace.source inst hi hk lt
  have r := LPq_PreparedTrace.source inst hi hk rt
  exact core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj (l.symm.trans r))

#print axioms program_eq
#print axioms native_result
#print axioms uniqueness
end AspisR1.LPq_PreparedClaim

import LPq_BytesTotal
import LPq_PreparedClaim
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_SelectedDomain
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues

def selected (y1 : Slice U8) (l : Usize) : Result (Slice U8) :=
  core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8) y1
    {start:=Usize.wrapping_mul l 32#usize,
     «end»:=Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_add l 1#usize) 32#usize}

/-- Only the selected input bytes and word bounds, with the actual native slice
operation. No decoded field output or field-success observation is a premise. -/
def ByteDomain (y1 : Slice U8) : Prop := ∀ l : Usize, l.val<29 → ∃ b : Slice U8,
  selected y1 l=ok b ∧ b.val.length=32 ∧
    (∀ j, j<8 → (LPq_BytesTotal.word b j).val<2147483647)

theorem selected_fields (y1 : Slice U8) (hy : ByteDomain y1) : LPq_SixPoints.SelectedFields y1 := by
  intro l hl
  obtain ⟨b,slice,len,words⟩ := hy l hl
  obtain ⟨out,decode,co⟩ := LPq_BytesTotal.source b len words
  refine ⟨out,co,?_⟩
  change (do
    let b ← selected y1 l
    let o ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes b
    core.option.Option.unwrap o)=_
  rw [slice,bind_tc_ok,decode,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl

theorem native_result {H : Type} (sem : AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (hs : LPq_ReadPorts.SemCanonical sem) (y1 : Slice U8) (hy : ByteDomain y1)
    (g : Array AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete.E 29#usize) (hg : LPq_ReadPorts.WeightsCanonical g)
    (inactive kappa : NE) (hi : canonE inactive) (hk : canonE kappa) :
    ∃ out, LPq_PreparedTrace.Trace sem y1 g inactive kappa out ∧ canonE out ∧
      LPq_PreparedClaim.program sem y1 g inactive kappa = fun _ => ok (.Ok (LPq_Powers.claim out)) :=
  LPq_PreparedClaim.native_result sem hs y1 (selected_fields y1 hy) g hg inactive kappa hi hk

#print axioms selected_fields
#print axioms native_result
end AspisR1.LPq_SelectedDomain

import LPq_SelectedDomain
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPq_CarrierFacts
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues XRo_Join_Carriers

theorem back_claim (x : NE) : LPq_ReadPorts.backE (LPq_Powers.claim x)=x := rfl

theorem weights_from_powers (gamma : NE) (hc : canonE gamma) (g : Array NE 29#usize)
    (call : FIo_Native.weights.powers 29#usize gamma=ok g) :
    LPq_ReadPorts.WeightsCanonical (arr LPq_Powers.claim g) := by
  have canonical := LPq_OutputDomains.powers gamma hc g call
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
  rw [back_claim]
  exact canonical x hx

theorem native_unique {H : Type} (inst : AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    {sem : AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.r1_semantic.Verified H} {y1 : Slice U8}
    {g : Array AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete.E 29#usize}
    {inactive kappa left right : NE} (hi : canonE inactive) (hk : canonE kappa)
    (lt : LPq_PreparedTrace.Trace sem y1 g inactive kappa left)
    (rt : LPq_PreparedTrace.Trace sem y1 g inactive kappa right) : left=right := by
  have same := LPq_PreparedClaim.uniqueness inst hi hk lt rt
  have port := congrArg LPq_ReadPorts.backE same
  simpa only [back_claim] using port

#print axioms back_claim
#print axioms weights_from_powers
#print axioms native_unique
end AspisR1.LPq_CarrierFacts

import Aeneas
import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPr_WordValue
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

/-- Four arbitrary native bytes; no canonical-field or decoder-success premise. -/
theorem bits (a b c d : U8) :
    (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])).bv =
      d.bv ++ c.bv ++ b.bv ++ a.bv := by
  change (BitVec.fromLEBytes [a.bv,b.bv,c.bv,d.bv] : BitVec 32) = _
  ext i hi
  have bound : i < 32 := by simpa using hi
  rw [BitVec.fromLEBytes_getElem]
  rw [BitVec.getElem_append (by omega)]
  interval_cases i <;>
    simp only [List.getElem_cons_zero, List.getElem_cons_succ,
      Nat.reduceDiv, Nat.reduceMod, Nat.reduceLT, ↓reduceDIte, Nat.reduceSub]
  all_goals try rw [BitVec.getElem_append (by omega)]
  all_goals try simp only [Nat.reduceLT, ↓reduceDIte, Nat.reduceSub]
  all_goals try rw [BitVec.getElem_append (by omega)]
  all_goals try simp only [Nat.reduceLT, ↓reduceDIte, Nat.reduceSub]
  all_goals rfl

#print axioms bits
end AspisR1.LPr_WordValue

import LPr_WordValue
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPr_WordNat
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

theorem append_value {m n : Nat} (x : BitVec m) (y : BitVec n) :
    (x ++ y).toNat = x.toNat * 2^n + y.toNat := by
  rw [BitVec.toNat_append, ← Nat.shiftLeft_add_eq_or_of_lt y.isLt, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]

/-- Natural little-endian formula for the exact native library decoder. -/
theorem value (a b c d : U8) :
    (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])).val =
      a.val + 256*b.val + 65536*c.val + 16777216*d.val := by
  change ((core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])).bv).toNat = _
  rw [LPr_WordValue.bits, append_value, append_value, append_value]
  change ((d.val * 256 + c.val) * 256 + b.val) * 256 + a.val = _
  omega

#print axioms append_value
#print axioms value
end AspisR1.LPr_WordNat
